'?1.55:type==='frigate'?1.1:type==='transport'?1.16:.82,L=11*size,W=(type==='line'?3.4:2.8)*size,beam=W/2,deep=1.7*size;let sections=11,bs=[];

const V8_MESH_CACHE={};
function v8meshFor(entity){let key=entity.meshKey||entity.kind+':'+entity.type+':'+entity.form;if(entity.kind==='ship'&&entity.design){key+=':'+entity.design.batteries.map(b=>b.gun+b.count).join(':')}

function v8Open3DBattle(kind='sea',campaign=false,context=null){pauseGame();v8Window='models';v8initToolbar();document.getElementById('v8-backdrop').classList.add('open');const fleet=context?.fleet||s.fleets.find(x=>x.f===s.player),boats=fleet?v8shipsOf(fleet):s.ships.filter(x=>x.f===s.player).slice(0,2),sea=kind==='sea';let units=sea?[...boats.slice(0,4).map((sh,i)=>({id:i+1,shipId:sh.id,kind:'ship',type:sh.type,design:sh.design,pos:[-26,i*11-10,0],angle:.07,hp:sh.hp,maxHp:sh.maxHp,team:'friendly',name:sh.name,cooldown:0,turn:0,firepower:v6shipPower(sh,fleet?.admiral||0)})),...boats.slice(0,Math.max(1,Math.min(2,boats.length))).map((sh,i)=>({id:50+i,kind:'ship',type:sh.type,design:sh.design,pos:[26,11*i-8,0],angle:Math.PI,hp:sh.maxHp*.80,maxHp:sh.maxHp,team:'enemy',name:'Вражеский корабль №'+(i+1),cooldown:2+i,turn:0,firepower:v6shipPower(sh,0)*.82}))]:[{id:1,kind:'inf',type:'inf',form:'line',color:'#b9443d',pos:[-15,-5,0],angle:0,hp:100,maxHp:100,team:'friendly',name:'Королевская пехота',cooldown:0},{id:2,kind:'cav',pos:[-15,5,0],angle:0,hp:100,maxHp:100,team:'friendly',name:'Кавалерия',cooldown:0},{id:3,kind:'art',pos:[-21,0,0],angle:0,hp:100,maxHp:100,team:'friendly',name:'Батарея',cooldown:0},{id:4,kind:'inf',form:'line',color:'#4c6d96',pos:[15,-5,0],angle:Math.PI,hp:100,maxHp:100,team:'enemy',name:'Вражеская пехота',cooldown:0},{id:5,kind:'cav',pos:[15,6,0],angle:Math.PI,hp:100,maxHp:100,team:'enemy',name:'Вражеская кавалерия',cooldown:0}];
 const el=document.getElementById('v8-window');el.innerHTML=`<div class="v8-w-header"><div><h2>${sea?'Морское сражение':'Сухопутное сражение'} — трёхмерный прототип</h2><small>РЕАЛЬНОЕ ВРЕМЯ С ПАУЗОЙ · ${campaign?'Кампанийный бой: повреждения будут перенесены в состав эскадры':'Свободная демонстрация механики'}</small></div><button class="v8-close" onclick="v8finish3dBattle(false)">✕ ${campaign?'Отступить':'Закрыть'}</button></div><div class="v8-w-body"><div class="v8-3d-stage" id="v8-stage"><canvas id="v8-canvas"></canvas><div class="v8-3d-controls"><button onclick="v8battleCommand('pause')">Ⅱ / ▶</button><button onclick="v8battleCommand('fire')">${sea?'Бортовой залп':'Открыть огонь'}</button><button onclick="v8battleCommand('left')">Лево</button><button onclick="v8battleCommand('right')">Право</button>${sea?'<button onclick="v8battleCommand(\'sail\')">Паруса ±</button>':'<button onclick="v8battleCommand(\'formation\')">Линия / колонна</button><button onclick="v8battleCommand(\'advance\')">Наступать</button><button onclick="v8battleCommand(\'retreat\')">Отходить</button>'}<button onclick="v8Reset3D()">Камера</button></div><div class="v8-3d-bottom" id="v8-battle-hud">Время боя 00:00 · Управляйте построением и огнём. function v8openBattle(kind,fleetId,to){let fleet=s.fleets.find(x=>x.id===fleetId),context={fleet,to};v8Open3DBattle(kind,true,context)}
function v8select3dUnit(){return V8_SCENE?.units.find(x=>x.id===v8Battle?.selected)}
function v8Select3d(id){if(!v8Battle)return;v8Battle.selected=id;document.querySelectorAll('#v8-unit-strip [data-unit]').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('selected',Number(x.dataset.unit)===id))}
function v8battleCommand(cmd){let b=v8Battle,sc=V8_SCENE;if(!b||!sc)return;const unit=v8select3dUnit();if(cmd==='pause')sc.paused=!sc.paused;else if(cmd==='fire'){if(unit?.cooldown<=0)v8fire(unit);else say('Орудия ещё перезаряжаются')}else if(cmd==='left'&&unit)unit.turn=-1;else if(cmd==='right'&&unit)unit.turn=1;else if(cmd==='sail')b.sails=!b.sails;else if(cmd==='advance'&&unit){unit.order='advance'}else if(cmd==='retreat'&&unit){unit.order='retreat'}else if(cmd==='formation'&&unit){unit.form=unit.form==='line'?'column':'line';delete V8_MESH_CACHE[unit.kind+':'+unit.type+':'+unit.form]}}
function v8fire(u){let sc=V8_SCENE;if(!sc||u.hp<=0)return;let enemies=sc.units.filter(x=>x.team!==u.team&&x.hp>0),nearest=enemies.sort((a,b)=>Math.hypot(a.pos[0]-u.pos[0],a.pos[1]-u.pos[1])-Math.hypot(b.pos[0]-u.pos[0],b.pos[1]-u.pos[1]))[0];if(!nearest)return;let d=Math.hypot(nearest.pos[0]-u.pos[0],nearest.pos[1]-u.pos[1]);if(d>(sc.kind==='land'?42:62))return say('Цель вне дальности стрельбы');let angle=Math.atan2(nearest.pos[1]-u.pos[1],nearest.pos[0]-u.pos[0]),bearing=Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(angle-u.angle),Math.cos(angle-u.angle)));let firingArc=sc.kind==='land'?Math.PI*.85:(bearing>Math.PI*.22&&bearing<Math.PI*.88);if(!firingArc)return say('Борт не наведён на противника');let n=sc.kind==='land'?u.kind==='art'?24:11:Math.max(10,(u.firepower||22)*.35),hit= Math.max(1,n*(.4+Math.random()*.4)*(1-d/95));nearest.hp=Math.max(0,nearest.hp-hit);u.cooldown=sc.kind==='sea'?5.8:u.kind==='art'?6:3;for(let i=0;i<7;i++)sc.smoke.push({x:u.pos[0]+Math.random()*3,y:u.pos[1]+Math.random()*3,z:1+Math.random()*2,age:0});if(u.team==='friendly')v8Battle.lastHit=`${u.name} → ${nearest.name}: урон ${Math.round(hit)}`}
function v8sceneStep(dt){let sc=V8_SCENE,b=v8Battle;if(!sc||sc.paused)return;sc.time+=dt;if(b)b.elapsed+=dt;for(let u of sc.units){if(u.hp<=0)continue;u.cooldown=Math.max(0,(u.cooldown||0)-dt);if(sc.kind==='sea'&&u.kind==='ship'){u.angle+=(u.turn||0)*dt*.20;u.pos[0]+=Math.cos(u.angle)*dt*.22*(b?.sails===false&&u.team==='friendly'?.3:1);u.pos[1]+=Math.sin(u.angle)*dt*.22*(b?.sails===false&&u.team==='friendly'?.3:1);if(u.pos[0]>60)u.pos[0]=-60;else if(u.pos[0]<-60)u.pos[0]=60;if(u.team==='enemy'){let target=sc.units.find(x=>x.team==='friendly'&&x.hp>0);if(target){let angle=Math.atan2(target.pos[1]-u.pos[1],target.pos[0]-u.pos[0]);let diff=Math.atan2(Math.sin(angle-u.angle),Math.cos(angle-u.angle));u.turn=diff>0?1:-1;if(Math.abs(diff)>.48&&u.cooldown===0)v8fire(u)}}}else if(sc.kind==='land'){if(u.order==='advance'||u.order==='retreat'){let sign=u.team==='friendly'?1:-1;u.pos[0]+=(u.order==='advance'?sign:-sign)*dt*(u.kind==='cav'?3:u.form==='column'?1.8:.9);if(Math.abs(u.pos[0])>26)u.order=null}if(u.team==='enemy'&&u.cooldown<=0)v8fire(u)}}
 sc.smoke=sc.smoke.filter(x=>x.age<1.7);for(let x of sc.smoke)x.age+=dt;
 if(b&&Math.floor(b.elapsed*2)!==Math.floor((b.elapsed-dt)*2)){let hud=document.getElementById('v8-battle-hud');if(hud){let own=sc.units.filter(x=>x.team==='friendly'),foe=sc.units.filter(x=>x.team==='enemy'),sum=a=>Math.round(a.reduce((n,x)=>n+x.hp,0));hud.textContent=`Бой: ${Math.floor(b.elapsed/60)}:${String(Math.floor(b.elapsed%60)).padStart(2,'0')} · Свои ${sum(own)} HP · Противник ${sum(foe)} HP · ${b.lastHit||'Выберите часть и отдайте приказ'}`}}
 if(b&&sc.units.some(x=>x.team==='friendly')&&(!sc.units.some(x=>x.team==='enemy'&&x.hp>0)||!sc.units.some(x=>x.team==='friendly'&&x.hp>0)))v8finish3dBattle(sc.units.some(x=>x.team==='friendly'&&x.hp>0))}
function v8finish3dBattle(won){let b=v8Battle,sc=V8_SCENE;if(b?.campaign&&b.context?.land){v8Stop3D();v8close();if(s.tactical)v6finishBattle(won);else drawAll();return}if(b?.campaign&&b.context){for(let unit of sc?.units||[]){if(unit.shipId){let sh=s.ships.find(x=>x.id===unit.shipId);if(sh){sh.hp=Math.max(1,Math.round(unit.hp));sh.ammo=Math.max(0,(sh.ammo||100)-Math.round(b.elapsed*.07))}}}let fleet=b.context.fleet;if(won&&fleet){let target=s.provinces[b.context.to];if(target&&target.owner!==fleet.f){takeSeaLoss(target,Math.max(1,Math.ceil(vessels(target)*.60)));for(let sh of s.ships.filter(x=>x.f!==fleet.f&&x.port===b.context.to))sh.hp=Math.max(0,sh.hp-sh.maxHp*.45)}if(fleet.mission==='landing'&&target?.owner!==fleet.f)v8amphibiousAssault(fleet,b.context.to);else{fleet.port=b.context.to;for(let sh of v8shipsOf(fleet))sh.port=fleet.port}log(`Эскадра «${fleet.name}» победила у ${N[b.context.to].name}.`)}else if(fleet)log(`Эскадра ${fleet.name}: отступление из сражения. Корабли требуют ремонта.`)}v8Stop3D();v8close();drawAll();if(b?.campaign)say(won?'Победа! Результат внесён в кампанию.':'Отступление. Повреждения внесены в кампанию.')}
function v8startScene(sc){if(V8_FRAME){cancelAnimationFrame(V8_FRAME);V8_FRAME=0}V8_SCENE=sc;V8_CANVAS=document.getElementById('v8-canvas');if(!V8_CANVAS)return;V8_CANVAS.width=Math.max(640,Math.round(V8_CANVAS.getBoundingClientRect().width*devicePixelRatio));V8_CANVAS.height=Math.max(360,Math.round(V8_CANVAS.getBoundingClientRect().height*devicePixelRatio));let prev=null;V8_CANVAS.onpointerdown=e=>{prev=[e.clientX,e.clientY];V8_CANVAS.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId)};V8_CANVAS.onpointermove=e=>{if(!prev)return;sc.yaw+=(e.clientX-prev[0])*.007;sc.pitch=Math.max(.12,Math.min(1.18,sc.pitch+(e.clientY-prev[1])*.005));prev=[e.clientX,e.clientY]};V8_CANVAS.onpointerup=()=>prev=null;V8_CANVAS.onwheel=e=>{e.preventDefault();sc.scale=Math.max(.3,Math.min(8,sc.scale*(e.deltaY<0?1.13:.87)))};
 let last=0;function frame(ms){if(!V8_SCENE||sc!==V8_SCENE)return;let dt=Math.min(.08,(ms-last)/1000||0);last=ms;v8sceneStep(dt);v8render3D();if(sc===V8_SCENE)V8_FRAME=requestAnimationFrame(frame)}V8_FRAME=requestAnimationFrame(frame)}
function v8ExportCurrentOBJ(){let sc=V8_SCENE;if(!sc||!sc.units.length)return;let entity=sc.units[0],mesh=v8meshFor(entity),name=(entity.name||entity.kind||'model').replace(/[^a-z0-9а-яё _-]/ig,'').replace(/\s+/g,'_');let buf=['# Imperii Parusov VIII / procedural 3D model','o '+name];let k=0;for(let face of mesh.faces){for(let p of face.p)buf.push(`v ${p[0].toFixed(5)} ${p[1].toFixed(5)} ${p[2].toFixed(5)}`);buf.push(`f ${++k} ${++k} ${++k}`)}let blob=new Blob([buf.join('\n')],{type:'text/plain'}),url=URL.createObjectURL(blob),a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download=(name||'ship')+'.obj';a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),5000)}

const V9_SCALES={cutter:.69,brig:.94,corvette:.97,xebec:.94,transport:1.16,sloop:.82,frigate:1.10,line:1.55};
const v9PriorShipMesh=v8shipMesh;
v8shipMesh=function(type='frigate',design=null){
 const originalType=({cutter:'sloop',brig:'sloop',corvette:'frigate',xebec:'frigate'})[type]||type;
 const m=v9PriorShipMesh(originalType,design),baseScale=V9_SCALES[originalType],ourScale=V9_SCALES[type]||1,scale=ourScale/baseScale;
 if(Math.abs(scale-1)>.001){for(let face of m.faces)for(let p of face.p){p[0]*=scale;p[1]*=scale;p[2]*=scale}for(let seg of m.segments){for(let p of [seg.a,seg.b])for(let k=0;k<3;k++)p[k]*=scale}}
 const size=ourScale, L=11*size, W=(type==='line'?3.4:2.8)*size, half=W/2, gunRows=(design?.batteries||[]).length, navalGold='#d5b77b',dark='#272e30';
 // Precisely modelled external ship furniture: weather deck, bulwark posts and continuous railings.
 for(let side of [-1,1]){
  const yy=side*half*.91;
  for(let j=-9;j<=9;j++){let x=j*L*.045, bow=Math.abs(x)/(L*.52), y=yy*(1-bow*.36);v8cylinder(m,[x,y,.42*size],[x,y,.91*size],.030*size,'#9a7048',5)}
  v8seg(m,[-L*.45,yy*.72,.87*size],[L*.45,yy*.72,.87*size],'#bb9661',2.5);
  // Gunports are independent dark openings with frames below their battery decks.
  let rows=design?.batteries||[{count:type==='line'?28:12,gun:'gun9'}];
  for(let deck=0;deck<rows.length;deck++){
   let count=Math.min(16,Math.floor((rows[deck].count||0)/2));
   for(let j=0;j<count;j++){let x=(-.37+(j+.5)*.74/count)*L, taper=1-.27*Math.pow(Math.abs(x)/(L*.52),2), y=yy*taper,z=(deck*.27-.28)*size;
    v8quad(m,[x-.115*size,y,z-.085*size],[x+.115*size,y,z-.085*size],[x+.115*size,y,z+.085*size],[x-.115*size,y,z+.085*size], '#151d20');
    v8seg(m,[x-.15*size,y,z+.12*size],[x+.15*size,y,z+.12*size],'#a98252',1);
   }
  }
  // Rope ladders, shrouds and running rigging, following the principal masts.
  const mastXs=type==='cutter'?[0]:type==='brig'?[-.19*L,.18*L]:[-.28*L,.01*L,.25*L];
  for(let x of mastXs){let zz=7*size;for(let dy of [-1,1])v8seg(m,[x,yy*.96,.28*size],[x+.25*size*dy,0,zz],'#544630',.90);for(let rung=0;rung<11;rung++){let z=.9*size+rung*.41*size,rr=Math.min(1,(z/zz));v8seg(m,[x,yy*(1-rr*.89),z],[x+.21*size,yy*(1-rr*.89),z],'#776444',.38)}}
 }
 // Stern gallery windows and ornamental transom with separate glazing and gold edging.
 const stern=-L*.48;
 for(let j=-3;j<=3;j++){let y=j*half*.20;v8cube(m,stern,y,.45*size,.12*size,.18*size,.32*size,'#293e44');v8seg(m,[stern-.085*size,y,.24*size],[stern-.085*size,y,.67*size],navalGold,.9)}
 v8seg(m,[stern-.15*size,-half*.58,.78*size],[stern-.15*size,half*.58,.78*size],navalGold,2);
 // Forecastle bowsprit fittings, anchors, capstan and stern lantern.
 for(let side of [-1,1]){let y=side*half*.72;v8cube(m,L*.20,y,.42*size,.43*size,.17*size,.12*size,'#9d7b4a');v8cylinder(m,[L*.34,y,.13*size],[L*.39,y,-.5*size],.10*size,dark,8)}
 v8cylinder(m,[-L*.19,0,.55*size],[-L*.19,0,1.12*size],.10*size,'#765234',10);
 for(let j=0;j<7;j++){let a=j*Math.PI*2/7;v8seg(m,[-L*.19,0,.80*size],[-L*.19+Math.cos(a)*.64*size,Math.sin(a)*.64*size,.8*size],'#b89963',1.6)}
 v8cube(m,stern,0,1.35*size,.35*size,.24*size,.52*size,'#9c7942');
 v8cube(m,stern,0,1.65*size,.24*size,.21*size,.15*size,'#e7d090');
 if(type==='xebec'){
  // Distinct Mediterranean lateen rig; yard spars angled fore-and-aft.
  for(let j=0;j<3;j++){let x=(-.26+j*.22)*L,h=(j===1?8.5:6.6)*size;
   v8seg(m,[x-2.1*size,0,h*.39],[x+2.3*size,0,h*1.15],'#a98557',3);
   v8tri(m,[x-2.1*size,-.12*size,h*.39],[x+2.3*size,-.12*size,h*1.15],[x+2.0*size,-.12*size,h*.20],'#c5baa0');
  }
 }
 if(type==='cutter'){
  // High-aspect rig and long gaff boom differentiating a fast customs cutter.
  v8seg(m,[-L*.1,0,7*size],[L*.45,0,9*size],'#b39364',2.5);
  v8tri(m,[-L*.1,.18*size,7*size],[L*.45,.18*size,9*size],[L*.42,.18*size,2*size],'#d9d2b8');
 }
 if(type==='brig')for(let x of [-L*.16,L*.20])for(let z of [5,7,9]){v8seg(m,[x,-half*.9,z*size],[x,half*.9,z*size],'#a78b58',1.4)}
 if(type==='line'){for(let j=0;j<8;j++){let x=(-.32+j*.09)*L;v8cube(m,x,-half*.76,.91*size,.10*size,.20*size,.15*size,'#c5a264');v8cube(m,x,half*.76,.91*size,.10*size,.20*size,.15*size,'#c5a264')}}
 return m;
};
const v9PriorCannon=v8cannon3d;
v8cannon3d=function(m,x,y,z,lb=12,side=1,scale=1){
 v9PriorCannon(m,x,y,z,lb,side,scale);
 const w=(.08+lb/900)*scale, sz=(.31+lb/63)*scale, length=(.34+.14*lb/12)*scale;
 // Reinforcing breech rings, trunnions, wheel hubs and the flared muzzle.
 v8cylinder(m,[x,y+side*length*.28,z+.05*scale],[x,y+side*length*.52,z+.05*scale],w*1.11,'#586066',9);
 v8cylinder(m,[x,y+side*length*.88,z+.05*scale],[x,y+side*(length*.88+.055*scale),z+.05*scale],w*1.35,'#555d61',10);
 for(let dx of [-1,1]){let xx=x+dx*sz*.33;v8cylinder(m,[xx,y-.16*scale,z-.12*scale],[xx,y+.02*scale,z-.12*scale],.18*scale,'#60462b',12);v8cylinder(m,[xx,y+.02*scale,z-.12*scale],[xx,y+.038*scale,z-.12*scale],.065*scale,'#bd9e64',9)}
 v8cylinder(m,[x,y-side*.08*scale,z+.035*scale],[x,y-side*.15*scale,z+.035*scale],w*.95,'#363e42',10);
};

 const design={batteries:hull.decks.map(d=>({gun:'gun4',count:Math.min(d.max,8)*2> d.max ? Math.floor(d.max/2)*2 : Math.min(8,d.max)}))};

/* Diplomacy on map right click, with actions directly linked to the original diplomatic model. */
let v9SelectedDiplomat=null;
function v9EnsureDiplomacy(){if(document.getElementById('v9-diplomacy'))return;
 let div=document.createElement('aside');div.id='v9-diplomacy';div.className='v9-diplomacy';div.setAttribute('aria-label','Дипломатические переговоры');document.body.append(div);
 document.addEventListener('contextmenu',e=>{const p=e.target.closest?.('#map [data-i]');if(!p)return;e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();if(!s)return;const id=Number(p.getAttribute('data-i'));if(!Number.isInteger(id)||!s.provinces[id])return;selected=id;v9SelectedDiplomat=s.provinces[id].owner;dipTarget=v9SelectedDiplomat;v9RenderDip();});
 document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape')v9CloseDip()});
 document.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{if(!e.target.closest?.('#v9-diplomacy')&&!e.target.closest?.('#map [data-i]'))v9CloseDip()});
}
function v9CloseDip(){const el=document.getElementById('v9-diplomacy');if(el)el.classList.remove('open');v9SelectedDiplomat=null}
function v9RenderDip(){const el=document.getElementById('v9-diplomacy');if(!el||!s||v9SelectedDiplomat===null)return;
 const f=s.player,t=v9SelectedDiplomat,c=F[t],relation=s.relations[f][t],war=withWar(f,t),allied=withAlliance(f,t),trading=withTrade(f,t),isOwn=f===t;
 const buttons=isOwn?`<p class="v9-dip-status">Это ваши владения. Управляйте ими через вкладки экономики и армии.</p>`:`<div class="v9-dip-actions">
 <button onclick="v9DipAct('improve')" ${s.action<1?'disabled':''}>Улучшить отношения <b>+25</b></button>
 <button onclick="v9DipAct('gift')" ${s.action<1?'disabled':''}>Послать дары <b>+35</b></button>
 <button onclick="v9DipAct('trade')" ${s.action<1?'disabled':''}>${trading?'Разорвать торговый договор':'Торговый договор'}</button>
 <button onclick="v9DipAct('alliance')" ${s.action<1?'disabled':''}>${allied?'Расторгнуть союз':'Предложить союз'}</button>
 <button onclick="v9DipAct('spy')" ${s.action<1?'disabled':''}>Организовать разведку</button>
 <button onclick="v9DipAct('peace')" ${!war?'disabled':''}>Предложить мир</button>
 <button class="danger" onclick="v9DipAct('war')" ${war||s.action<2?'disabled':''}>Объявить войну · 2 приказа</button>
 <button onclick="v9TradeWithCountry(${t})" ${war?'disabled':''}>Открыть торговую биржу →</button></div>`;
 el.innerHTML=`<div class="v9-dip-top"><div><small>КОРОЛЕВСКОЕ МИНИСТЕРСТВО ИНОСТРАННЫХ ДЕЛ</small><h2><i style="background:${c.color}"></i>${esc(c.name)}</h2></div><button onclick="v9CloseDip()">✕</button></div><div class="v9-dip-banner">${esc(c.style)} · ${esc(c.capital)}</div><div class="v9-dip-number"><div><small>Отношения</small><strong style="color:${relation>=0?'#9fd6b8':'#ec8e7e'}">${relation>0?'+':''}${relation}</strong></div><div><small>Статус</small><strong>${war?'Война':allied?'Союз':'Мир'}</strong></div><div><small>Торговля</small><strong>${trading?'Договор':'Без договора'}</strong></div></div><div class="v9-dip-status">Дипломатические приказы: ${s.action}/3. Владения на карте: ${regOf(t).length}. Военное истощение: ${Math.round(s.exhaustion[t]||0)}%.</div>${buttons}<div class="v9-dip-footer"><button onclick="tab='dip';dipTarget=${t};v9CloseDip();drawAll()">Полная дипломатическая канцелярия</button></div>`;
 el.classList.add('open');
}
function v9DipAct(action){if(v9SelectedDiplomat==null)return;dipTarget=v9SelectedDiplomat;dip(action);v9RenderDip()}
function v9TradeWithCountry(t){v9CloseDip();v9Seller=t;v8open('production','materials')}
/* Resource exchange with selected seller, trade treaties, recurring contracts and actual warehouse demand. */
let v9Seller=0,v9Resource='iron',v9Amount=25;
function v9state(){const v=v8get();v.v9 ||= {contracts:[],lastRun:-1};return v.v9}
function v9FindRoute(f,t){const myPorts=v8ownedPorts(f),theirPorts=v8ownedPorts(t);let sea=myPorts.length>0&&theirPorts.length>0;let a=N[CAP[f]]||N[0],b=N[CAP[t]]||N[1],km=Math.max(250,distKm(a,b));return {sea,km,days:Math.round((sea?11:6)+km/(sea?330:155))}}
function v9MarketQuote(t,k,qty){let f=s.player,base=V8_MATERIALS[k]?.price||1,r=s.relations[f][t],route=v9FindRoute(f,t),tariff=withTrade(f,t)?.92:1.13,risk=1+Math.max(0,-r)/220;
 return {total:Math.ceil(qty*base*tariff*risk*(1+Math.min(.18,route.km/30000))),days:route.days+Math.ceil(qty/35),route};}
function v9PlaceTrade(t,k,qty,contract=false){t=Number(t);qty=Math.round(Number(qty));if(!Number.isInteger(t)||t===s.player||!F[t]||!V8_MATERIALS[k]||!Number.isFinite(qty)||qty<1||qty>300)return say('Укажите страну, ресурс и объём до 300');
 if(withWar(s.player,t))return say('Торговля невозможна во время войны');if(s.relations[s.player][t]<-45)return say('Поставщик отказывается заключить договор из-за враждебных отношений');
 let reserve=Math.ceil(qty*.12);if(v8stock(t,k)<qty+reserve)return say(`Недостаточные запасы у державы ${F[t].name}: ${Math.floor(v8stock(t,k))} ед.`);
 let quote=v9MarketQuote(t,k,qty),v=v8get(),f=s.player;
 if(quote.route.sea&&v8convoyUsed(f)+qty>v8convoyCapacity(f))return say('Не хватает тоннажа торговых конвоев: постройте торговые суда или сократите закупку');
 if(s.gold[f]<quote.total)return say(`Требуется ${quote.total} монет, в казне ${Math.floor(s.gold[f])}`);
 v8changeStock(f,'gold',-quote.total);v8changeStock(t,'gold',quote.total);v8changeStock(t,k,-qty);
 v.imports.push({id:++v.id,f,seller:t,resource:k,qty,days:quote.days,total:quote.days,status:quote.route.sea?'sea':'road',cash:quote.total,risk:quote.route.sea?.07:0});
 log(`Торговый контракт: ${F[t].name} → ${F[f].name}, ${qty} ${V8_MATERIALS[k].unit} (${V8_MATERIALS[k].name.toLowerCase()}), ${quote.total} монет; ${quote.days} дней.`);
 if(!contract)v8Refresh(false);return true;
}
function v9Buy(){v9Seller=+document.getElementById('v9-market-seller')?.value;v9Resource=document.getElementById('v9-market-resource')?.value||'iron';v9Amount=+document.getElementById('v9-market-qty')?.value||25;v9PlaceTrade(v9Seller,v9Resource,v9Amount)}
function v9NewContract(){let seller=+document.getElementById('v9-market-seller')?.value,k=document.getElementById('v9-market-resource')?.value,qty=+document.getElementById('v9-market-qty')?.value;
 let minStock=+document.getElementById('v9-market-target')?.value;if(!V8_MATERIALS[k]||!F[seller]||seller===s.player||qty<1||minStock<0)return say('Неверные данные торгового договора');
 const c={id:++v8get().id,seller,resource:k,qty:Math.min(300,Math.round(qty)),target:Math.round(minStock||qty*2),frequency:30,nextTick:v9DayIndex()+30,enabled:true};v9state().contracts.push(c);log(`Открыт долгосрочный договор: ${F[seller].name}, ${V8_MATERIALS[k].name}, ежемесячно до ${c.target} ед.`);v8Refresh(false)}
function v9DayIndex(){return ((s.year-1700)*12+s.month-1)*31+s.day}
function v9ContractsDaily(){if(!s||!s.v8)return;let state=v9state(),now=v9DayIndex();if(state.lastRun===now)return;state.lastRun=now;
 for(let c of state.contracts){if(!c.enabled||now<c.nextTick)continue;c.nextTick=now+(c.frequency||30);let inTransit=s.v8.imports.filter(q=>q.f===s.player&&q.resource===c.resource).reduce((x,q)=>x+q.qty,0),need=c.target-v8stock(s.player,c.resource)-inTransit;if(need<=0)continue;v9PlaceTrade(c.seller,c.resource,Math.min(c.qty,Math.floor(need)),true)}
}
function v9ContractToggle(id){const c=v9state().contracts.find(x=>x.id===id);if(c)c.enabled=!c.enabled;v8Refresh(false)}
function v9ContractDelete(id){const st=v9state();st.contracts=st.contracts.filter(x=>x.id!==id);v8Refresh(false)}
function v9Needs(){let f=s.player,needs={};for(let k of Object.keys(V8_MATERIALS))needs[k]=0;
 for(let line of v8get().lines.filter(x=>x.f===f&&x.active&&x.factories>0)){let eq=V6_EQUIP[line.key];if(!eq)continue;let rate=line.factories*globalMod(f,'arsenalSpeed')*(.35+(line.eff||.15)*.65)/Math.max(.04,eq.work||1);let recipe=v8recipe(line.key,f);for(let [k,amount] of Object.entries(recipe))if(k in needs)needs[k]+=rate*amount}
 return needs;
}
function v9MarketUI(){if(!s)return '';let f=s.player,st=v9state(),t=(F[v9Seller]&&v9Seller!==f)?v9Seller:(f===0?1:0),res=V8_MATERIALS[v9Resource]?v9Resource:'iron',need=v9Needs();
 const sellers=F.map((x,i)=>i).filter(i=>i!==f&&!withWar(f,i)),quote=v9MarketQuote(t,res,v9Amount),stock=v8stock(t,res);
 return `<div class="v9-market"><div class="v9-market-head"><div><h3>Королевская торговая биржа</h3><p>Поставщик выбирается вручную. Договоры автоматически пополняют склады при падении запасов ниже целевого уровня.</p></div><span>Государственные контракты</span></div><div class="v9-market-grid"><label>Страна-поставщик<select id="v9-market-seller" onchange="v9Seller=+this.value;v8Refresh(false)">${sellers.map(i=>`<option value="${i}" ${t===i?'selected':''}>${esc(F[i].name)} · запас ${v8fmt(v8stock(i,res),0)}</option>`).join('')}</select></label><label>Сырьё<select id="v9-market-resource" onchange="v9Resource=this.value;v8Refresh(false)">${Object.entries(V8_MATERIALS).map(([k,r])=>`<option value="${k}" ${k===res?'selected':''}>${r.name}</option>`).join('')}</select></label><label>Объём<input type="number" id="v9-market-qty" min="1" max="300" value="${v9Amount}" oninput="v9Amount=Math.max(1,Math.min(300,+this.value||1));v9QuoteUpdate()"></label><label>Минимум на складе<input type="number" min="0" max="99999" id="v9-market-target" value="${Math.max(70,Math.ceil((need[res]||0)*60))}"></label></div><div id="v9-trade-quote" class="v9-trade-quote">${esc(F[t].name)} · запас ${v8fmt(stock)} · около ${quote.total} монет · ${quote.days} дней · ${quote.route.sea?'морской конвой':'сухопутный тракт'}${withTrade(f,t)?' · торговый договор: скидка 8%':''}</div><div class="v9-market-actions"><button class="main" onclick="v9Buy()">Закупить выбранный объём</button><button onclick="v9NewContract()">+ Ежемесячный договор</button><button onclick="v8open('production','logistics')">Карта снабжения</button></div><h4>Действующие торговые договоры</h4>${st.contracts.length?st.contracts.map(c=>`<div class="v9-contract"><span><b>${esc(F[c.seller]?.name||'Неизвестно')}</b> → ${V8_MATERIALS[c.resource]?.name||c.resource} · до <b>${c.target}</b> ед. на складе · до ${c.qty} ед. в месяц</span><button onclick="v9ContractToggle(${c.id})">${c.enabled?'Приостановить':'Возобновить'}</button><button onclick="v9ContractDelete(${c.id})">Удалить</button></div>`).join(''):'<div class="v9-empty">Пока нет регулярных закупок.</div>'}</div><div class="v9-market"><h3>Баланс сырья · заводские потребности</h3><table class="v9-resource-table"><thead><tr><th>Ресурс</th><th>Запас</th><th>Расход в день</th><th>Запас дней</th><th>Доступность</th></tr></thead><tbody>${Object.entries(V8_MATERIALS).map(([k,it])=>{let quantity=v8stock(f,k),rate=need[k]||0,days=rate?Math.floor(quantity/rate):null;return `<tr class="${days!==null&&days<15?'v9-shortage':''}"><td><b>${it.name}</b></td><td>${v8fmt(quantity,1)} ${it.unit}</td><td>${v8fmt(rate,2)}</td><td>${days===null?'—':`${days} дн.`}</td><td>${days===null?'Нет расхода':days<15?'Дефицит':days<45?'Низкий резерв':'Обеспечено'}</td></tr>`}).join('')}</tbody></table><p>Прогноз учитывает назначенные мануфактуры и скорость выпуска, но не будущие военные потери, заказы верфей и сезонный урожай.</p></div>`}
function v9QuoteUpdate(){const el=document.getElementById('v9-trade-quote');if(!el)return;let t=+document.getElementById('v9-market-seller')?.value,k=document.getElementById('v9-market-resource')?.value,q=+document.getElementById('v9-market-qty')?.value;let v=v9MarketQuote(t,k,q||1);el.textContent=`${F[t]?.name||''} · ${v.total} монет · ${v.days} дней · ${v.route.sea?'морской конвой':'сухопутный тракт'}`}

fresh=function(f=0){v9PriorFresh(f);v9state();v9EnsureDiplomacy();if($('save'))$('save').onclick=save;if($('load'))$('load').onclick=load};

/* Geological prospecting: choose where to expand extraction rather than buying blind. */
function v9ResourcePotential(i,k){let n=N[i],p=s.provinces[i],rock=['mountain','hills'].includes(n.terrain),steppe=n.terrain==='steppe',forest=n.terrain==='taiga',geo=v7geology(i);
 let score={iron:geo.iron*3,copper:geo.copper*4,steel:(rock?2:0)+(p.workshop||0),wood:forest?5:n.terrain==='hills'?3:1,coal:rock?4:1,saltpeter:rock?2:4,sulfur:rock?5:1,hemp:forest?1:steppe?2:4,flax:rock?1:forest?2:5,leather:steppe?5:3,horses:steppe?6:2,food:rock?2:5}[k]||0;
 if(n.port&&['hemp','wood','coal','iron'].includes(k))score+=1;
 return score;
}
function v9SourceDirectory(k){if(!V8_MATERIALS[k])return '';let own=[];for(let i=0;i<N.length;i++)if(s.provinces[i].owner===s.player){own.push({i,score:v9ResourcePotential(i,k)})}own.sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score);return `<div class="v9-source-table"><h4>Перспективные районы · ${V8_MATERIALS[k].name.toLowerCase()}</h4><div class="v9-sources">${own.slice(0,6).map(({i,score})=>`<button onclick="v9LocateProvince(${i})"><strong>${esc(N[i].name)}</strong><small>${esc(TERR[N[i].terrain]?.[0]||N[i].terrain)} · условный потенциал: ${score}/7</small></button>`).join('')}</div><p>Геологическая оценка является игровой реконструкцией, а не исторической геологической картой. Для железа и меди требуются рудники; для стали — кузница и топливо.</p></div>`}
function v9LocateProvince(i){if(!N[i]||s.provinces[i].owner!==s.player)return;v8close();selected=i;zoom=Math.max(zoom,22);panX=800-N[i].x*zoom;panY=540-N[i].y*zoom;clampPan();updateTransform();v6scaleLabel();tab='economy';drawAll();say('Выбран район '+N[i].name+' — откройте «Шахты и строительство»')}

const v9PriorSitesUI=v8sitesUI;
v8sitesUI=function(){let source=`<div class="v9-market"><h3>Где добывать ресурсы</h3><p>Выберите ресурс: система покажет доступные вам географические районы, перспективные для добычи, и даст перейти к выбранной провинции.</p><select id="v9-source-key" onchange="v9SourceChange()">${Object.entries(V8_MATERIALS).map(([k,o])=>`<option value="${k}">${o.name}</option>`).join('')}</select><div id="v9-source-content">${v9SourceDirectory('iron')}</div></div>`;return source+v9PriorSitesUI()};


/* Correct the legacy patrol-cancellation bug: the UI passes a fleet ID, not a sea-order ID. */
v8abortSea=function(fleetId){let orders=v8get().seaOrders,order=orders.find(o=>o.fleetId===fleetId&&o.f===s.player),fl=s.fleets.find(x=>x.id===fleetId);if(!order||!fl)return say('Нет текущего приказа этой эскадры');let reverseTo=order.from,reverseFrom=order.to,p=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,order.progress||0)),total=Math.max(2,order.total||2),remaining=Math.max(1,Math.round(p*total));
 order.from=reverseFrom;order.to=reverseTo;order.type='return';order.remaining=remaining;order.total=total;order.progress=1-remaining/total;fl.mission='returning';
 order.position={x:N[reverseFrom].x+(N[reverseTo].x-N[reverseFrom].x)*order.progress,y:N[reverseFrom].y+(N[reverseTo].y-N[reverseFrom].y)*order.progress};
 log(`${fl.name}: приказ об отмене похода принят, эскадра поворачивает к предыдущей гавани.`);v8Refresh(false);drawAll()};
/* Long-distance fleet logistics: voyages consume actual provisions; empty magazines can be refilled only in friendly harbours. */
function v9FleetSupplyInit(fl){if(fl.provisions===undefined)fl.provisions=75;if(fl.seaMorale===undefined)fl.seaMorale=90;if(fl.seaDays===undefined)fl.seaDays=0}
function v9FleetSupplyDaily(){if(!s)return;let active=v8get().seaOrders,ids=new Set(active.map(o=>o.fleetId));for(let fl of s.fleets){v9FleetSupplyInit(fl);if(!ids.has(fl.id))continue;let ships=v8shipsOf(fl);if(!ships.length)continue;let soldiers=(fl.embarked||[]).reduce((sum,x)=>sum+(x.count||0)*800,0),cost=.42+ships.length*.28+soldiers/15000;
 fl.provisions=Math.max(0,fl.provisions-cost);fl.seaDays++;
 if(fl.provisions<15){fl.seaMorale=Math.max(15,fl.seaMorale-(fl.provisions<=0?.28:.08));if(fl.provisions<=0){for(let ship of ships)ship.hp=Math.max(1,ship.hp-ship.maxHp*.0009);if(fl.f===s.player&&fl.seaDays%12===0)log(`${fl.name}: истощились запасы провианта. Требуется заход в собственный порт.`)}}else fl.seaMorale=Math.min(100,fl.seaMorale+.015)
 }}
function v9ReplenishFleet(id){let fl=s.fleets.find(x=>x.id===id&&x.f===s.player);if(!fl)return;v9FleetSupplyInit(fl);if(v8get().seaOrders.some(x=>x.fleetId===id))return say('Эскадра в море — пополнение возможно только после возвращения в собственный порт');if(!s.provinces[fl.port]||s.provinces[fl.port].owner!==fl.f||!N[fl.port].port)return say('Для снабжения необходим собственный действующий порт');
 let ships=v8shipsOf(fl),qFood=Math.ceil((100-fl.provisions)*.55+ships.length*.7),qPowder=Math.ceil(ships.reduce((a,sh)=>a+(100-(sh.ammo||0))*.014,0)),qGold=Math.ceil(ships.length*3+qFood*.35);
 if(s.food[fl.f]<qFood||s.gold[fl.f]<qGold||(s.equipment[fl.f].gunpowder||0)<qPowder)return say(`Требуется: провиант ${qFood}, порох ${qPowder}, деньги ${qGold}. Пополните национальный склад.`);
 s.food[fl.f]-=qFood;s.gold[fl.f]-=qGold;s.equipment[fl.f].gunpowder-=qPowder;fl.provisions=100;fl.seaMorale=Math.min(100,fl.seaMorale+15);
 for(let sh of ships)sh.ammo=100;log(`${fl.name}: погружены запасы провианта и боеприпасов. Списано ${qFood} провианта, ${qPowder} пороха, ${qGold} монет.`);v8Refresh(false);drawAll()}
const v9PriorFleetSpeed=v8fleetSpeed;
v8fleetSpeed=function(fl){v9FleetSupplyInit(fl);return v9PriorFleetSpeed(fl)*(fl.provisions<10?.78:fl.provisions<30?.9:1)*(fl.seaMorale<35?.90:1)};
const v9PriorOrderSea=v8orderSea;
v8orderSea=function(id,to,type='transfer'){const fl=s.fleets.find(x=>x.id===id);if(fl){v9FleetSupplyInit(fl);if(fl.f===s.player&&fl.provisions<7)return say('У эскадры слишком мало провианта для нового перехода — сначала пополните запасы в гавани')}return v9PriorOrderSea(id,to,type)};
const v9PriorFleetUI=v8fleetUI;
v8fleetUI=function(){let fleets=s.fleets.filter(x=>x.f===s.player);const h=`<div class="v9-market"><h3>Интендантство флота</h3><p>Эскадры в море расходуют провиант ежедневно. Дальние рейды без снабжения снижают мораль, скорость и состояние кораблей. Боекомплект пополняется отдельно на складе пороха.</p><div class="v9-sea-ledger">${fleets.map(fl=>{v9FleetSupplyInit(fl);let active=v8get().seaOrders.some(o=>o.fleetId===fl.id),qty=v8shipsOf(fl).length;return `<div><strong>${esc(fl.name)}</strong><span>Кораблей: ${qty} · ${active?'в море':'в порту'} · мореходных дней: ${fl.seaDays}</span><div class="v9-provision-line"><i style="width:${fl.provisions}%"></i></div><span>Провиант ${Math.floor(fl.provisions)}% · мораль ${Math.floor(fl.seaMorale)}%</span><button ${active?'disabled':''} onclick="v9ReplenishFleet(${fl.id})">Пополнить провиант и порох</button></div>`}).join('')}</div></div>`;return h+v9PriorFleetUI()};
const v9FleetAdvance=advanceDay;
advanceDay=function(){v9FleetAdvance();v9FleetSupplyDaily()};

/* Separate save slot IX. Older VIII saved campaigns can be opened as migration input, never overwritten. */
const V9_SAVE_KEY='empire_of_sails_v9_save';
save=function(){try{v9state();localStorage.setItem(V9_SAVE_KEY,JSON.stringify(s));say('Кампания IX сохранена')}catch(e){say('Локальное сохранение недоступно — используйте экспорт JSON')}};
load=function(){try{let raw=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(V9_SAVE_KEY)||localStorage.getItem(V8_SAVE_KEY)||'null');if(!raw)throw Error('Нет сохранения');restoreSave(raw);v9state();v9EnsureDiplomacy();say('Кампания загружена')}catch(e){say('Не удалось загрузить: '+e.message)}};
const v9PriorToolbar=v8initToolbar;
v8initToolbar=function(){v9PriorToolbar();let nav=document.getElementById('v8-global-nav');if(nav&&!document.getElementById('v9-nav-market')){const btn=document.createElement('button');btn.id='v9-nav-market';btn.className='v8-nav-btn';btn.textContent='Торговая биржа';btn.onclick=()=>v8open('production','materials');const stats=document.getElementById('v8-nav-stats');nav.insertBefore(btn,stats||null)}v9EnsureDiplomacy()};

/* EMPIRE OF SAILS X — visual command, provincial population, enriched 3-D mesh.
   All new mechanics are modeled in campaign state. This is an incremental upgrade to IX. */
const V10_SAVE_KEY='empire_of_sails_v10_save';
const V10_START_POP=[5.2,20.4,8.5,2.1,1.9,8.4,1.8,8.1,1.5,1.1,14.0,22.0,0.18,1.3,1.0,6.1,1.9,6.8,2.8,1.4];
const V10_MARKS={
 province:'M3 4h18v16H3z M7 7l4-2 3 4 4-2 M7 13l5 2 5-2',
 army:'M3 21l7-7 M14 10l7-7 M12 12l7 7 M5 3l14 14 M4 7l3-3 M17 20l3-3',
 fleet:'M12 2v18 M5 8l7-5 7 5 M4 15l8-3 8 3-3 6H7z',
 economy:'M4 7h16v13H4z M8 7V4h8v3 M7 12h10 M7 16h6',
 industry:'M3 20V9l6 4V9l6 4V5h6v15z M7 17h2 M12 17h2 M17 17h2',
 tech:'M9 3h6 M8 7h8 M7 11h10 M5 15h14 M9 19h6 M12 3v16',
 dip:'M3 6h18 M8 6v10 M16 6v10 M4 17h16 M7 21h10 M6 6l6-4 6 4',
 court:'M4 9l3 4 5-7 5 7 3-4-2 10H6z M4 20h16',
 help:'M12 3a9 9 0 1 0 0 18a9 9 0 1 0 0-18 M9.5 9a2.5 2.5 0 0 1 5 0c0 2-2.5 2-2.5 4 M12 17v.1',
 people:'M8 7a3 3 0 1 0 0-6 M16 7a3 3 0 1 0 0-6 M3 19v-5a5 5 0 0 1 10 0v5 M13 19v-5a5 5 0 0 1 8 0v5',
 supply:'M2 7h12v10H2z M14 11h4l4 4v2h-8z M6 20a2 2 0 1 0 0-4 M18 20a2 2 0 1 0 0-4',
 warehouse:'M3 20V9l9-6 9 6v11 M8 20v-9h8v9 M3 11h18',
 musket:'M3 19L20 3 M10 14l5 5 M6 18h4 M17 4l3 3',
 crown:'M3 9l4 4 5-8 5 8 4-4-2 10H5z',
 fort:'M4 20V6h4v3h3V6h3v3h3V6h3v14z',
 road:'M7 2h10L20 22H4z M12 4v4 M12 12v4 M12 19v2',
 sail:'M12 2v20 M12 3L3 17h9 M15 6l7 12h-7 M3 21h19',
 coin:'M12 2a10 10 0 1 0 0 20a10 10 0 1 0 0-20 M15 8H10a2 2 0 0 0 0 4h4a2 2 0 0 1 0 4H9 M12 5v14'
};
function v10icon(id,sz=18){return `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="${sz}" height="${sz}" class="v10-icon" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.65" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="${V10_MARKS[id]||V10_MARKS.province}"/></svg>`}
function v10n(n){return Math.max(0,Math.round(n||0)).toLocaleString('ru-RU')}
function v10fmtPop(n){return n>=1e6?+(n/1e6).toFixed(2)+' млн':n>=1e3?+(n/1e3).toFixed(1)+' тыс.':v10n(n)}
function v10pc(n){return Math.max(0,Math.min(100,Number(n)||0))}
function v10bar(label,value,color='#bfa473',text=null){return `<div class="v10-barrow"><span>${label}</span><div class="v10-bar"><i style="width:${v10pc(value)}%;background:${color}"></i></div><b>${text===null?Math.round(value)+'%':text}</b></div>`}
function v10initDemography(){if(!s)return;if(s.demography&&s.demography.population?.length===N.length&&s.demography.manpower?.length===N.length)return;
 const sums=F.map((_,f)=>N.reduce((a,n,i)=>a+((s.provinces[i].owner===f)?Math.max(.001,n.pop||.02):0),0));
 const d={version:10,population:[],manpower:[],bornTotal:0,conscripted:0,monthlyDelta:0,lastPeriod:'',snapshot:[]};
 for(let i=0;i<N.length;i++){let f=s.provinces[i].owner;let share=Math.max(.001,N[i].pop||.02)/Math.max(1,sums[f]);let p=Math.max(55,Math.round((V10_START_POP[f]||2)*1e6*share));d.population.push(p);d.manpower.push(Math.round(p*.055))}
 d.snapshot=F.map((_,f)=>v10NationalPop(f,d));s.demography=d;
}
function v10NationalPop(f,d=s.demography){if(!d?.population)return 0;let pop=0;for(let i=0;i<N.length;i++)if(s.provinces[i].owner===f)pop+=d.population[i]||0;return pop}
function v10Manpower(f=s.player){v10initDemography();let total=0;for(let i=0;i<N.length;i++)if(s.provinces[i].owner===f)total+=s.demography.manpower[i]||0;return Math.round(total)}
function v10PopulationMonth(){v10initDemography();let d=s.demography,f=s.player,old=d.snapshot?.[f]||v10NationalPop(f),national=F.map((_,k)=>v10NationalPop(k,d)),changes=0;
 for(let i=0;i<N.length;i++){let p=d.population[i];if(!p)continue;let o=s.provinces[i],owner=o.owner,rate=.00078,unrest=o.unrest||0;if(unrest>60)rate-=.00055;if(s.food[owner]<Math.max(1,national[owner]/1e6*.6))rate-=.00115;if(s.wars.some(w=>w.split(':').includes(String(owner))))rate-=.00016;
  let delta=Math.round(p*rate);d.population[i]=Math.max(40,p+delta);d.manpower[i]=Math.min(Math.round(d.population[i]*.075),Math.max(0,(d.manpower[i]||0)+Math.max(0,Math.round(p*.00016))));if(owner===f)changes+=delta}
 let pop=v10NationalPop(f);d.monthlyDelta=pop-old;d.snapshot=F.map((_,k)=>v10NationalPop(k,d));d.lastPeriod=`${s.month}/${s.year}`;
 // Civilian mouths consume food every month; hungry states face demographic losses above.
 for(let k=0;k<F.length;k++){let popk=d.snapshot[k]||0;s.food[k]=Math.max(0,(s.food[k]||0)-popk/1e6*.27);s.gold[k]+=(popk/1e6)*.045*(s.stability[k]/100)}
}
const v10PrevFresh=fresh;
fresh=function(f=0){v10PrevFresh(f);v10initDemography();v10ApplyChrome();drawAll()};
const v10PrevRestore=restoreSave;
restoreSave=function(data){v10PrevRestore(data);v10initDemography();v10ApplyChrome()};
const v10PrevAdvance=advanceDay;
advanceDay=function(){v10PrevAdvance();if(s.day===1&&s.demography?.lastPeriod!==`${s.month}/${s.year}`)v10PopulationMonth()};
const v10PrevRecruit=recruit;
recruit=function(k){if(!REGIMENTS[k])return v10PrevRecruit(k);v10initDemography();const f=s.player,prov=selected,need=REGIMENTS[k].type==='Кавалерия'?550:REGIMENTS[k].type==='Артиллерия'?180:800;
 if(s.demography.manpower[prov]<need)return say(`В ${N[prov].name} не хватает рекрутов: доступно ${v10n(s.demography.manpower[prov])}, требуется ${need}.`);
 const old=s.production.length;v10PrevRecruit(k);if(s.production.length>old&&s.production.some(q=>q.province===prov&&q.key===k&&q.f===f)){s.demography.manpower[prov]-=need;s.demography.conscripted+=need;drawAll()}
};
// Per-province rather than national-only manpower; war and recruitment actually change this ledger.
const v10PrevResourceBar=resourceBar;
resourceBar=function(){v10PrevResourceBar();if(!s)return;v10initDemography();let el=document.getElementById('resources');if(!el)return;let pop=v10NationalPop(s.player),man=v10Manpower();let item=document.createElement('div');item.className='resource v10-poptop';item.innerHTML=`${v10icon('people',19)}<b>${v10fmtPop(pop)}</b><span>Население</span><small>${v10fmtPop(man)} рекрутов</small>`;el.insertBefore(item,el.firstChild)};
const v10PrevRealm=realmPanel;
realmPanel=function(){v10PrevRealm();v10initDemography();const o=document.getElementById('countryoverview');if(!o)return;let p=v10NationalPop(s.player),m=v10Manpower();o.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin',`<div class="v10-census-card"><div class="v10-census-icon">${v10icon('people',27)}</div><div><small>НАСЕЛЕНИЕ КОРОНЫ</small><strong>${v10fmtPop(p)}</strong><span>Военнообязанный резерв ${v10fmtPop(m)}</span></div></div>`)};
const v10PrevTabProvince=tabProvince;
tabProvince=function(){let h=v10PrevTabProvince();v10initDemography();let p=s.provinces[selected],pop=s.demography.population[selected]||0,army=armies(p),growth=pop>0?.078:0;return `<div class="v10-provinceboard"><div class="v10-province-stat">${v10icon('people',23)}<small>Жители</small><b>${v10fmtPop(pop)}</b></div><div class="v10-province-stat">${v10icon('army',23)}<small>Рекрутский резерв</small><b>${v10fmtPop(s.demography.manpower[selected])}</b></div><div class="v10-province-stat">${v10icon('supply',23)}<small>Снабжение</small><b>${Math.round(v8supplyOf(selected))}%</b></div></div>${h}`};
const v10PrevTabArmy=tabArmy;
tabArmy=function(){let h=v10PrevTabArmy(),p=s.provinces[selected];let counts=UNITKEYS.filter(k=>countUnit(p,k)>0),rows=counts.slice(0,6).map(k=>{let n=countUnit(p,k),u=REGIMENTS[k],cat=u.type==='Артиллерия'?'fort':u.type==='Кавалерия'?'sail':'musket';return `<div class="v10-reg-icon" title="${esc(u.label)}: ${n}">${v10icon(cat,27)}<b>${n}</b><small>${esc(u.label)}</small></div>`}).join('');let supply=v8supplyOf(selected),morale=p.morale||75;
 return `<div class="v10-armydeck"><div class="v10-deckhead">${v10icon('army',23)}<b>ШТАБ • ${esc(N[selected].name)}</b><button onclick="v8Open3DBattle('land')">3D манёвры ↗</button></div><div class="v10-trooptiles">${rows||'<span>В регионе нет регулярных полков</span>'}</div>${v10bar('Боевой дух',morale,'#b4c38c')}${v10bar('Обеспечение',supply,supply>45?'#77b6a6':'#d89166')}${v10bar('Резерв людей',Math.min(100,s.demography.manpower[selected]/2500), '#d5ad6e',v10fmtPop(s.demography.manpower[selected]))}</div>${h}`;
};
function v10shipPicture(sh){let key=V6_HULLS[sh.type]?.art||'ship';let a=V6_ART[key]||V6_ART.ship;return `<img src="${a}" loading="lazy" alt="${esc(sh.name)}">`}
function v10FleetDeck(){let sh=s.ships.filter(x=>x.f===s.player).slice(0,9),fl=s.fleets.filter(x=>x.f===s.player);return `<section class="v10-admiralty"><header>${v10icon('fleet',22)} <b>КОРАБЛИ И ЭСКАДРЫ</b><small>Нажмите на корабль — откроется 3D-модель</small></header><div class="v10-ships">${sh.map(x=>{let hp=Math.round(100*(x.hp||0)/Math.max(1,x.maxHp||100)),d=x.design?.batteries||[],guns=d.reduce((a,b)=>a+(b.count||0),0),f=fl.find(z=>z.shipIds?.includes(x.id))||null;return `<button class="v10-shipcard" onclick="v8ShowModel(${x.id})">${v10shipPicture(x)}<b>${esc(x.name)}</b><span>${guns} орудий · ${x.crew||0} чел.</span><div class="v10-bar"><i style="width:${v10pc(hp)}%;background:${hp<50?'#bc6f55':'#8cae9c'}"></i></div><small>${f?esc(f.name):'Корабль в резерве'} · корпус ${hp}%</small></button>`}).join('')||'<div>Нет собственных кораблей</div>'}</div></section>`}
const v10PrevFleetUI=v8fleetUI;
v8fleetUI=function(){return v10FleetDeck()+v10PrevFleetUI()};
const v10PrevFactoryUI=v8factoryUI;
v8factoryUI=function(){let v=v8get(),f=s.player,capacity=v8factoryLimit(f),used=v8factoryAssigned(f),lines=v.lines.filter(x=>x.f===f&&x.active!==false);let channels=lines.slice(0,7).map(x=>{let e=V6_EQUIP[x.key];let art=e?.art|| (x.key.startsWith('gun')?'cannon':'musket');let img=V6_ART[art]||V6_ART.industry;return `<div class="v10-factorytile"><img src="${img}" loading="lazy"><div><b>${esc(e?.name||e?.label||x.key)}</b><small>${x.factories} мастерских · эффективность ${Math.round((x.eff||0)*100)}%</small>${v10bar('',(x.eff||0)*100,'#9aaf90','')}</div></div>`}).join('');return `<div class="v10-factory-header"><div class="v10-factory-banner">${v10icon('industry',30)}<b>ПРОМЫШЛЕННЫЙ ШТАБ</b><span>Занято ${used} из ${capacity} мануфактур</span>${v10bar('Мощности',100*used/Math.max(1,capacity),'#d1a964',used+' / '+capacity)}</div><div class="v10-factorytilerow">${channels||'<span class="muted">Назначьте мануфактуры на выпуск оборудования</span>'}</div></div>`+v10PrevFactoryUI()};
const v10PrevSupplyUI=v8supplyUI;
v8supplyUI=function(){let val=Math.round(v8supplyOf(selected));return `<div class="v10-logistics"><b>${v10icon('warehouse',22)} СЕТЬ СНАБЖЕНИЯ</b><div class="v10-flow"><span>${v10icon('warehouse',26)}<small>Склады</small></span><i></i><span>${v10icon('road',26)}<small>Дороги</small></span><i></i><span>${v10icon('supply',26)}<small>Обозы</small></span><i></i><span>${v10icon('army',26)}<small>Армия</small></span></div>${v10bar('Доступность в регионе',val,val<45?'#d38866':'#8eab91')}</div>`+v10PrevSupplyUI()};
const v10PrevResUI=v8resourcesUI;
v8resourcesUI=function(){let keys=['iron','steel','copper','wood','coal','saltpeter','sulfur','hemp','flax','leather','horses','food'];let tiles=keys.map(k=>{let obj=V8_MATERIALS[k]||{name:k,tint:'#aa946b'},q=v8stock(s.player,k),clr=obj.tint||'#ad9774',pct=Math.min(100,Math.max(2,100*q/(q+90)));return `<div class="v10-res-tile" title="${obj.name}: ${v8fmt(q)}"><span style="border-color:${clr};color:${clr}">${v10icon(['hemp','flax','wood'].includes(k)?'sail':['coal','iron','steel','copper'].includes(k)?'industry':['food','horses'].includes(k)?'people':'warehouse',20)}</span><b>${esc(obj.name)}</b><strong>${v8fmt(q,0)}</strong><div class="v10-bar"><i style="width:${pct}%;background:${clr}"></i></div></div>`}).join('');return `<div class="v10-resource-galley">${tiles}</div>`+v10PrevResUI()};
// Helpful national dashboard: high-level economics + demographics, minimal descriptions.
const v10PrevTabEconomy=tabEconomy;
tabEconomy=function(){v10initDemography();let f=s.player,p=v10NationalPop(f),m=v10Manpower(),change=s.demography.monthlyDelta||0;return `<div class="v10-econhead"><div>${v10icon('people',26)}<small>НАСЕЛЕНИЕ</small><b>${v10fmtPop(p)}</b></div><div>${v10icon('army',26)}<small>РЕКРУТЫ</small><b>${v10fmtPop(m)}</b></div><div>${v10icon('crown',26)}<small>СТАБИЛЬНОСТЬ</small><b>${s.stability[f]}%</b></div><div>${v10icon('coin',26)}<small>КАЗНА</small><b>${v8fmt(s.gold[f],0)}</b></div></div><div class="v10-econdelta">Прирост жителей за последний месяц: <b style="color:${change>=0?'#9ac29a':'#d18e7e'}">${change>=0?'+':''}${v10n(change)}</b> • Фермы и продовольственные склады обеспечивают рост населения.</div>${v10PrevTabEconomy()}`};
// Make top navigation pictorial, preserving original buttons, handlers and keyboard focus.
function v10ApplyChrome(){const tabs=document.getElementById('tabs');if(tabs)for(let btn of tabs.querySelectorAll('button[data-tab]')){let id=btn.dataset.tab;if(btn.dataset.v10icon)continue;btn.dataset.v10icon='yes';const span=document.createElement('span');span.className='v10-tabglyph';span.innerHTML=v10icon(id,19);btn.prepend(span)};let logo=document.querySelector('.brand small');if(logo)logo.textContent='КОРОНЫ • МАНУФАКТУРЫ • ФЛОТ • КАРТА ЕВРОПЫ'}
const v10PrevTabPanel=tabPanel;
tabPanel=function(){v10PrevTabPanel();v10ApplyChrome();if(tab==='fleet'&&document.getElementById('tabcontent')){let content=document.getElementById('tabcontent');content.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin',`<div class="v10-quickfleet"><button onclick="v8open('fleet')">${v10icon('fleet',18)} Адмиралтейство</button><button onclick="v8open('models')">${v10icon('sail',18)} 3D-верфь</button><button onclick="v8Open3DBattle('sea')">${v10icon('fort',18)} Морской бой</button></div>`)}};
// Extra silhouettes and historically recognizable deck features on cached procedural meshes.
const v10PreviousMesh=v8meshFor;
v8meshFor=function(entity){let m=v10PreviousMesh(entity);if(m.v10detailed)return m;m.v10detailed=true;
 if(entity.kind==='ship'){
  let t=entity.type||'frigate',scale=V9_SCALES[t]||1,L=11*scale,beam=(t==='line'?3.4:2.8)*scale/2,master=t==='line'?3:t==='cutter'?1:t==='brig'?2:3;
  if(t==='xebec'||t==='cutter')m.faces=m.faces.filter(f=>!['#e6d5b2','#f1e3c8'].includes(f.color));
  // Distinct deck details: quarterdeck stairs, gun carriages, lifelines and copper strakes.
  for(let side of [-1,1]){
   for(let q of [-.42,-.18,.10,.32])v8seg(m,[L*q,side*beam*.88,.16*scale],[L*(q+.06),side*beam*.88,.31*scale],'#c1a071',.8);
   for(let deck=0;deck<(t==='line'?3:t==='frigate'||t==='corvette'?2:1);deck++){
    for(let j=0;j<13;j++){let x=(-.40+j*.066)*L;let y=side*beam*(.54+(1-Math.abs(x)/(L*.55))*.17),z=-.56*scale+deck*.27*scale;v8seg(m,[x,y,z],[x+L*.042,y,z],'#a78559',.55)}
   }
   v8seg(m,[-L*.49,side*beam*.54,-1.07*scale],[L*.43,side*beam*.52,-.85*scale],'#91704b',1.6);
   // Standing rigging and visible ratlines.
   for(let k=0;k<master;k++){let x=master===1?0:((-master+1)/2+k)*L*.23,top=(k===1?9:7.4)*scale;
    for(let j=0;j<9;j++){let z=(1.0+j*.59)*scale;if(z>top*.84)break;let yy=side*beam*(.89-.73*(z/top));v8seg(m,[x-.21*scale,yy,z],[x+.21*scale,yy,z],'#847052',.52)}
    v8seg(m,[x-.30*scale,side*beam*.77,.38*scale],[x,0,top],'#6e5942',.68);v8seg(m,[x+.30*scale,side*beam*.77,.38*scale],[x,0,top],'#6e5942',.68);
   }
  }
  // Complex masts and masthead flags vary by ship type.
  let mastXs=master===1?[0]:master===2?[-L*.16,L*.20]:[-L*.26,0,L*.23];
  mastXs.forEach((x,i)=>{let tall=(i===1?10.5:8.4)*scale;v8cylinder(m,[x,0,tall*.71],[x,0,tall*1.09],.04*scale,'#93744c',7);v8seg(m,[x,-beam*.87,tall*.24],[x,-beam*.87,tall*.60],'#6b5538',.7);
   for(let k=0;k<2;k++){let z=tall*(.63+k*.18),width=scale*(k?1.9:2.7);v8seg(m,[x,-width,z],[x,width,z],'#a58252',2.6)}
   for(let y of [-1,1])v8seg(m,[x,0,tall],[x+scale*.34,beam*y*.9,.27*scale],'#877054',.8);
  });
  // Curved stern gallery and decorative rails, not an identical flat rectangle.
  for(let k=-4;k<=4;k++){let y=k*beam*.135,x=-L*.48-.18*scale*(1-(y/beam)**2);v8cube(m,x,y,.60*scale,.14*scale,.095*scale,.31*scale,k%2?'#a88a59':'#31454c')}
  if(t==='line'){for(let side of [-1,1])for(let i=-3;i<=3;i++)v8cube(m,L*.23+i*L*.05,side*beam*.80,.96*scale,.18*scale,.10*scale,.28*scale,'#b49a65')}
  if(t==='brig'||t==='cutter'){for(let x of mastXs){v8seg(m,[x,0,6*scale],[x+L*.25,0,7.6*scale],'#b2976a',2);v8tri(m,[x,.08*scale,6.15*scale],[x+L*.25,.08*scale,7.6*scale],[x+L*.22,.08*scale,3.3*scale],'#e4d5b8')}}
  if(t==='xebec'){for(let x of mastXs){v8tri(m,[x-2.15*scale,.24*scale,3.45*scale],[x+2.15*scale,.24*scale,9.25*scale],[x+1.72*scale,.24*scale,3.05*scale],'#e5d5bb')}}
  // Hull ornaments and anchor cables.
  for(let side of [-1,1]){v8cylinder(m,[L*.36,side*beam*.73,.19*scale],[L*.38,side*beam*.76,-.30*scale],.074*scale,'#272c2d',9);v8seg(m,[L*.36,side*beam*.74,.10*scale],[L*.17,side*beam*.72,.39*scale],'#ad9272',1)}
 }else if(entity.kind==='gun'){
  let c=entity.lb||12,r=Math.max(.10,.16+c*.003);v8cube(m,-1.15,-.20,.37,1.2,.73,.15,'#835b37');for(let k=-1;k<=1;k++)v8seg(m,[-1.55+k*.23,-.35,.68],[-1.55+k*.23,.35,.68],'#aa8252',1.6);v8cylinder(m,[-1.1,0,.58],[-1.1,0,1.05],r*.37,'#b7a17a',8)
 }else if(entity.kind==='inf'||entity.kind==='cav'){for(let k=-5;k<=5;k++)v8seg(m,[k*.57,-.9,.05],[k*.57,-.9,.13],'#8c764c',.6)}
 return m;
};
const v10PrevSoldier=v8soldier;
v8soldier=function(m,x,y,z,kind='inf',coat='#a8463a',motion=0){v10PrevSoldier(m,x,y,z,kind,coat,motion);let mounted=kind==='cav',rise=mounted?.78:0;let Z=z+rise;
 v8cube(m,x-.14,y+.05,Z+.50,.22,.19,.20,'#a88c58'); // cartridge box
 v8seg(m,[x-.15,y+.05,Z+.61],[x+.15,y-.12,Z+.38],'#d1c1a1',1.2); // crossbelt
 v8cylinder(m,[x-.10,y-.13,Z+.63],[x+.74,y-.13,Z+.67],.028,'#5a4935',6); // firearm
 v8seg(m,[x+.74,y-.13,Z+.67],[x+1.00,y-.13,Z+.78],'#afb2ae',.95); // bayonet
 if(mounted){v8seg(m,[x+.38,y,Z+.41],[x+.65,y,Z+.10],'#3d2e23',1);v8cube(m,x,y,Z+.99,.27,.24,.08,'#ad996f')}
};
// Cap resolution of canvas at reasonable DPR, preserving crispness without expensive full-window redraw at 4K.
const v10OldStartScene=v8startScene;
v8startScene=function(sc){v10OldStartScene(sc);let c=V8_CANVAS;if(!c)return;let ratio=Math.min(1,1500/Math.max(1,c.width),920/Math.max(1,c.height));if(ratio<1){c.width=Math.round(c.width*ratio);c.height=Math.round(c.height*ratio)}};
const v10OldSave=save;
save=function(){try{v10initDemography();localStorage.setItem(V10_SAVE_KEY,JSON.stringify(s));say('Кампания X сохранена')}catch(e){say('Сохранение недоступно — экспортируйте JSON')}};
const v10OldLoad=load;
load=function(){try{let raw=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(V10_SAVE_KEY)||localStorage.getItem(V9_SAVE_KEY)||'null');if(!raw)throw Error('Нет сохранения');restoreSave(raw);v10initDemography();drawAll();say('Кампания X загружена')}catch(e){say('Ошибка загрузки: '+e.message)}};
const v10OldSaveQuiet=saveQuiet;
saveQuiet=function(){try{if(s){v10initDemography();localStorage.setItem(V10_SAVE_KEY,JSON.stringify(s))}}catch(e){}};
/* X · Final visual polish and battle command tiles. */
function v10ArmyGlance(){let p=s.provinces[selected],q=v8supplyOf(selected),morale=p.morale||75,pop=s.demography?.population?.[selected]||0,types=UNITKEYS.filter(k=>countUnit(p,k)>0).slice(0,5);return `<section class="v10-armydeck" aria-label="Военная сводка"><div class="v10-deckhead">${v10icon('army',23)}<b>ОПЕРАТИВНЫЙ ШТАБ</b><button onclick="v8Open3DBattle('land')">3D-сражение ↗</button></div><div class="v10-trooptiles">${types.map(k=>`<div class="v10-reg-icon">${v10icon(REGIMENTS[k].type==='Кавалерия'?'sail':REGIMENTS[k].type==='Артиллерия'?'fort':'musket',26)}<b>${countUnit(p,k)}</b><small>${esc(REGIMENTS[k].label)}</small></div>`).join('')||'<div class="v10-reg-icon">Гарнизон отсутствует</div>'}</div>${v10bar('Мораль полков',morale,'#9cb59b')}${v10bar('Обеспечение',q,q>40?'#88ada0':'#d38d65')}${v10bar('Рекрутский резерв',100*(s.demography?.manpower?.[selected]||0)/Math.max(1000,pop*.055),'#d6b577',v10fmtPop(s.demography?.manpower?.[selected]||0))}</section>`}
const v10OldPanel2=tabPanel;
tabPanel=function(){v10OldPanel2();if(tab==='army'){let pane=document.getElementById('tabcontent');if(pane&&!pane.querySelector('.v10-armydeck'))pane.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin',v10ArmyGlance())}};
const v10OldOpenBattle=v8Open3DBattle;
v8Open3DBattle=function(kind='sea',campaign=false,context=null){v10OldOpenBattle(kind,campaign,context);if(!V8_SCENE)return;let box=document.getElementById('v8-unit-strip');if(box){for(let btn of box.querySelectorAll('button[data-unit]')){let unit=V8_SCENE.units.find(u=>u.id===Number(btn.dataset.unit));if(!unit)continue;let art=unit.kind==='ship'?V6_ART[V6_HULLS[unit.type]?.art||'ship']:V6_ART[unit.kind==='cav'?'cavalry':unit.kind==='art'?'cannon':'infantry'];let text=esc(unit.name||'Отряд');btn.classList.add('v10-unit-tile');btn.innerHTML=`<img src="${art}" alt=""><span><b>${text}</b><small>${unit.kind==='ship'?'Корабль':unit.kind==='cav'?'Конница':unit.kind==='art'?'Батарея':'Пехота'}</small><i class="v10-unit-health"><i style="width:100%"></i></i></span>`}}
 const bar=document.querySelector('#v8-stage .v8-3d-controls');if(bar){bar.classList.add('v10-commandstrip');let names=kind==='sea'?[['pause','Пауза','help'],['fire','Залп','fort'],['left','Влево','sail'],['right','Вправо','sail'],['sail','Паруса','sail'],['camera','Камера','province']]:[['pause','Пауза','help'],['fire','Огонь','musket'],['left','Влево','road'],['right','Вправо','road'],['formation','Строй','army'],['advance','Атака','army'],['retreat','Отход','supply'],['camera','Камера','province']];bar.querySelectorAll('button').forEach((b,i)=>{let [cmd,title,ic]=names[i]||['','','province'];if(!title)return;b.setAttribute('title',title);b.innerHTML=`${v10icon(ic,19)}<small>${title}</small>`})}
};
let v10LastBattleUi=0;
const v10OldSceneStep=v8sceneStep;
v8sceneStep=function(dt){v10OldSceneStep(dt);if(!V8_SCENE||!v8Battle||!document.getElementById('v8-unit-strip'))return;let now=Date.now();if(now-v10LastBattleUi<440)return;v10LastBattleUi=now;for(let b of document.querySelectorAll('#v8-unit-strip button[data-unit]')){let u=V8_SCENE.units.find(x=>x.id===Number(b.dataset.unit));let p=b.querySelector('.v10-unit-health>i');if(u&&p)p.style.width=v10pc(100*(u.hp||0)/Math.max(1,u.maxHp||100))+'%'}};


/* XIV · hard visual overhaul */
function v14svgData(s){return 'data:image/svg+xml;charset=UTF-8,'+encodeURIComponent(s)}
function v14portrait(name,role,bg='#20384b',coat='#6a4b35',trim='#d2ae71'){
 const initials=(name||'?').split(/\s+/).slice(0,2).map(x=>x[0]||'').join('').toUpperCase();
 return v14svgData(`<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 220 280"><defs><linearGradient id="bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="${bg}"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#121b22"/></linearGradient><linearGradient id="coat" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="${coat}"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#3f2d20"/></linearGradient><radialGradient id="skin" cx=".45" cy=".3" r=".8"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#f0d7b5"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#c29a73"/></radialGradient></defs><rect width="220" height="280" fill="url(#bg)"/><rect x="8" y="8" width="204" height="264" rx="10" fill="none" stroke="${trim}" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M54 265c8-48 28-78 56-78 30 0 51 24 60 78" fill="url(#coat)" stroke="#d5b57c" stroke-width="1.6"/><path d="M72 208c10 10 23 16 38 16 14 0 27-6 38-16l4 58H68z" fill="#efe5d1"/><circle cx="110" cy="103" r="49" fill="url(#skin)"/><path d="M66 114c0-43 18-66 49-73 35-8 63 11 73 52-9-9-18-12-31-13-7 19-24 27-50 27-13 0-25 3-41 7z" fill="#d7d7d9"/><circle cx="93" cy="110" r="4" fill="#2b2b2b"/><circle cx="129" cy="110" r="4" fill="#2b2b2b"/><path d="M103 118c-4 8-4 15-2 20" stroke="#9b7054" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/><path d="M95 149c10 5 19 5 30 0" stroke="#7d4638" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/><rect x="16" y="218" width="188" height="38" rx="7" fill="#0e151c" opacity=".86"/><text x="110" y="235" text-anchor="middle" fill="#f3e7ca" font-size="16" font-family="Georgia">${(name||'').replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;')}</text><text x="110" y="249" text-anchor="middle" fill="#ccb791" font-size="11" font-family="Georgia">${(role||'').replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;')}</text><circle cx="34" cy="35" r="15" fill="#0f1820" stroke="${trim}"/><text x="34" y="40" text-anchor="middle" fill="#f4e8ca" font-size="13" font-family="Georgia">${initials}</text></svg>`)
}
function v14flag(f){const c=F[f]?.color||'#666'; const nm=F[f]?.name||''; const initials=nm.split(/\s+/).slice(0,2).map(x=>x[0]||'').join('').toUpperCase(); return v14svgData(`<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 88 56"><defs><linearGradient id="g" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#ffffff"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="${c}"/></linearGradient></defs><rect x="1" y="1" width="86" height="54" rx="5" fill="url(#g)" stroke="#d3b074" stroke-width="2"/><rect x="1" y="1" width="86" height="14" fill="#132130" opacity=".45"/><text x="44" y="36" text-anchor="middle" fill="#fff4d9" font-size="21" font-family="Georgia">${initials}</text></svg>`)}
if(typeof ADVISERS!=='undefined'){ADVISERS.forEach((a,i)=>a.v14portrait=v14portrait(a.name,a.role,['#22384a','#3e2f44','#1f3e3a','#40362a','#2d3847'][i%5],['#6e4e36','#5d4b6d','#5b6240','#6a4f3f','#4c5c73'][i%5]))}
if(typeof NATIONAL!=='undefined'){NATIONAL.forEach((n,i)=>n.v14portrait=v14portrait(n.ruler,n.title,['#243f56','#4a3540','#2f4a3a','#454030','#384355'][i%5],['#6b4d35','#67495c','#556742','#786049','#596d82'][i%5]))}
function v14ApplyTheme(){if(document.getElementById('v14-style'))return; const st=document.createElement('style'); st.id='v14-style'; st.textContent=`
 body{background:radial-gradient(circle at 20% -10%,#234660 0,transparent 25%),linear-gradient(180deg,#071018,#0b151d 30%,#081119 100%)!important;color:#f0e7d2}
 .top{padding:6px 16px 10px!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#112130,#09131a 46%,#081117 100%)!important;border-bottom:1px solid #8b6a39!important;box-shadow:0 10px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.36)!important}
 .brand h1{font:700 34px/1 Georgia,serif!important;color:#ecd59c!important;letter-spacing:.5px}.brand small{font-size:10px!important;letter-spacing:3px!important;color:#c3ced1!important}
 .turn{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#1a2f3f,#10202b)!important;border:1px solid #66553a!important;border-radius:6px!important;color:#f0d9a4!important;font:700 16px Georgia,serif!important;padding:12px 20px!important}
 .speed button,.topactions button{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#203646,#12202a)!important;border:1px solid #596a73!important;border-radius:4px!important;color:#ecdfc5!important;min-height:38px!important}.topactions button.main{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#b48e54,#6e512c)!important;border-color:#dab97c!important}
 .resourcebar{padding:10px 18px!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#101a23,#091118)!important;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.04)!important;border-bottom:1px solid #6f5836!important;gap:8px!important}.resource{min-width:96px!important;padding:10px 10px 8px!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#172631,#0f1820)!important;border:1px solid #5d4c32!important;border-radius:5px!important}.resource b{font:700 24px Georgia,serif!important;color:#f0d9a4!important}.resource span{font-size:10px!important;letter-spacing:1.4px!important;color:#c2ccd0!important;text-transform:uppercase}
 .shell{padding:10px!important;gap:10px!important;display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:1.45fr .55fr!important}.mapframe{border:1px solid #715737!important;border-radius:8px!important;background:#092333!important;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(211,177,112,.12),0 14px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.35),inset 0 0 36px rgba(0,0,0,.45)!important;overflow:hidden}.maptools{padding:8px 10px!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#162734,#0f1a21)!important;border-bottom:1px solid #715737!important}.maptools button,.mode{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#213847,#15242d)!important;border:1px solid #596973!important;border-radius:4px!important;color:#eee1c7!important}.mode.chosen,.tabs button.active{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#b58d52,#6e512c)!important;border-color:#d8b67a!important;color:#fff5e0!important}.mapviewport{background:#082030!important}
 #map{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 30%,#2b6989 0,#17415d 35%,#0a2434 75%,#07141d 100%)!important}
 .sidebar{display:grid!important;grid-template-rows:auto auto 1fr!important;gap:10px!important}.panel{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#162734,#0f181f)!important;border:1px solid #715737!important;border-radius:8px!important;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(211,177,112,.08),0 10px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.26)!important}.panel h2,.panel h3{font-family:Georgia,serif!important;color:#ecd59c!important}.headingrow{border-bottom:1px solid #53462f!important;padding-bottom:6px!important}.badge{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#223846,#12212b)!important;border:1px solid #7d6540!important;color:#efdbab!important}
 .tabs{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))!important;gap:6px!important}.tabs button{padding:11px 4px!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#213847,#14242d)!important;border:1px solid #566772!important;border-radius:4px!important;color:#f1e4cb!important;font-weight:700!important}
 .feed{max-height:260px!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#101a22,#0b1218)!important}.feed li{border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05)!important;color:#d7d0bf!important}
 .foot{padding:7px 18px!important;background:#071018!important;border-top:1px solid #6e5635!important;color:#8fa4ab!important}
 .majorlabel{font:700 27px Georgia,serif!important;fill:#f2ead4!important;stroke:#1a2229!important;stroke-width:3!important;letter-spacing:1.2px}.majorlabel.subtle{font-size:14px!important}
 .sea-label{fill:#7fb4c8!important;font:italic 18px Georgia,serif!important;letter-spacing:3px!important;opacity:.52!important}
 .province{stroke:#352515!important;stroke-width:1.05!important}
 .v14-flagwrap{display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;gap:8px!important;padding:2px 8px!important;border:1px solid #7c6440!important;border-radius:6px!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#223746,#13222c)!important;cursor:pointer}.v14-flag{width:60px!important;height:38px!important;display:block;border:1px solid #d1b075;border-radius:4px}
 .v14-overview{display:grid;gap:10px}.v14-hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:88px 1fr;gap:10px;align-items:start}.v14-hero img{width:88px;height:108px;object-fit:cover;border:1px solid #c5a873;border-radius:6px}.v14-hero h3{margin:2px 0 4px!important;font:700 28px Georgia,serif!important;color:#f0d8a5}.tiny-label{font-size:10px!important;letter-spacing:1.8px!important;color:#c0ccd0!important;text-transform:uppercase}.v14-kpi{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px}.v14-kpi .box{padding:10px 8px;border:1px solid #485968;border-radius:6px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#162531,#101a22);text-align:center}.v14-kpi .box b{display:block;font:700 28px Georgia,serif;color:#f0d8a5}.v14-kpi .box span{display:block;font-size:11px;color:#bfc9cc}.v14-idea{margin-top:2px;padding:8px;border:1px solid #485968;border-radius:6px;background:#111a21}.v14-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:2px 0;font-size:12px}.v14-row span{color:#c0c9cd}.v14-row b{color:#f0e0be}.good{color:#93d08a!important}.v14-council{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:8px}.v14-council img{width:42px;height:52px;object-fit:cover;border:1px solid #c4a873;border-radius:4px}
 .modal{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#162734,#0f181f)!important;border:1px solid #7b6240!important;border-radius:8px!important}.modal h2,.modal h3{font-family:Georgia,serif!important;color:#ecd59c!important}
 .v14-techmodal{width:min(1700px,95vw)!important;max-width:none!important}.v14-techhead{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px;padding-bottom:10px;border-bottom:1px solid #574a32}.v14-techhead h2{margin:0;font:700 34px Georgia,serif;color:#efd79f}.v14-techcats{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:10px 0}.v14-techcats button{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#223746,#14232d);border:1px solid #5f6e77;border-radius:4px;color:#f1e3c9;padding:10px 14px}.v14-techcats button.active{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#b58d52,#6e512c);border-color:#d8b67a}.v14-techgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px}.v14-techcard{position:relative;padding:8px;border:1px solid #54442f;border-radius:8px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#182734,#111920)}.v14-techcard img{width:100%;height:118px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid #a0885b;background:#d6c6a7}.v14-techcard h4{margin:8px 0 4px;font:700 18px Georgia,serif;color:#efd6a0}.v14-techcard small{display:block;color:#b8c4c8;min-height:34px}.v14-ribbon{position:absolute;top:8px;right:8px;padding:4px 7px;background:rgba(10,16,20,.85);border:1px solid #806640;border-radius:4px;font-size:11px;color:#f0d8a5}.v14-eff{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;font-size:12px}.v14-eff span{color:#b7c3c6}.v14-eff b{color:#9dd1a0}.v14-techfoot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-top:8px}.v14-req{font-size:11px;color:#ceb98d;min-height:26px}
 .v14-fleetlead,.v14-cannondeck{margin-bottom:12px}.v14-fleetgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}.v14-fleetcard{display:grid;grid-template-columns:148px 1fr;gap:10px;padding:8px;border:1px solid #55452f;border-radius:8px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#182734,#111a22)}.v14-fleetcard img{width:148px;height:95px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid #a58d62;background:#d1c09d}.v14-cannongrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}.v14-cannoncard{padding:8px;border:1px solid #54442f;border-radius:8px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#182835,#101820)}.v14-cannoncard img{width:100%;height:110px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid #9d8457;background:#d8caad}.v14-c-head h4{margin:6px 0 2px;font:700 18px Georgia,serif;color:#efd6a0}.v14-c-head small{color:#b6c2c7}.v14-barline{display:grid;grid-template-columns:110px 1fr 56px;gap:8px;align-items:center;font-size:11px;margin-top:5px}.v14-barline span{color:#b6c2c7}.v14-bar{height:8px;border-radius:999px;background:#182430;overflow:hidden}.v14-bar i{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:999px}
 @media (max-width:1500px){.shell{grid-template-columns:1fr!important}.v14-techgrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.v14-fleetgrid,.v14-cannongrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

function v14bar(label,val,max,color,text){const pc=Math.max(6,Math.min(100,Math.round((val/max)*100)));return `<div class="v14-barline"><span>${label}</span><div class="v14-bar"><i style="width:${pc}%;background:${color}"></i></div><b>${text||val}</b></div>`}
function v14gunArt(key){try{return (typeof V6_ART!=='undefined'&&V6_ART[key])?V6_ART[key]:((typeof V6_ART!=='undefined'&&V6_ART.cannon)?V6_ART.cannon:'')}catch(e){return ''}}
function v14Cannon(c){const fire=(c.atk*10).toFixed(1), pen=Math.round(c.atk*8+c.lb/2), rng=c.range, rel=Math.round(100/Math.max(.7,c.reload));return `<div class="v14-cannoncard"><img src="${v14gunArt(c.id)}" alt="${c.lb}"><div class="v14-c-head"><h4>${c.lb}-фунтовая морская пушка</h4><small>${c.category}</small></div>${v14bar('Огневая мощь',c.atk,7.5,'#67af81',fire)}${v14bar('Бронепробитие',pen,90,'#d1b25a',pen)}${v14bar('Дальность',rng,900,'#5ca9d3',rng+' м')}${v14bar('Перезарядка',rel,100,'#c96c5a',rel+'%')}${v14bar('Производство',Math.max(10,50-c.lb/1.4),50,'#8b8f95','−'+Math.min(30,Math.round(c.lb/2))+'%')}</div>`}
function v14techArt(t){const n=(t.name||'').toLowerCase(); if(/пушк|оруд|батар/.test(n)){const m=n.match(/(4|6|9|12|18|24|32|42)/); return v14gunArt(m?('gun'+m[1]):'gun12')} try{if(typeof V6_ART!=='undefined'){if(/мушкет|штык/.test(n)) return V6_ART.musket||V6_ART.infantry; if(/фрегат|кораб|парус|такел|навига|карты|эскадр/.test(n)) return V6_ART.ship||V6_ART.naval; if(/кавал|драгун/.test(n)) return V6_ART.cavalry||V6_ART.infantry; if(/образован|школ|академ|универ/.test(n)) return V6_ART.academy||V6_ART.advisor; if(/мануф|банк|торгов|промыш|кредит|хозяй/.test(n)) return V6_ART.industry||V6_ART.money; if(/логист|дорог|мост|магазин|снабж/.test(n)) return V6_ART.map||V6_ART.industry; return V6_ART.advisor||V6_ART.ship;}}catch(e){} return ''}
function v14techEffects(t){const lines=[]; const id=t.id||''; if(/^gun\d+$/.test(id)){const c=CANNONS.find(x=>x.id===id); if(c){lines.push(['Огневая мощь','+'+Math.round(c.atk*8)+'%']);lines.push(['Бронепробитие','+'+Math.round(c.lb/1.4)+'%']);lines.push(['Дальность','+'+Math.round((c.range-300)/9)+'%']);lines.push(['Перезарядка','−'+Math.max(4,Math.round((4-c.reload)*8))+'%']);lines.push(['Производство','−'+Math.min(24,Math.round(c.lb/2))+'%']);}} else if(/образован|академ|школ|универ/i.test(t.name)){lines.push(['Скорость исследований','+8%'],['Рост образования','+12%'],['Стоимость технологий','−4%'],['Подготовка офицеров','+6%']);} else if(/фрегат|кораб|верф|такел|парус|навига/i.test(t.name)){lines.push(['Скорость эскадр','+6%'],['Стоимость постройки','−8%'],['Организация флота','+5%'],['Дальность похода','+7%']);} else if(/мушкет|штык|строев|устав|пехот/i.test(t.name)){lines.push(['Подготовка пехоты','+8%'],['Атака пехоты','+6%'],['Организация армии','+4%']);} else if(/артил|осад|калибр/i.test(t.name)){lines.push(['Урон артиллерии','+9%'],['Точность батарей','+6%'],['Стоимость орудий','−5%']);} else if(/мануф|банк|торгов|кредит|хозяй/i.test(t.name)){lines.push(['Доход экономики','+10%'],['Торговая эффективность','+6%'],['Содержание мануфактур','−4%']);} else if(/логист|снабж|дорог|магазин/i.test(t.name)){lines.push(['Снабжение армии','+10%'],['Скорость марша','+4%'],['Потери от истощения','−6%']);} else {lines.push(['Эффективность государства','+5%'],['Стоимость реформ','−3%']);} return lines.slice(0,5).map(([a,b])=>`<div class="v14-eff"><span>${a}</span><b>${b}</b></div>`).join('')}
const v14OldShowTechTree=showTechTree; showTechTree=function(cat=treeCat){treeCat=cat; const f=s.player,cats=[...new Set(TECH.map(t=>t.cat))],now=s.research[f],active=now&&TECH.find(t=>t.id===now.id); let h=`<div class="v14-techhead"><div><h2>Исследования державы</h2><small>${F[f].name} · ${s.tech[f].length}/${TECH.length} технологий${active?' · идёт: '+esc(active.name):''}</small></div><button onclick="closeModal()">✕</button></div><div class="v14-techcats">${cats.map(c=>`<button class="${c===cat?'active':''}" onclick="showTechTree('${c}')">${esc(c)}</button>`).join('')}</div><div class="v14-techgrid">`; for(const t of TECH.filter(t=>t.cat===cat)){const done=has(f,t.id), eligible=techAccessible(f,t), activeNow=now?.id===t.id, can=!done&&!now&&eligible&&s.gold[f]>=t.cost; const reqs=t.req.map(id=>TECH.find(x=>x.id===id)?.name||id).join(' · '); h+=`<div class="v14-techcard ${done?'done':activeNow?'active':can?'can':'lock'}"><div class="v14-ribbon">${done?'Изучено':activeNow?'Исследуется':can?'Доступно':'Заблокировано'}</div><img src="${v14techArt(t)}" alt=""><h4>${esc(t.name)}</h4><small>${esc(t.desc)}</small><div>${v14techEffects(t)}</div>${reqs?`<div class="v14-req">Требуется: ${esc(reqs)}</div>`:''}<div class="v14-techfoot"><span>${researchDays(t,f)} дн.</span><button ${can?'':'disabled'} onclick="research('${t.id}')">${done?'Освоено':activeNow?'В процессе':'◈ '+t.cost}</button></div></div>`} h+='</div>'; showModal(h); $('modalbody').classList.add('v14-techmodal') };
const v14OldTabFleet=tabFleet; tabFleet=function(){ const f=s.player; const fleets=(s.fleets||[]).filter(x=>x.f===f).slice(0,4); const ships=(s.ships||[]).filter(x=>x.f===f); const cards=fleets.map(fl=>{const members=ships.filter(sh=>sh.squadronId===fl.id||sh.fleetId===fl.id).slice(0,4); const lead=members[0]; let art=''; try{if(typeof V6_ART!=='undefined'){art=V6_ART.ship||V6_ART.naval}}catch(e){} return `<div class="v14-fleetcard"><img src="${art}" alt=""><div><h4 style="margin:0 0 6px;font:700 19px Georgia,serif;color:#efd79f">${esc(fl.name)}</h4><div class="v14-eff"><span>Корабли</span><b>${members.length}</b></div><div class="v14-eff"><span>Порт приписки</span><b>${typeof fl.port==='number'?esc(N[fl.port].name):'в море'}</b></div><div class="v14-eff"><span>Готовность</span><b>${Math.max(72,96-members.length*2)}%</b></div></div></div>`}).join('')||'<div class="mini">Пока нет активных эскадр.</div>'; const gunDeck=`<section class="v14-cannondeck"><div class="headingrow"><h3 style="margin:0">Корабельная артиллерия</h3><span class="badge">Параметры как в Age of Sail</span></div><div class="v14-cannongrid">${CANNONS.map(c=>v14Cannon(c)).join('')}</div></section>`; return `<section class="v14-fleetlead"><div class="headingrow"><h2 style="margin:0">Флот и операции</h2><span class="badge">Эскадры ${fleets.length} · суда ${ships.length}</span></div><div class="v14-fleetgrid">${cards}</div></section>`+gunDeck+v14OldTabFleet() }
const v14OldRealmPanel=realmPanel; realmPanel=function(){v14OldRealmPanel(); const f=s.player, idea=NATIONAL?.[f], advisors=(s.advisers[f]||[]).map(id=>ADVISERS.find(a=>a.id===id)).filter(Boolean); const ps=regOf(f), ships=ps.reduce((sum,z)=>sum+vessels(z.p),0), reg=ps.reduce((sum,z)=>sum+armies(z.p),0); $('flag').innerHTML=`<img class="v14-flag" src="${v14flag(f)}" alt="flag"><span>${F[f].style}</span>`; $('flag').classList.add('v14-flagwrap'); $('flag').onclick=()=>{tab='court';drawAll()}; $('countryoverview').innerHTML=`<div class="v14-overview"><div class="v14-hero">${idea?`<img src="${idea.v14portrait}" alt="${esc(idea.ruler)}">`:''}<div><div class="tiny-label">ДЕРЖАВА</div><h3>${F[f].name}</h3><div class="v14-row"><span>Население короны</span><b>${fmt(s.population?.[f]||5200000)}</b></div><div class="v14-row"><span>Военный резерв</span><b>${fmt((s.recruits?.[f]||286000))}</b></div></div></div><div class="v14-kpi"><div class="box"><b>${ps.length}</b><span>Провинции</span></div><div class="box"><b>${reg}</b><span>Полки</span></div><div class="box"><b>${ships}</b><span>Суда</span></div></div><div class="v14-idea"><div class="v14-row"><span>Стабильность</span><b>${Math.round(s.stability[f])}%</b></div><div class="v14-row"><span>Образование</span><b>${edu(f).toFixed(1)}</b></div><div class="v14-row"><span>Престиж</span><b>${Math.round(s.prestige[f])}</b></div>${idea?`<div class="tiny-label" style="margin-top:6px">НАЦИОНАЛЬНАЯ ИДЕЯ</div><div style="font:700 18px Georgia,serif;color:#efd8a4;margin:2px 0 5px">${esc(idea.title)}</div>${Object.entries(idea.mods).slice(0,3).map(([k,v])=>`<div class="v14-row"><span>${BONUS_NAMES[k]||k}</span><b class="good">${v<1?'−'+Math.round((1-v)*100):'+'+Math.round((v-1)*100)}%</b></div>`).join('')}`:''}<div class="v14-council">${advisors.slice(0,3).map(a=>`<img src="${a.v14portrait}" title="${esc(a.name)}">`).join('')}</div></div></div>` }
function v14MapDecor(){ const world=document.getElementById('world'); if(!world) return; let old=document.getElementById('v14decor'); if(old) old.remove(); let g=document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','g'); g.id='v14decor'; g.setAttribute('pointer-events','none'); g.innerHTML=`<path d="M86 220 C178 318, 228 425, 300 523" fill="none" stroke="#2aa2d1" stroke-width="5" stroke-dasharray="16 12" opacity=".82"/><path d="M462 549 C523 516, 598 474, 689 438 S897 359 1039 334 S1216 266 1348 170" fill="none" stroke="#2aa2d1" stroke-width="4.5" stroke-dasharray="14 10" opacity=".74"/><path d="M674 706 C765 688, 887 675, 1012 681 S1250 684 1370 687" fill="none" stroke="#2aa2d1" stroke-width="4.2" stroke-dasharray="14 10" opacity=".74"/><text x="925" y="258" class="sea-label">СЕВЕРНОЕ МОРЕ</text><text x="165" y="722" class="sea-label">СРЕДИЗЕМНОЕ МОРЕ</text><g transform="translate(1338 112)"><circle r="44" cx="0" cy="0" fill="#10263a" stroke="#c9aa6a" stroke-width="2.2"/><circle r="34" cx="0" cy="0" fill="none" stroke="#c9aa6a" stroke-opacity=".65"/><path d="M0-36 L6 -6 L0 -14 L-6 -6 Z M36 0 L6 6 L14 0 L6 -6 Z M0 36 L6 6 L0 14 L-6 6 Z M-36 0 L-6 6 L-14 0 L-6 -6 Z" fill="#e9d8a8"/><circle r="3" fill="#fff0c8"/></g>`; world.insertBefore(g,world.firstChild)}
const v14OldDrawMap=drawMap; drawMap=function(){v14OldDrawMap(); setTimeout(v14MapDecor,0)}
const v14OldDrawAll=drawAll; drawAll=function(){v14OldDrawAll(); const tabs=document.querySelectorAll('#tabs button'); tabs.forEach(btn=>btn.innerHTML=btn.textContent) }

/* XV — Главный штаб, снаряжение, процедурные корпуса, научные доктрины. */
const V15_RESEARCH = [
 ['v15_rifles','Унификация кремнёвых замков','Пехотное оружие',['flintlock'],4,165,{infAttack:1.05,arsenalSpeed:1.05}],
 ['v15_cartridge','Стандартизация бумажных патронов','Пехотное оружие',['v15_rifles'],5,185,{infAttack:1.04,arsenalCost:.95}],

 ['v15_quickfire','Унифицированные корабельные расчёты','Морская артиллерия',['v15_elevating'],6,225,{gunReload:1.12,navalPower:1.04}],
