];
const V15_NEW_EFFECTS = Object.fromEntries(V15_RESEARCH.map(z=>[z[0],z[6]]));
for(const [id,name,cat,req,time,cost,mods] of V15_RESEARCH){
  if(!TECH.some(t=>t.id===id)) TECH.push({id,name,cat,req,time,cost,eduMin:30+Math.round(time*2),desc:Object.entries(mods).map(([k,v])=>`${BONUS_NAMES[k]||k} ${v<1?'−':'+'}${Math.round(Math.abs(v-1)*100)}%`).join(' · ')});
}
Object.assign(BONUS_NAMES,{arsenalSpeed:'Скорость вооружения',arsenalCost:'Себестоимость оружия',gunCost:'Стоимость орудий',gunDamage:'Урон корабельных пушек',gunReload:'Скорость перезарядки',gunAccuracy:'Точность орудий',supply:'Обеспечение армии',armySpeed:'Скорость похода',shipHull:'Прочность кораблей',shipSpeed:'Скорость кораблей'});
const v15PreviousGlobalMod=globalMod;
globalMod=function(f,k){let x=v15PreviousGlobalMod(f,k);for(const id of s?.tech?.[f]||[]){if(V15_NEW_EFFECTS[id]?.[k]!==undefined)x*=V15_NEW_EFFECTS[id][k]}return x};

function v15Hash(text){let h=2166136261;for(const ch of String(text)){h^=ch.charCodeAt(0);h=Math.imul(h,16777619)}return h>>>0}
function v15Random(seed){let s=seed>>>0;return()=>{s=(Math.imul(s,1664525)+1013904223)>>>0;return s/4294967296}}
function v15Portrait(name,role,kind='court'){
 const r=v15Random(v15Hash(name+'|'+role));let wig=Math.floor(r()*4),coat=['#762f34','#2e4a65','#6c633a','#376054','#63507a'][Math.floor(r()*5)],skin=['#dbac88','#edc59f','#c59170','#e5b996'][Math.floor(r()*4)],eyes=90+Math.floor(r()*5),jaw=148+Math.floor(r()*10),hat=r()>.65, beard=r()>.75;
 const hair=wig===0?'#bdb7a7':wig===1?'#d4cbc0':wig===2?'#8f8683':'#e6d9c3';
 const svg=`<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 180 220"><defs><linearGradient id="b" x2=".5" y2="1"><stop stop-color="#425568"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#141b24"/></linearGradient></defs><rect width="180" height="220" fill="url(#b)"/><path d="M10 212 Q24 149 65 151 L115 151 Q162 155 170 212Z" fill="${coat}" stroke="#bd9a61" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M71 154 L90 193 L110 154 L100 222 L80 222Z" fill="#f2e8d9"/><ellipse cx="90" cy="103" rx="42" ry="55" fill="${skin}"/><path d="M46 100 Q40 36 87 32 Q133 24 137 94 Q124 64 117 68 Q92 79 56 75Z" fill="${hair}"/><path d="M47 81 Q35 103 43 132 Q48 146 54 129 L59 78 M133 78 L137 132 Q145 146 150 119 L143 72" fill="${hair}" stroke="#706b65" stroke-width="1.2"/><path d="M64 ${eyes}l16 0 M101 ${eyes}l16 0" stroke="#735943" stroke-width="2"/><circle cx="73" cy="${eyes+6}" r="3" fill="#28313a"/><circle cx="109" cy="${eyes+6}" r="3" fill="#28313a"/><path d="M88 100q-5 12-3 20l8 0" stroke="#a77b5c" fill="none" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M75 ${jaw}q16 8 31 0" stroke="#7b4b42" fill="none" stroke-width="2"/>${beard?'<path d="M65 143 Q80 180 99 172 Q115 168 119 143 Q91 156 65 143Z" fill="#a6a099" opacity=".9"/>':''}${hat?'<path d="M25 74 Q90 45 155 74 L135 51 L112 26 L62 26 L45 51Z" fill="#272b32" stroke="#c4a36a" stroke-width="2"/>':''}<path d="M18 207h144" stroke="#c7a16a" stroke-width="3"/></svg>`;
 return 'data:image/svg+xml;charset=UTF-8,'+encodeURIComponent(svg);
}
const V15_PEOPLE={};for(const n of NATIONAL)V15_PEOPLE[n.ruler]=v15Portrait(n.ruler,n.title);for(const a of ADVISERS)V15_PEOPLE[a.id]=v15Portrait(a.name,a.role);for(const a of V6_ADMIRALS)V15_PEOPLE[a.name]=v15Portrait(a.name,'Адмирал','navy');

function v15Get(){if(!s)return null;s.v15 ||= {training:[],unlocked:[],next:1,created:15};return s.v15}
function v15Regiments(i){let p=s.provinces[i];p.v15Regiments ||= [];if(p.owner!==s.player)return p.v15Regiments;
 if(!p.v15Initialized){const keys=['inf','lineinf','fusiliers','militia','lightinf','grenadiers','guards','cav','dragoons','hussars','cuirassiers','art','lightart','heavyart'];for(const key of keys){let n=Math.min(6,countUnit(p,key));for(let j=0;j<n;j++)p.v15Regiments.push({id:++v15Get().next,type:key,headcount:(REGIMENTS[key]?.type==='Артиллерия'?120:REGIMENTS[key]?.type==='Конница'?500:800),name:`${p.v15Regiments.length+1}-й ${REGIMENTS[key]?.label||'полк'}`,experience:0,training:0,weapon:null,gearCount:0,morale:p.morale||70});}p.v15Initialized=true;}return p.v15Regiments;}
function v15SelectedReg(){let r=v15Regiments(selected);return r.find(x=>x.id===v15RegId)||r[0]}
let v15RegId=null,v15Tab='regiments';
function v15Equip(regId,equip){const p=s.provinces[selected],r=v15Regiments(selected).find(x=>x.id===regId);if(!r||!own(selected))return;
 if(equip!==''&&(!V6_EQUIP[equip]||V6_EQUIP[equip].tech&&!has(s.player,V6_EQUIP[equip].tech)))return say('Требуется соответствующее исследование');
 const inventory=s.equipment[s.player],qty=equip===''?0:((equip.startsWith('gun')?2:120));
 if((inventory[equip]||0)<qty)return say('Недостаточно предметов на складе — назначьте мануфактуры в Производстве');
 if(r.weapon){inventory[r.weapon]=(inventory[r.weapon]||0)+(r.gearCount||0)}
 if(equip)inventory[equip]-=qty;r.weapon=equip||null;r.gearCount=qty;r.experience=Math.max(0,r.experience-1);
 log(`${r.name}: новое оснащение ${equip?V6_EQUIP[equip].name:'штатное'}.`);v15Render();drawAll();}
function v15Train(regId){let r=v15Regiments(selected).find(x=>x.id===regId),v=v15Get();if(!r)return;
 if(v.training.some(x=>x.regId===regId&&x.i===selected))return say('Полк уже на учениях');
 if(s.gold[s.player]<18||s.food[s.player]<3||(s.equipment[s.player].gunpowder||0)<1)return say('Для подготовки нужны 18 монет, 3 провианта и 1 единица пороха');
 s.gold[s.player]-=18;s.food[s.player]-=3;s.equipment[s.player].gunpowder-=1;
 v.training.push({i:selected,regId,remaining:21});log(`${r.name}: начаты полковые учения (21 день).`);v15Render();drawAll();}
const v15PreviousAdvanceDay=advanceDay;
advanceDay=function(){v15PreviousAdvanceDay();if(!s||s.ended)return;const v=v15Get();for(const t of v.training){t.remaining--;if(t.remaining<=0){const r=s.provinces[t.i]?.v15Regiments?.find(x=>x.id===t.regId);if(r){r.experience=Math.min(100,r.experience+12);r.training=Math.min(100,r.training+8);r.morale=Math.min(100,r.morale+5);if(s.provinces[t.i].owner===s.player)log(`${r.name}: учебный сбор окончен. Опыт +12, подготовка +8.`)}}}v.training=v.training.filter(x=>x.remaining>0)};
const v15PreviousPower=power;
power=function(p,f,attack=false,where=0){let val=v15PreviousPower(p,f,attack,where);if(p?.v15Regiments?.length){let troops=p.v15Regiments;let mul=troops.reduce((a,r)=>a+(r.experience/100)*.12+(r.training/100)*.09+(r.weapon?((r.weapon.startsWith('gun')?.085:.05))*Math.min(1,(r.gearCount||0)/Math.max(1,r.headcount||800)):0),0)/Math.max(1,troops.length);val*=1+Math.min(.28,mul);}return val};

const v15PreviousShipMesh=v8shipMesh;
v8shipMesh=function(type='frigate',design=null){let base=v15PreviousShipMesh(type,design),seed=design?.modelSeed??v15Hash((design?.name||type)+'|'+(design?.id||0)),rng=v15Random(seed);let size=type==='line'?1.55:type==='frigate'?1.1:type==='transport'?1.16:.82,L=11*size,W=(type==='line'?3.4:2.8)*size;
 // Детерминированная генерация кормы, вымпелов, галерей и декоративных надстроек.
 const accent=['#bc9a5b','#aeb9bc','#946847','#c0a66d'][Math.floor(rng()*4)],rake=.3+rng()*.6;
 for(const side of [-1,1]){for(let j=0;j<4;j++){let xx=-L*.38+j*L*.25;v8seg(base,[xx,side*W*.4,.32*size],[xx,side*W*.4,(.45+rng()*.12)*size],accent,1);}}
 v8cube(base,-L*.46,0,.60*size,L*.08,W*.63,.25*size,accent);
 for(let i=0;i<(type==='line'?5:3);i++){const yy=(i-(type==='line'?2:1))*W*.10;v8cube(base,-L*.51,yy,.64*size,.12*size,.07*size,.15*size,'#25343c');}
 for(let j=0;j<2;j++){let x=(j===0?-.16:.22)*L;v8seg(base,[x,0,(6.9+j)*size],[x+(j===0?-1:1)*rake*size,0,(7.6+j)*size],accent,1.2)}
 v8cube(base,L*.42,0,.60*size,L*.10,W*.48,.17*size,accent);
 // Гальюнная носовая решётка и оснастка, варьирующиеся по проекту.
 for(let j=0;j<4;j++){v8seg(base,[L*.43,(-.23+j*.15)*W,.22*size],[L*.6,(-.20+j*.13)*W,-.05*size],'#9d855f',.8)}
 return base;};
const v15PreviousMeshFor=v8meshFor;
v8meshFor=function(e){if(e.kind==='ship'){const sid=e.shipId||e.design?.id||e.id;const sd=v15Hash(String(sid)+'|'+(e.design?.name||e.type));e.design={...(e.design||{}),modelSeed:sd,batteries:e.design?.batteries||[]};e.meshKey='v15-'+e.type+'-'+sd+'-'+e.design.batteries.map(b=>b.gun+b.count).join('-')}return v15PreviousMeshFor(e)};
const v15OldCannon=v8cannon3d;
v8cannon3d=function(m,x,y,z,lb=12,side=1,scale=1){v15OldCannon(m,x,y,z,lb,side,scale);let sc=scale*(.6+lb/42*.55),r=(.045+lb*.0016)*scale;
 // Цапфы, медные обоймы, подкосы лафета, оси колёс.
 v8cylinder(m,[x,y,z+.045*sc],[x,y+side*.16*sc,z+.045*sc],r*1.12,'#bd9a60',10);
 v8cube(m,x,y,z-.15*sc,.46*sc,.50*sc,.08*sc,'#60472e');
 for(const dx of [-1,1])v8seg(m,[x+dx*.19*sc,y-.2*sc,z-.17*sc],[x+dx*.19*sc,y+.2*sc,z-.17*sc],'#332922',1.2)
};


// Исследования снабжения, артиллерийской точности и скорости марша участвуют в расчёте.
const v15OldSupplyOf=v8supplyOf;
v8supplyOf=function(i){let q=v15OldSupplyOf(i);let f=s.provinces[i]?.owner;if(Number.isInteger(f))q=Math.min(100,q*globalMod(f,'supply'));return q};
const v15OldTravelDays=travelDays;
travelDays=function(from,to,force,f){return Math.max(4,Math.round(v15OldTravelDays(from,to,force,f)/globalMod(f,'armySpeed')))};
const v15OldShipPower=v6shipPower;
v6shipPower=function(sh,admiralIndex){return v15OldShipPower(sh,admiralIndex)*globalMod(sh.f,'gunAccuracy')};
const v15OldShowModel=v8ShowModel;
v8ShowModel=function(shipId){v15OldShowModel(shipId);if(V8_SCENE?.units?.[0]){V8_SCENE.units[0].shipId=shipId;V8_SCENE.units[0].meshKey=null}};

// Морская артиллерия XV: дальность, борт, масса залпа, сопротивление корпуса и перезарядка.
function v15CannonStats(c,f=0){return {damage:c.atk*globalMod(f,'gunDamage'),penetration:c.lb*(globalMod(f,'gunAccuracy')||1),range:c.range,reload:Math.max(1.5,4.7*c.reload/Math.max(.5,globalMod(f,'gunReload')))}}
const v15PreviousFire=v8fire;
v8fire=function(u){let sc=V8_SCENE;if(!sc||sc.kind!=='sea'||u.kind!=='ship')return v15PreviousFire(u);
 if(u.hp<=0||u.cooldown>0)return;
 const nearest=sc.units.filter(z=>z.team!==u.team&&z.hp>0).sort((a,b)=>Math.hypot(u.pos[0]-a.pos[0],u.pos[1]-a.pos[1])-Math.hypot(u.pos[0]-b.pos[0],u.pos[1]-b.pos[1]))[0];if(!nearest)return;
 const batt=u.design?.batteries?.filter(z=>z.count>0)||[];const guns=batt.map(row=>({c:CANNONS.find(c=>c.id===row.gun)||CANNONS[0],count:row.count||0}));const total=guns.reduce((a,b)=>a+b.count,0);
 if(!total)return v15PreviousFire(u);
 const d=Math.hypot(u.pos[0]-nearest.pos[0],u.pos[1]-nearest.pos[1]);const maxRange=guns.reduce((a,g)=>Math.max(a,g.c.range),0)/12;
 if(d>maxRange)return;
 const angle=Math.atan2(nearest.pos[1]-u.pos[1],nearest.pos[0]-u.pos[0]);const bearing=Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(angle-u.angle),Math.cos(angle-u.angle)));
 if(!(bearing>Math.PI*.19&&bearing<Math.PI*.88))return;
 if(u.ammo===undefined)u.ammo=100;if(u.ammo<1)return;
 const weightedReload=guns.reduce((a,g)=>a+g.c.reload*g.count,0)/total;
 const power=guns.reduce((a,g)=>a+g.c.atk*g.count/2,0);
 const penetration=guns.reduce((a,g)=>a+g.c.lb*g.count,0)/total;
 const armor=(nearest.type==='line'?25:nearest.type==='frigate'?15:nearest.type==='transport'?6:9)*Math.max(.6,nearest.hp/Math.max(1,nearest.maxHp||nearest.hp));
 const penFactor=Math.min(1.25,Math.max(.3,penetration/Math.max(1,armor)));
 const crewRatio=(u.shipId?s.ships.find(x=>x.id===u.shipId)?.crew/(s.ships.find(x=>x.id===u.shipId)?.crewMax||1):1)||.75;
 const accuracy=Math.max(.12,(1-d/(maxRange*1.4))*(.70+Math.random()*.3));
 const hit=Math.max(.5,power*.16*penFactor*accuracy*Math.max(.3,crewRatio));
 nearest.hp=Math.max(0,nearest.hp-hit);u.cooldown=Math.max(2.2,weightedReload*4.8/Math.max(.55,globalMod(u.team==='friendly'?s.player:(nearest.shipId?s.ships.find(x=>x.id===nearest.shipId)?.f||0:0),'gunReload')));
 u.ammo-=1;sc.smoke ||= [];for(let i=0;i<9;i++)sc.smoke.push({x:u.pos[0]+Math.random()*2,y:u.pos[1]+Math.random()*2,z:1+Math.random()*2,age:0});
 if(u.team==='friendly'&&v8Battle)v8Battle.lastHit=`${u.name} → ${nearest.name}: ${Math.round(hit)} HP · пробитие ${Math.round(penFactor*100)}%`;
};
const v15PreviousFinish3DBattle=v8finish3dBattle;
v8finish3dBattle=function(won){if(v8Battle?.campaign&&V8_SCENE){for(const u of V8_SCENE.units||[]){if(u.shipId){const sh=s.ships.find(x=>x.id===u.shipId);if(sh)sh.ammo=Math.min(sh.ammo??100,u.ammo??100)}}}return v15PreviousFinish3DBattle(won)};
// Точные статистические значения у старой части дерева без фиктивных бонусов.
const V15_LEGACY_EFFECTS={
 flintlock:{infAttack:1.12},rankfire:{infAttack:1.12},platoonfire:{infAttack:1.12},
 shipyards:{shipCost:.82},professional_army:{infAttack:1.08},
 conscription:{armyCost:.87},rifling:{infAttack:1.08},
 blockandpulleys:{shipTime:.90},drydock:{shipTime:.89},portinspections:{shipTime:.85},
 studss:{armySpeed:1.04},academies:{research:1.13},
 v15_rifles:V15_NEW_EFFECTS.v15_rifles
};
if(typeof v14techEffects==='function'){
 v14techEffects=function(t){let mods=V15_NEW_EFFECTS[t.id]||V15_LEGACY_EFFECTS[t.id];
  if(!mods)return `<div class="v14-eff"><span>${esc(t.desc||'Открывает новый этап развития')}</span><b>Эффект базовой системы</b></div>`;
  return Object.entries(mods).map(([k,v])=>`<div class="v14-eff"><span>${esc(BONUS_NAMES[k]||k)}</span><b>${v<1?'−':'+'}${Math.round(Math.abs(1-v)*100)}%</b></div>`).join('')};
}
if(typeof v14Cannon==='function'){
 v14Cannon=function(c){let q=v15CannonStats(c,s?.player||0),prod=V6_EQUIP[c.id]?.work||c.lb;
  const bar=(label,val,max,color,txt)=>v14bar(label,val,max,color,txt);
  return `<div class="v14-cannoncard"><img src="${typeof V6_ART!=='undefined'&&(V6_ART[c.id]||V6_ART.cannon)||''}" alt="${c.lb}"><div class="v14-c-head"><h4>${c.lb}-фунтовая корабельная пушка</h4><small>Игровые характеристики конкретного образца</small></div>${bar('Мощность',q.damage,8,'#77ac87',q.damage.toFixed(1))}${bar('Пробитие',q.penetration,45,'#ceb074',q.penetration.toFixed(1))}${bar('Дальность',q.range,900,'#6fabc6',q.range+' м')}${bar('Перезарядка',Math.max(1,100-q.reload*7),100,'#bf7a70',q.reload.toFixed(1)+' с')}${bar('Трудозатраты',prod,48,'#989797',prod+' ед.')}</div>`;
 }
}

const v15OldComputerTurn=computerTurn;
computerTurn=function(){v15OldComputerTurn(); // Additional deterministic economic choices, based on shortages and threats.
 for(let f=0;f<F.length;f++){if(f===s.player)continue;const provs=regOf(f);if(!provs.length)continue;
 const enemy=provs.some(({i})=>N[i].adj.some(j=>withWar(f,s.provinces[j].owner)));
 const wantFarm=s.food[f]<Math.max(35,provs.length*.35),wantFoundry=s.iron[f]<Math.max(20,provs.length*.14);
 let best=null,score=-Infinity;for(const {i,p} of provs){let q=(wantFarm?5-p.farm:wantFoundry?4-p.workshop:3-p.market)+(p.road||0)*.5-(p.unrest||0)*.015;if(enemy&&N[i].adj.some(j=>withWar(f,s.provinces[j].owner)))q-=2;if(q>score){score=q;best=p}}
 if(best&&s.gold[f]>135&&s.wood[f]>25){if(wantFarm&&best.farm<5){best.farm++;s.gold[f]-=75;s.wood[f]-=20}else if(wantFoundry&&best.workshop<5&&s.iron[f]>5){best.workshop++;s.gold[f]-=115;s.wood[f]-=24;s.iron[f]-=5}else if(enemy&&best.depot<2){best.depot++;s.gold[f]-=100;s.wood[f]-=22}}
 }
};
/* XV — Графический штаб и насыщенный экран кампании. */
let v15OverlayTab='fleet',v15ShipId=null,v15NewPortraitIndex=0;
function v15Gauge(label,n,max,color='#8cae9d',format=''){let v=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,n/Math.max(1,max)*100));return `<div class="v15-gauge"><span>${label}</span><i><b style="width:${v.toFixed(1)}%;background:${color}"></b></i><strong>${format||Math.round(n)}</strong></div>`}
function v15StateLabels(r){const u=REGIMENTS[r.type]||REGIMENTS.inf;const atk=u.atk*(1+r.training*.0009+r.experience*.0012+(r.weapon?.startsWith('gun')?.09:r.weapon?.includes('sabre')?.07:r.weapon?.includes('musket')?.05:0));return [atk,u.def*(1+r.experience*.001),u.speed,r.morale||70]}
function v15Header(){let f=s.player;return `<div class="v15-h-header"><div><small>КОРОЛЕВСКИЙ ШТАБ · ${dateLabel()}</small><h2>${F[f].name}</h2></div><nav>${[['fleet','Адмиралтейство'],['regiments','Полки и снаряжение'],['research','Доктрины'],['industry','Промышленность']].map(([k,n])=>`<button class="${v15OverlayTab===k?'on':''}" onclick="v15Switch('${k}')">${n}</button>`).join('')}</nav><button class="v15-close" onclick="v15Close()">✕</button></div>`}
function v15ShipPanel(){let fleets=(s.fleets||[]).filter(x=>x.f===s.player),ships=(s.ships||[]).filter(x=>x.f===s.player),sh=ships.find(x=>x.id===v15ShipId)||ships[0];v15ShipId=sh?.id||null;
 let fleet=sh?fleets.find(x=>x.id===sh.fleetId):null,st=sh?v6designStats({...sh.design,f:sh.f}):null;
 const cards=ships.slice(0,32).map(z=>{let stats=v6designStats({...z.design,f:z.f}),kind=V6_HULLS[z.type]?.label||z.type;return `<button class="v15-shiptile ${sh?.id===z.id?'selected':''}" onclick="v15ShipId=${z.id};v15Render()"><img src="${(typeof V6_ART!=='undefined'&&(V6_ART[V6_HULLS[z.type]?.art]||V6_ART.ship))||''}" alt=""><div><b>${esc(z.name)}</b><small>${esc(kind)} · ${stats.guns} орудий</small>${v15Gauge('Корпус',z.hp,z.maxHp,'#9dba94',Math.round(100*z.hp/z.maxHp)+'%')}</div></button>`}).join('');
 let batteries=sh?.design?.batteries||[];
 return `<div class="v15-docklayout"><aside class="v15-docklist"><h3>Личный состав эскадр <small>${fleets.length} эскадр · ${ships.length} кораблей</small></h3>${cards||'<p>Корабли отсутствуют. Создайте проект и заложите его на верфи.</p>'}<button class="v15-main" onclick="v15Close();v8open('fleet')">Эскадры и операции ↗</button></aside><section class="v15-dockhero">${sh?`<div class="v15-shiptitle"><h3>${esc(sh.name)}</h3><span>${esc(V6_HULLS[sh.type]?.label||sh.type)}</span></div><div class="v15-shipimage"><img src="${(typeof V6_ART!=='undefined'&&(V6_ART[V6_HULLS[sh.type]?.art]||V6_ART.ship))||''}" alt=""><div><strong>${st.guns} орудий</strong><strong>${st.speed.toFixed(1)} узлов</strong><strong>${sh.crew}/${sh.crewMax} человек</strong></div></div><div class="v15-shipactions"><button class="v15-main" onclick="v15Close();v8ShowModel(${sh.id})">Открыть 3D-модель ↗</button><button onclick="v15Close();tab='fleet';v6FleetPage='designer';drawAll()">Редактировать проекты</button><button onclick="v15Close();v8open('fleet')">Управление эскадрой</button></div>${v15Gauge('Корпус',sh.hp,sh.maxHp,'#9dba94',Math.round(sh.hp/sh.maxHp*100)+'%')}${v15Gauge('Экипаж',sh.crew,sh.crewMax,'#bda270')}${v15Gauge('Боекомплект',sh.ammo||0,100,'#83b2cb')}${v15Gauge('Опыт',sh.experience||0,100,'#c89c70')}<h3>Орудийные палубы</h3><div class="v15-batteries">${batteries.map((row,i)=>`<div><img src="${(typeof V6_ART!=='undefined'&&(V6_ART[row.gun]||V6_ART.cannon))||''}" alt=""><span>${esc(V6_HULLS[sh.type]?.decks[i]?.name||'Батарея')}</span><b>${row.count} × ${row.gun.replace('gun','')}-фн</b></div>`).join('')}</div><p>Процедурная 3D-модель имеет собственный генерируемый силуэт кормы и декоративные детали. Калибры и число пушек берутся из настоящего проекта корабля.</p>`:'<h3>Корабли ещё не построены</h3><p>Создайте индивидуальный проект, произведите орудия и заложите судно на верфи.</p>'}</section></div>`}
function v15RegPanel(){const entries=v15Regiments(selected),r=v15SelectedReg(),f=s.player,p=s.provinces[selected];if(r&&!v15RegId)v15RegId=r.id;
 const categories=[['musket','Кремнёвый мушкет'],['bayonet','Штыки'],['sabre1700','Палаш 1700'],['cavalrySabre','Кавалерийская сабля'],['gun4','4-фунтовая батарея'],['gun6','6-фунтовая батарея'],['gun12','12-фунтовая батарея']];
 const art=n=>(typeof V6_ART!=='undefined'&&(V6_ART[n]||V6_ART[V6_EQUIP[n]?.art]||V6_ART.infantry))||'';
 return `<div class="v15-reglayout"><aside class="v15-reglist"><h3>Учебные лагеря · ${esc(N[selected].name)}</h3><small>Действующие полки в выбранной провинции</small>${entries.slice(0,30).map(z=>`<button class="v15-regtile ${r?.id===z.id?'selected':''}" onclick="v15RegId=${z.id};v15Render()"><img src="${art(z.weapon||'musket')}" alt=""><span><b>${esc(z.name)}</b><small>${esc(REGIMENTS[z.type]?.type||'Пехота')} · опыт ${z.experience}</small></span></button>`).join('')||'<p>В этой провинции нет полков. Наберите их во вкладке «Армия».</p>'}<button class="v15-main" onclick="v15Close();tab='army';drawAll()">Набор новых полков ↗</button></aside><section class="v15-regmain">${r?`<div class="v15-shiptitle"><h3>${esc(r.name)}</h3><span>${esc(REGIMENTS[r.type]?.label||r.type)}</span></div><div class="v15-regscene"><img src="${art(r.weapon||'musket')}" alt=""><div><strong>Командир полка</strong><img src="${V15_PEOPLE[NATIONAL[f].ruler]}" alt=""></div></div>${[['Атака',v15StateLabels(r)[0],3,'#a3bd91'],['Оборона',v15StateLabels(r)[1],3,'#7ca8b8'],['Мораль',r.morale||70,100,'#ceab71'],['Подготовка',r.training||0,100,'#c2a55f'],['Опыт',r.experience,100,'#a9b78e']].map(z=>v15Gauge(...z)).join('')}<h3>Оснащение из национального склада · ${r.gearCount||0}/${r.headcount||800} человек</h3><div class="v15-equipment">${categories.map(([key,label])=>{const eq=V6_EQUIP[key],req=eq.tech&&!has(f,eq.tech),stock=s.equipment[f][key]||0;return `<button ${req||stock<(key.startsWith('gun')?2:120)?'disabled':''} class="${r.weapon===key?'selected':''}" onclick="v15Equip(${r.id},'${key}')"><img src="${art(key)}" alt=""><b>${label}</b><small>Склад ${Math.floor(stock)} · требуется ${key.startsWith('gun')?2:120}</small></button>`}).join('')}</div><div class="v15-shipactions"><button class="v15-main" onclick="v15Train(${r.id})">Полковая муштра · 21 день</button><button onclick="v15Equip(${r.id},'')">Снять оснащение</button><button onclick="v15Close();v8open('production','lines')">Заказать снаряжение</button></div><p>Учения расходуют монеты, продовольствие и порох. Подготовка, опыт и выбранное оружие повышают расчётную эффективность полка в бою.</p>`:'<h3>Выберите собственный гарнизон на карте</h3>'}</section></div>`}
function v15TechPanel(){let f=s.player,done=s.tech[f].length,active=s.research[f];return `<div class="v15-techpanel"><div class="v15-numbers"><div><small>Изучено</small><b>${done}/${TECH.length}</b></div><div><small>Образование</small><b>${edu(f).toFixed(1)}</b></div><div><small>Активное исследование</small><b>${active?esc(TECH.find(t=>t.id===active.id)?.name||active.id):'нет'}</b></div></div><div class="v15-techgrid">${V15_RESEARCH.map(([id,name,cat,req,time,cost,mods])=>{let d=has(f,id),allowed=techAccessible(f,TECH.find(t=>t.id===id)),can=!d&&!s.research[f]&&allowed&&s.gold[f]>=cost;return `<div class="v15-technode ${d?'done':can?'available':'locked'}"><div class="v15-techpicture"><img src="${(typeof V6_ART!=='undefined'&&(V6_ART[/морск|верф|суд|обшив|эскадр|десант/i.test(name)?'ship':/оруд|ствол|батар/i.test(name)?'gun12':/школ|офицер|навига|стандарт/i.test(name)?'academy':/мушкет|пехот|полк|штыков/i.test(name)?'musket':'industry']))||''}" alt=""></div><b>${name}</b><small>${cat}</small>${Object.entries(mods).map(([k,v])=>`<div class="v15-effect"><span>${BONUS_NAMES[k]||k}</span><strong>${v<1?'−':'+'}${Math.round(Math.abs(1-v)*100)}%</strong></div>`).join('')}<div class="v15-techfoot"><span>${cost} ◈ · ${researchDays(TECH.find(t=>t.id===id),f)} дн.</span><button ${can?'':'disabled'} onclick="v15Research('${id}')">${d?'Изучено':'Исследовать'}</button></div></div>`}).join('')}</div><button class="v15-main" onclick="v15Close();showTechTree()">Открыть полное древо технологий ↗</button></div>`}
function v15Research(id){research(id);if(document.getElementById('modal')?.classList.contains('visible'))closeModal();v15Render()}
function v15IndustryPanel(){let v=v8get(),f=s.player,lines=v.lines.filter(x=>x.f===f),resources=['iron','steel','copper','wood','coal','saltpeter','sulfur','hemp','flax','leather','horses','food'];return `<div class="v15-industry"><div class="v15-numbers"><div><small>Мануфактуры</small><b>${v8factoryLimit(f)}</b></div><div><small>Линии</small><b>${lines.length}</b></div><div><small>Готовых предметов</small><b>${Math.round(Object.values(s.equipment[f]||{}).reduce((a,b)=>a+(Number(b)||0),0))}</b></div></div><div class="v15-stockgrid">${resources.map(k=>`<div><strong>${V8_MATERIALS?.[k]?.name||k}</strong><b>${Math.round(v8stock(f,k))}</b><span>${V8_MATERIALS?.[k]?.unit||''}</span></div>`).join('')}</div><h3>Производственные линии</h3><div class="v15-linegrid">${lines.map(l=>`<div><img src="${(typeof V6_ART!=='undefined'&&(V6_ART[V6_EQUIP[l.key]?.art]||V6_ART.industry))||''}" alt=""><b>${esc(V6_EQUIP[l.key]?.name||l.key)}</b><span>Мануфактуры ${l.factories} · эффективность ${Math.round(l.eff*100)}%</span>${v15Gauge('Эффективность',l.eff,1,'#98bd92',Math.round(l.eff*100)+'%')}<small>${l.blocked?'Нехватка: '+esc(l.blocked):'Линия работает'}</small></div>`).join('')||'<p>Назначьте хотя бы одну мануфактуру.</p>'}</div><div class="v15-shipactions"><button class="v15-main" onclick="v15Close();v8open('production','lines')">Распределение заводов ↗</button><button onclick="v15Close();v8open('production','materials')">Импорт сырья</button><button onclick="v15Close();v8open('production','logistics')">Логистика</button></div></div>`}
function v15Render(){let el=document.getElementById('v15-window');if(!el||!s)return;el.innerHTML=v15Header()+`<div class="v15-h-body">${v15OverlayTab==='fleet'?v15ShipPanel():v15OverlayTab==='regiments'?v15RegPanel():v15OverlayTab==='research'?v15TechPanel():v15IndustryPanel()}</div>`}
function v15Switch(tab){v15OverlayTab=tab;v15Render()}
function v15Open(tab='fleet'){v15OverlayTab=tab;pauseGame();let box=document.getElementById('v15-overlay');box.classList.add('open');v15Render()}
function v15Close(){document.getElementById('v15-overlay')?.classList.remove('open')}
function v15Rail(){if(!s)return;const el=document.getElementById('v15-rail');if(!el)return;const f=s.player,monarch=NATIONAL[f];let advisers=(s.advisers[f]||[]).map(id=>ADVISERS.find(x=>x.id===id)).filter(Boolean);
 el.innerHTML=`<div class="v15-railhead"><img src="${V15_PEOPLE[monarch.ruler]}" alt=""><div><small>${esc(F[f].name)}</small><h3>${esc(monarch.ruler)}</h3><span>${esc(monarch.title)}</span></div></div><div class="v15-railmetric"><span>Стабильность</span><b>${Math.round(s.stability[f])}%</b></div>${v15Gauge('Образование',edu(f),100,'#c9b373',edu(f).toFixed(1))}<h4>Совет короны</h4>${advisers.map(a=>`<button class="v15-person" onclick="tab='court';drawAll();v15Open('research')"><img src="${V15_PEOPLE[a.id]}" alt=""><span><b>${esc(a.name)}</b><small>${esc(a.role)}</small>${Object.entries(a.mods).slice(0,1).map(([k,v])=>`<strong>${esc(BONUS_NAMES[k]||k)} ${v<1?'−':'+'}${Math.round(Math.abs(v-1)*100)}%</strong>`).join('')}</span></button>`).join('')||'<small>Советники ещё не назначены</small>'}<h4>Управление</h4><button class="v15-main" onclick="v15Open('fleet')">Адмиралтейство ↗</button><button onclick="v15Open('regiments')">Оснащение армии ↗</button><button onclick="v15Open('research')">Технологии ↗</button><button onclick="v15Open('industry')">Мануфактуры ↗</button><button onclick="tab='court';drawAll()">Правитель и совет ↗</button>`;}
function v15Install(){if(document.getElementById('v15-overlay'))return;
 const ov=document.createElement('div');ov.id='v15-overlay';ov.innerHTML='<div id="v15-window"></div>';ov.onclick=e=>{if(e.target===ov)v15Close()};document.body.appendChild(ov);
 const rail=document.createElement('aside');rail.id='v15-rail';rail.className='v15-rail';document.querySelector('.shell')?.prepend(rail);
 const dock=document.createElement('section');dock.id='v15-bottomdock';dock.innerHTML=`<button onclick="v15Open('industry')"><img src="${(typeof V6_ART!=='undefined'&&V6_ART.industry)||''}" alt=""><span><b>Производство</b><small>Заводы · склады · импорт</small></span></button><button onclick="v15Open('regiments')"><img src="${(typeof V6_ART!=='undefined'&&V6_ART.infantry)||''}" alt=""><span><b>Армии</b><small>Полки · снаряжение · учения</small></span></button><button onclick="v15Open('fleet')"><img src="${(typeof V6_ART!=='undefined'&&V6_ART.ship)||''}" alt=""><span><b>Флот</b><small>Эскадры · 3D · артиллерия</small></span></button>`;
 document.querySelector('.primary-column')?.appendChild(dock);
 document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape'&&document.getElementById('v15-overlay')?.classList.contains('open')){e.preventDefault();v15Close()}});
}
const v15PreviousDrawAll=drawAll;
drawAll=function(){v15PreviousDrawAll();if(s&&document.getElementById('v15-rail'))v15Rail()};
function v15ApplyCSS(){if(document.getElementById('v15-style'))return;let style=document.createElement('style');style.id='v15-style';style.textContent=`
/* АТЛАС ИМПЕРИЙ XV · Топография и кабинет управления */
.shell{grid-template-columns:265px minmax(0,1fr)!important;gap:9px!important;max-width:none!important}
.shell>.v15-rail{grid-column:1;grid-row:1/4;align-self:start;position:sticky;top:8px;max-height:calc(100vh - 16px);overflow:auto;scrollbar-width:thin}
.shell>.primary-column{grid-column:2;grid-row:1}.shell>.sidebar{grid-column:2;grid-row:2;display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.2fr;gap:10px!important;align-items:start}.shell>.sidebar>.panel:last-child{display:none}.shell>.sidebar>.panel:nth-child(2){grid-column:2}
.v15-rail{background:linear-gradient(115deg,#172a34,#0b161f);border:2px ridge #b09159;border-radius:7px;padding:9px;box-shadow:0 8px 26px #0009,inset 0 0 0 2px #0b1720}
.v15-railhead{display:grid;grid-template-columns:95px 1fr;gap:9px;border-bottom:1px solid #8a6c42;padding:3px 0 12px}.v15-railhead img{width:95px;height:130px;object-fit:cover;border:2px solid #b18d54}.v15-railhead small{color:#aab5bb}.v15-railhead h3{margin:7px 0!important;font:700 19px Georgia,serif;color:#f1d7a3}.v15-railhead span{color:#c2b397;font-size:11px}
.v15-railmetric{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:8px 0;color:#d5c7af}.v15-rail h4{font:700 16px Georgia,serif;color:#e4c48d;margin:13px 0 8px;border-bottom:1px solid #705634;padding-bottom:4px}
.v15-person{display:grid;grid-template-columns:54px 1fr;gap:7px;width:100%;text-align:left;background:linear-gradient(100deg,#1e313a,#0e1d28)!important;border:1px solid #80633c!important;padding:5px!important;margin:6px 0}.v15-person img{width:54px;height:72px;object-fit:cover;border:1px solid #b79b66}.v15-person small,.v15-person strong{display:block;font-size:10px;margin-top:3px}.v15-person strong{color:#9ed7a8}.v15-person b{font:700 13px Georgia,serif;color:#f2ddb1}
.v15-rail>button:not(.v15-person){display:block;width:100%;margin-top:6px;font-weight:700}.v15-main{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#b28b4b,#684923)!important;border-color:#d9b377!important;color:#fcf0d3!important}
#v15-bottomdock{margin:10px 0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:9px}#v15-bottomdock>button{display:grid;grid-template-columns:108px 1fr;text-align:left;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#213340,#101b24);border:1px solid #8b6e44;padding:6px;height:102px}#v15-bottomdock img{width:108px;height:84px;object-fit:cover;background:#bdad8f;border:1px solid #bba170}#v15-bottomdock b{display:block;font:700 20px Georgia,serif;color:#f1daaa}#v15-bottomdock small{display:block;font-size:11px;margin-top:6px;color:#a9bec5}
#map{filter:contrast(1.06) saturate(1.05)}#map .province{stroke:#30261c!important;stroke-width:.95!important;fill-opacity:.96}#map .province:hover{stroke:#d7bc7a!important;stroke-width:2.4!important}#map .coastline{stroke:#e0cc93!important;opacity:.67!important}#map .sea-label{opacity:.7!important}
#v15-overlay{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:999;background:rgba(1,8,12,.89);backdrop-filter:blur(4px);align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:12px}#v15-overlay.open{display:flex}
#v15-window{width:min(1550px,100%);height:min(900px,96vh);display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:linear-gradient(175deg,#233342,#101b25 24%,#0c151e);border:3px ridge #ad884f;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 20px 70px #000d,inset 0 0 0 2px #121c22;overflow:hidden;color:#e8dfc9}
.v15-h-header{padding:10px 13px;border-bottom:2px ridge #a78a5a;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:14px;background:linear-gradient(#253b46,#13232e)}.v15-h-header small{font-size:10px;color:#b9c8cb;letter-spacing:1.7px}.v15-h-header h2{margin:2px 0;font:700 27px Georgia,serif;color:#f3dca9}.v15-h-header nav{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px}.v15-h-header button{padding:9px 11px;border-radius:3px}.v15-h-header button.on{background:linear-gradient(#a9824a,#654622);color:#fff4d5;border-color:#d3b273}.v15-close{font-size:20px}
.v15-h-body{padding:14px;overflow:auto;flex:1;scrollbar-color:#70593a #101924}.v15-h-body h3{font:700 20px Georgia,serif;color:#eccc8f;margin:7px 0 12px}.v15-h-body p{font-size:12px;color:#b7c8ca;line-height:1.5}
.v15-docklayout,.v15-reglayout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:37% minmax(0,1fr);gap:14px;align-items:start}.v15-docklist,.v15-reglist,.v15-dockhero,.v15-regmain{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#1b2d39,#111d26);border:1px solid #79613c;border-radius:7px;padding:10px;min-width:0}
.v15-shiptile,.v15-regtile{width:100%;display:grid;grid-template-columns:125px 1fr;gap:10px;text-align:left;align-items:center;padding:6px;margin:6px 0;border:1px solid #3f5865;background:#111f29;border-radius:5px}.v15-shiptile.selected,.v15-regtile.selected,.v15-equipment button.selected{border-color:#d7b277;background:#36402f}.v15-shiptile img,.v15-regtile img{width:125px;height:78px;object-fit:cover;background:#ad9d80;border:1px solid #9f885c}.v15-shiptile b,.v15-regtile b{font:700 15px Georgia,serif;color:#f1d7a0;display:block}.v15-shiptile small,.v15-regtile small{display:block;color:#b0c1c8;margin:5px 0}
.v15-shiptitle{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;align-items:center}.v15-shiptitle h3{font:700 27px Georgia,serif!important;margin:0!important}.v15-shipimage{position:relative;margin:10px 0;border:2px solid #b59665;border-radius:7px;overflow:hidden;background:#2c4654}.v15-shipimage>img{display:block;width:100%;height:215px;object-fit:cover}.v15-shipimage>div{position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;display:flex;justify-content:space-around;gap:5px;background:#0b131bdc;padding:10px 5px;color:#edd8aa}
.v15-shipactions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px;margin:10px 0 15px}.v15-batteries{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:7px}.v15-batteries>div{display:grid;border:1px solid #5d523f;padding:5px;border-radius:5px;background:#13202b}.v15-batteries img{width:100%;height:90px;object-fit:cover;background:#bfac88}.v15-batteries span{color:#b7c5ca;font-size:11px;margin-top:5px}.v15-batteries b{color:#ead4a6}
.v15-gauge{display:grid;grid-template-columns:105px 1fr 64px;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin:7px 0;font-size:11px}.v15-gauge>span{color:#c3cbd0}.v15-gauge>i{display:block;height:10px;background:#111923;border:1px solid #485d66;overflow:hidden;border-radius:8px}.v15-gauge>i>b{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:8px}.v15-gauge strong{text-align:right;color:#e7d5a9}
.v15-regscene{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 125px;gap:10px;border:1px solid #716142;padding:8px;background:#182938;margin-bottom:10px}.v15-regscene>img{width:100%;height:180px;object-fit:cover;background:#c9b99c}.v15-regscene>div img{width:105px;height:145px;object-fit:cover;border:1px solid #c4a46f}.v15-regscene>div strong{font:700 14px Georgia,serif;color:#e7d5a9;display:block;margin:0 0 6px}
.v15-equipment{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:7px}.v15-equipment>button{background:#1b2b36;border:1px solid #615238;padding:5px;text-align:left}.v15-equipment img{width:100%;height:85px;object-fit:cover;background:#ccb895}.v15-equipment b,.v15-equipment small{display:block}.v15-equipment b{color:#ead2a3;margin:4px 0}.v15-equipment small{color:#adbec5;font-size:10px}
.v15-numbers{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;margin:5px 0 15px}.v15-numbers>div{padding:12px;border:1px solid #6e583a;background:#14222c}.v15-numbers small{display:block;color:#afc2c8}.v15-numbers b{font:700 22px Georgia,serif;color:#edd5a4}
.v15-techgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}.v15-technode{padding:7px;border:1px solid #635237;border-radius:6px;background:#15242f}.v15-technode.done{outline:1px solid #769e70}.v15-technode.available{outline:1px solid #c1a06a}.v15-techpicture img{width:100%;height:130px;object-fit:cover;background:#bdb098;border:1px solid #b29765}.v15-technode>b{display:block;font:700 16px Georgia,serif;color:#efd9aa;margin:8px 0 3px}.v15-technode>small{display:block;color:#a6b9c1;font-size:11px;margin-bottom:6px}.v15-effect{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;font-size:11px;margin:4px 0}.v15-effect strong{color:#95d1a3}.v15-techfoot{display:flex;gap:5px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin:10px 0 0}.v15-techfoot button{font-size:11px}
.v15-stockgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px}.v15-stockgrid>div,.v15-linegrid>div{padding:10px;border:1px solid #594930;background:#14232e;border-radius:6px}.v15-stockgrid strong,.v15-stockgrid b,.v15-stockgrid span{display:block}.v15-stockgrid strong{font-size:11px;color:#aebfc5}.v15-stockgrid b{font:700 25px Georgia,serif;color:#efdcac}.v15-stockgrid span{font-size:10px;color:#8aa1a9}.v15-linegrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}.v15-linegrid img{width:100%;height:95px;object-fit:cover;background:#ccb996}.v15-linegrid b,.v15-linegrid span,.v15-linegrid small{display:block;margin:5px 0}.v15-linegrid b{font:700 16px Georgia,serif;color:#ead6a8}.v15-linegrid span{color:#afc3cb}
@media(max-width:1100px){.shell{display:block!important}.shell>.v15-rail{position:static;margin-bottom:10px;max-height:none}.shell>.sidebar{display:flex!important}.v15-railhead{grid-template-columns:76px 1fr}.v15-railhead img{width:76px;height:105px}.v15-docklayout,.v15-reglayout{grid-template-columns:1fr}.v15-techgrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.v15-h-header{flex-wrap:wrap}}
@media(max-width:680px){.v15-equipment,.v15-techgrid,.v15-batteries,.v15-stockgrid,.v15-linegrid,#v15-bottomdock{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.v15-shipimage>div{font-size:10px}.v15-shiptile,.v15-regtile{grid-template-columns:100px 1fr}.v15-shiptile img,.v15-regtile img{width:100px}}
`;document.head.appendChild(style)}
v15ApplyCSS();v15Install();


/* XVI — Arsenal, military doctrine, supply ministry and modular ship variants. */
const V16_GUN_PATTERN={
 short:{name:'Короткий ствол',damage:1.08,range:.78,penetration:.83,reload:1.18,weight:.80,cost:.90,description:'Быстрый залп на малой дистанции'},
 standard:{name:'Стандартный ствол',damage:1,range:1,penetration:1,reload:1,weight:1,cost:1,description:'Универсальное орудие для линейного боя'},
 long:{name:'Длинный ствол',damage:1.13,range:1.23,penetration:1.21,reload:.81,weight:1.21,cost:1.18,description:'Повышенная дальность и пробитие'}
};

const V16_EFFECTS={};for(const [id,name,cat,req,mods,cost,eduMin] of V16_RESEARCH){
  V16_EFFECTS[id]=mods;
  if(!TECH.some(x=>x.id===id))TECH.push({id,name,cat,req,cost,time:Math.max(4,Math.ceil(cost/44)),eduMin,desc:Object.entries(mods).map(([k,v])=>`${BONUS_NAMES[k]||k}: ${v<1?'−':'+'}${Math.round(Math.abs(v-1)*100)}%`).join(' · ')});
}

const v16PriorGlobalMod=globalMod;
globalMod=function(f,k){let base=v16PriorGlobalMod(f,k);for(const id of s?.tech?.[f]||[])if(V16_EFFECTS[id]?.[k]!=null)base*=V16_EFFECTS[id][k];return base};
function v16(){if(!s)return null;s.v16||={version:16,gunRefits:[],crewDrill:[],logistics:{},seq:160000,records:[]};return s.v16}
function v16Logistics(f=s.player){let v=v16();v.logistics[f]||={autoImport:false,limits:{iron:55,steel:25,copper:30,wood:75,coal:30,saltpeter:15,sulfur:15,hemp:35,flax:30,food:90},lastMonth:''};return v.logistics[f]}
function v16SetReserve(key,qty){let p=v16Logistics(),q=Math.max(0,Math.min(500,Number(qty)||0));if(!Object.hasOwn(p.limits,key))return;p.limits[key]=q;v16Render();say(`Целевой запас: ${V8_MATERIALS[key].name} — ${q}`)}
function v16ToggleAutoImport(){const p=v16Logistics();p.autoImport=!p.autoImport;v16Render()}
function v16StockPanel(){const f=s.player,p=v16Logistics(),imports=v8get().imports.filter(i=>i.f===f),order=['iron','steel','copper','wood','coal','saltpeter','sulfur','hemp','flax','leather','food'];return `<section class="v16-ministry"><div class="v16-hero"><h3>Управление снабжением и закупками</h3><div><span class="v16-tag">${imports.length} контрактов в пути</span><button class="${p.autoImport?'v15-main':''}" onclick="v16ToggleAutoImport()">Автозакупка: ${p.autoImport?'ВКЛ':'ВЫКЛ'}</button></div></div><p class="v16-note">Задайте государственный запас для каждого материала. При включённой автозакупке казначейство раз в месяц ищет поставщика и оплачивает поставку, когда запасы ниже нормы. Все заказы подчиняются существующим ограничениям казны, торговых конвоев и военного положения.</p><div class="v16-resourcegrid">${order.map(k=>{let stock=v8stock(f,k),target=p.limits[k]??0,m=V8_MATERIALS[k],pct=target?Math.min(100,stock/target*100):100;return `<div class="v16-resource"><div class="v16-rhead"><span class="v16-resourceico" style="background:${m.tint}">${esc(m.icon||k.slice(0,2))}</span><div><b>${esc(m.name)}</b><small>${m.unit} · ${m.price} ◈/ед.</small></div><strong class="${stock<target?'v16-short':''}">${Math.round(stock*10)/10}</strong></div><div class="v16-track"><i style="width:${pct}%;background:${stock<target?'#ce8a60':'#8eb69b'}"></i></div><div class="v16-res-controls"><label>Целевой запас <input type="number" min="0" max="500" step="5" value="${target}" onchange="v16SetReserve('${k}',this.value)"></label><button onclick="v8import('${k}',25);v16Render()">Купить 25</button></div></div>`}).join('')}</div><div class="v16-two"><section><h3>В пути</h3>${imports.slice(0,8).map(i=>`<div class="v16-row"><span>${esc(V8_MATERIALS[i.resource||i.material]?.name||i.resource||i.material||'Ресурс')}</span><b>${Math.round(i.qty||i.amount||0)} · ${i.days||0} дн.</b></div>`).join('')||'<p>Действующих импортных заказов нет.</p>'}</section><section><h3>Производственные узкие места</h3>${v8get().lines.filter(l=>l.f===f&&l.blocked).map(l=>`<div class="v16-row"><span>${esc(V6_EQUIP[l.key]?.name||l.key)}</span><b class="v16-short">${esc(l.blocked)}</b></div>`).join('')||'<p>Все активные линии обеспечены сырьём.</p>'}</section></div></section>`}
function v16ImportMonth(){const f=s.player,p=v16Logistics(f),month=`${s.year}-${s.month}`;if(!p.autoImport||p.lastMonth===month||s.day!==2)return;p.lastMonth=month;let n=0;for(const [k,target] of Object.entries(p.limits)){if(n>=2||s.gold[f]<100)break;let available=v8stock(f,k);if(available>=target*.7)continue;let qty=Math.max(25,Math.min(100,Math.ceil((target-available)/25)*25));let previous=v8get().imports.length;v8import(k,qty);if(v8get().imports.length>previous)n++}}
function v16Formation(id,type){const r=v15Regiments(selected).find(x=>x.id===id);if(!r||!V16_FORMATIONS[type])return;if(type==='square'&&REGIMENTS[r.type]?.type!=='Пехота')return say('Каре доступно только пехоте');if(type==='skirmish'&&REGIMENTS[r.type]?.type!=='Пехота')return say('Рассыпной строй доступен пехоте');r.formation=type;v16Render()}
function v16Resupply(id){const r=v15Regiments(selected).find(x=>x.id===id),f=s.player;if(!r||!own(selected))return;let inv=s.equipment[f];let powderCost=r.type.includes('art')?8:3;let foodCost=3;if((inv.gunpowder||0)<powderCost||s.food[f]<foodCost)return say(`Нужно: ${powderCost} пороха и ${foodCost} провианта`);inv.gunpowder-=powderCost;s.food[f]-=foodCost;r.ammo=Math.min(100,(r.ammo??60)+35);r.fatigue=Math.max(0,(r.fatigue||0)-12);v16Render();drawAll()}
const v16OldPower=power;
power=function(p,f,attack=false,where=0){let base=v16OldPower(p,f,attack,where);if(!p?.v15Regiments?.length)return base;let reg=p.v15Regiments,mods=reg.map(r=>{let m=V16_FORMATIONS[r.formation||'line']||V16_FORMATIONS.line;let q=(attack?m.atk:m.def),fat=Math.max(.7,1-(r.fatigue||0)/350),ammo=Math.max(.67,(r.ammo??100)/100);return q*fat*ammo});return base*mods.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/Math.max(1,mods.length)};
function v16RegPanel(){const r=v15SelectedReg(),base=v16PriorReg();if(!r)return base;const formation=r.formation||'line';const form=V16_FORMATIONS[formation];const rep=`<section class="v16-regtools"><div class="v16-hero"><h3>Тактическая организация: ${esc(r.name)}</h3><span class="v16-tag">${REGIMENTS[r.type]?.type||'Полк'}</span></div><div class="v16-formgrid">${Object.entries(V16_FORMATIONS).filter(([k])=>!['square','skirmish'].includes(k)||REGIMENTS[r.type]?.type==='Пехота').map(([k,z])=>`<button class="${k===formation?'v16-on':''}" onclick="v16Formation(${r.id},'${k}')"><b>${z.name}</b><small>Атака ${Math.round((z.atk-1)*100)}% · Оборона ${Math.round((z.def-1)*100)}% · Марш ${Math.round((z.speed-1)*100)}%</small></button>`).join('')}</div><div class="v16-metgrid"><div><b>Боеприпасы</b>${v15Gauge('Запас',r.ammo??65,100,'#b1c68a',`${r.ammo??65}%`)}</div><div><b>Усталость</b>${v15Gauge('Усталость',r.fatigue||0,100,'#c78979',`${r.fatigue||0}%`)}</div><div><b>Строй</b><strong>${form.name}</strong></div></div><button class="v15-main" onclick="v16Resupply(${r.id})">Пополнить боеприпасы со склада (3–8 пороха, 3 провианта)</button></section>`;return base+rep}
function v16CrewSchool(id){let sh=s.ships.find(x=>x.id===id&&x.f===s.player),v=v16();if(!sh)return;if(v.crewDrill.some(x=>x.shipId===id))return say('Экипаж уже проходит учения');if(s.gold[s.player]<35||s.food[s.player]<5||(s.equipment[s.player].gunpowder||0)<2)return say('Нужно 35 монет, 5 провианта и 2 пороха');s.gold[s.player]-=35;s.food[s.player]-=5;s.equipment[s.player].gunpowder-=2;v.crewDrill.push({shipId:id,remaining:28});log(`${sh.name}: тренировка артиллеристов, 28 дней.`);v16Render();drawAll()}
function v16GunStats(c,pattern='standard',f=s.player){let p=V16_GUN_PATTERN[pattern]||V16_GUN_PATTERN.standard;return {damage:c.atk*p.damage*globalMod(f,'gunDamage'),penetration:c.lb*p.penetration*globalMod(f,'gunPen'),range:c.range*p.range*globalMod(f,'gunRange'),reload:c.reload/(p.reload*globalMod(f,'gunReload')),weight:c.weight*p.weight,cost:c.iron*p.cost}}
function v16Refit(id,pattern){let sh=s.ships.find(x=>x.id===id&&x.f===s.player),p=V16_GUN_PATTERN[pattern],v=v16();if(!sh||!p)return;if(pattern==='long'&&!has(s.player,'v16_long_barrel'))return say('Исследуйте длинные корабельные стволы');if(pattern==='short'&&!has(s.player,'v16_light_guns'))return say('Исследуйте облегчённые лафеты');if(v.gunRefits.some(x=>x.shipId===id))return say('Корабль уже находится на перевооружении');if(!N[sh.port]?.port||s.provinces[sh.port]?.owner!==sh.f)return say('Перевооружение возможно только в своём порту');if(v8get().seaOrders.some(o=>s.fleets.find(f=>f.id===o.fleetId&&f.id===sh.fleetId)))return say('Верните эскадру в порт');const count=(sh.design?.batteries||[]).reduce((a,b)=>a+b.count,0);let steel=Math.ceil(count*.035),wood=Math.ceil(count*.12),iron=Math.ceil(count*.12),gold=Math.ceil(count*.8);if(s.steel[s.player]<steel||s.wood[s.player]<wood||s.iron[s.player]<iron||s.gold[s.player]<gold)return say(`Нужно ${gold} монет, ${steel} стали, ${wood} дерева и ${iron} железа`);s.steel[s.player]-=steel;s.wood[s.player]-=wood;s.iron[s.player]-=iron;s.gold[s.player]-=gold;v.gunRefits.push({shipId:id,pattern,remaining:Math.max(8,Math.ceil(count*.25))});log(`${sh.name}: модернизация батарей начата.`);v16Render();drawAll()}
function v16GunPanel(sh){const pattern=sh.v16Pattern||'standard',guns=(sh.design?.batteries||[]).reduce((a,b)=>a+b.count,0);const primary=sh.design?.batteries?.find(x=>x.count>0),base=CANNONS.find(c=>c.id===primary?.gun)||CANNONS[2];const active=v16().gunRefits.find(x=>x.shipId===sh.id),drill=v16().crewDrill.find(x=>x.shipId===sh.id);return `<section class="v16-gunfit"><div class="v16-hero"><h3>Батареи и артиллерийская школа</h3><div class="v16-tag">${guns} орудий · ${esc(V16_GUN_PATTERN[pattern].name)}</div></div><div class="v16-presetgrid">${Object.entries(V16_GUN_PATTERN).map(([k,v])=>{const z=v16GunStats(base,k,sh.f);return `<div class="v16-pattern ${pattern===k?'v16-on':''}"><img src="${(typeof V6_ART!=='undefined'&&(V6_ART[primary?.gun]||V6_ART.gun12||V6_ART.cannon))||''}" alt=""><b>${v.name}</b><small>${v.description}</small>${v16Metric('Дальность',z.range,1500,Math.round(z.range)+' м','#77b6c6')}${v16Metric('Пробитие',z.penetration,70,Math.round(z.penetration),'#ceba6f')}${v16Metric('Огонь',z.damage,11,z.damage.toFixed(1),'#a4c28b')}${v16Metric('Перезарядка',1/z.reload,2,(z.reload*10).toFixed(1)+' с','#d5927d')}<button ${pattern===k||!!active?'disabled':''} onclick="v16Refit(${sh.id},'${k}')">${pattern===k?'Установлено':'Переоснастить'}</button></div>`}).join('')}</div>${active?`<p class="v16-note">Перевооружение: ${active.remaining} дн. Остатки материалов уже списаны.</p>`:''}<div class="v16-hero"><h3>Экипаж и обучение</h3><button onclick="v16CrewSchool(${sh.id})" ${drill?'disabled':''}>${drill?'Учения: '+drill.remaining+' дней':'Учебный выход · 28 дней'}</button></div>${v15Gauge('Опыт артиллеристов',sh.gunnery||0,100,'#b1c78d')}${v15Gauge('Мореходная подготовка',sh.seamanship||0,100,'#85abc5')}</section>`}
function v16Metric(label,value,max,display,color){return `<div class="v16-meter"><span>${label}</span><i><i style="width:${Math.max(5,Math.min(100,value/max*100))}%;background:${color}"></i></i><strong>${display}</strong></div>`}
const v16OldShipPower=v6shipPower;
v6shipPower=function(sh,admiral){let pow=v16OldShipPower(sh,admiral);const p=V16_GUN_PATTERN[sh?.v16Pattern||'standard']||V16_GUN_PATTERN.standard;return pow*p.damage*p.penetration*(.80+.002*(sh?.gunnery||0))/.80};
const v16PriorCannonStats=v15CannonStats;
v15CannonStats=function(c,f=0){let out=v16PriorCannonStats(c,f);return {...out,penetration:out.penetration*globalMod(f,'gunPen'),range:out.range*globalMod(f,'gunRange')}};
// Tactical broadside: preserve the original target, ammunition and broadside-sector rules; override calibre model.
const v16PriorFire=v8fire;
v8fire=function(u){if(!V8_SCENE||V8_SCENE.kind!=='sea'||u.kind!=='ship')return v16PriorFire(u);let sc=V8_SCENE;if(u.hp<=0||u.cooldown>0)return;const enemy=sc.units.filter(z=>z.team!==u.team&&z.hp>0).sort((a,b)=>Math.hypot(a.pos[0]-u.pos[0],a.pos[1]-u.pos[1])-Math.hypot(b.pos[0]-u.pos[0],b.pos[1]-u.pos[1]))[0];if(!enemy)return;const sh=s.ships.find(x=>x.id===u.shipId),f=sh?.f??s.player,rows=u.design?.batteries?.filter(x=>x.count>0)||[];if(!rows.length)return v16PriorFire(u);const pat=sh?.v16Pattern||'standard',arr=rows.map(r=>({n:r.count,st:v16GunStats(CANNONS.find(c=>c.id===r.gun)||CANNONS[0],pat,f)})),count=arr.reduce((a,z)=>a+z.n,0);if(!count)return;const dist=Math.hypot(u.pos[0]-enemy.pos[0],u.pos[1]-enemy.pos[1]),range=Math.max(...arr.map(z=>z.st.range))/12;if(dist>range)return;const theta=Math.atan2(enemy.pos[1]-u.pos[1],enemy.pos[0]-u.pos[0]),bearing=Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(theta-u.angle),Math.cos(theta-u.angle)));if(bearing<Math.PI*.19||bearing>Math.PI*.88)return;if(u.ammo==null)u.ammo=100;if(u.ammo<1)return;const power=arr.reduce((a,z)=>a+z.st.damage*z.n/2,0),penetration=arr.reduce((a,z)=>a+z.st.penetration*z.n,0)/count,reload=arr.reduce((a,z)=>a+z.st.reload*z.n,0)/count,armor=(enemy.type==='line'?25:enemy.type==='frigate'?15:enemy.type==='transport'?6:9)*Math.max(.6,enemy.hp/Math.max(1,enemy.maxHp||enemy.hp)),pen=Math.min(1.35,Math.max(.28,penetration/Math.max(1,armor))),crew=Math.max(.35,(sh?.crew||u.crew||70)/Math.max(1,sh?.crewMax||u.crewMax||100)),accuracy=Math.max(.10,(1-dist/(range*1.45))*(.67+Math.random()*.33))*(1+.0025*(sh?.gunnery||0))*globalMod(f,'gunAccuracy');const hit=Math.max(.5,power*.16*pen*accuracy*crew);enemy.hp=Math.max(0,enemy.hp-hit);u.cooldown=Math.max(2,reload*4.8/(1+.002*(sh?.gunnery||0)));u.ammo-=1;sc.smoke ||= [];for(let j=0;j<7;j++)sc.smoke.push({x:u.pos[0]+Math.random()*1.7,y:u.pos[1]+Math.random()*1.7,z:1+Math.random()*2,age:0});if(u.team==='friendly'&&v8Battle)v8Battle.lastHit=`${u.name} → ${enemy.name}: ${hit.toFixed(1)} урона · пробитие ${Math.round(pen*100)}%`};
const v16PriorMesh=v8shipMesh;
v8shipMesh=function(type='frigate',design=null){let m=v16PriorMesh(type,design);const r=v15Random(v15Hash('XVI|'+(design?.modelSeed||design?.id||design?.name||type)));const size=type==='line'?1.55:type==='frigate'?1.1:type==='transport'?1.16:.82,L=11*size,W=(type==='line'?3.4:2.8)*size;const gild=['#e3c27b','#b2ae99','#e3ad6a','#a8bbb8'][Math.floor(r()*4)];let trim=3+Math.floor(r()*4);for(let sgn of [-1,1]){for(let j=0;j<trim;j++){let x=-L*.42+(j+.5)*L*.76/trim;v8seg(m,[x,sgn*W*.43,-.12*size],[x+.08*size,sgn*W*.43,.26*size],gild,.5)}for(let j=0;j<4;j++){let x=-L*.38+(j+.5)*L*.74/4;v8cube(m,x,sgn*W*.38,.29*size,.19*size,.02*size,.07*size,gild)}}const flagR=r();for(let j=0;j<3;j++){const x=(-.13+j*.19)*L;v8seg(m,[x,0,5.1*size+j*.1*size],[x+(flagR-.5)*.8*size,.1*size,5.7*size+j*.1*size],'#eadab3',.75)}return m};
const v16PriorAdvance=advanceDay;
advanceDay=function(){v16PriorAdvance();if(!s||s.ended)return;const v=v16();for(let a of v.gunRefits){a.remaining--;if(a.remaining<=0){let sh=s.ships.find(x=>x.id===a.shipId);if(sh){sh.v16Pattern=a.pattern;log(`${sh.name}: переоснащение батарей завершено — ${V16_GUN_PATTERN[a.pattern].name}.`)}}}v.gunRefits=v.gunRefits.filter(x=>x.remaining>0);for(let a of v.crewDrill){a.remaining--;if(a.remaining<=0){let sh=s.ships.find(x=>x.id===a.shipId);if(sh){sh.gunnery=Math.min(100,(sh.gunnery||0)+12);sh.seamanship=Math.min(100,(sh.seamanship||0)+9);log(`${sh.name}: артиллерийские учения завершены. Навыки экипажа повышены.`)}}}v.crewDrill=v.crewDrill.filter(x=>x.remaining>0);if(s.day===2)v16ImportMonth()};
const v16PriorReg=v15RegPanel;
v15RegPanel=v16RegPanel;
const v16PriorShipPanel=v15ShipPanel;
v15ShipPanel=function(){let base=v16PriorShipPanel(),sh=s.ships.find(x=>x.id===v15ShipId&&x.f===s.player);return base+(sh?v16GunPanel(sh):'')};

/* XVI-2 — geographic LOD and non-random operational AI. */
function v16MapLabels(){
 const z=Math.max(1,typeof zoom==='number'?zoom:1);
 for(const node of document.querySelectorAll('#towns .majorlabel')){
   node.style.setProperty('font',`700 ${(node.classList.contains('subtle')?13:19)/z}px Georgia,serif`,'important');
   node.style.setProperty('stroke-width',2.6/z+'px','important');
   node.style.setProperty('letter-spacing',Math.max(.06,.8/z)+'px','important');
 }
 for(const node of document.querySelectorAll('#seanames .sea-label')){
   node.style.setProperty('font',`italic ${17/z}px Georgia,serif`,'important');
   node.style.setProperty('stroke-width',1.2/z+'px','important');
 }
}
const v16PriorScaleLabel=v6scaleLabel;

updateTransform=function(){v16OldUpdateTransform();v16MapLabels()};

function v16StrategicAITurn(){
 for(let f=0;f<F.length;f++){
  if(f===s.player)continue;
  const provinces=regOf(f);if(!provinces.length)continue;
  const isAtWar=s.wars.some(x=>x.split(':').includes(String(f)));
  const border=provinces.filter(x=>N[x.i].adj.some(j=>withWar(f,s.provinces[j].owner)));
  const food=s.food[f],iron=s.iron[f],gold=s.gold[f],wood=s.wood[f];
  const role=NATIONAL[f]?.quality||'court';
  // Deliberate industry investment: explicit costs, scarcity-aware, one additional decision per quarter.
  if(food<90&&gold>=75&&wood>=21){
   let best=provinces.filter(x=>x.p.farm<5).sort((a,b)=>b.i===CAP[f]?1:a.i===CAP[f]?-1:b.p.market-a.p.market)[0];
   if(best){best.p.farm++;s.gold[f]-=75;s.wood[f]-=21;}
  }else if(iron<55&&gold>=125&&wood>=24){
   let best=provinces.filter(x=>x.p.workshop<4).sort((a,b)=>b.p.road-a.p.road)[0];
   if(best){best.p.workshop++;s.gold[f]-=125;s.wood[f]-=24;}
  }else if(border.length&&food>=80&&gold>=105&&wood>=30){
   let best=border.sort((a,b)=>(b.p.depot?0:1)-(a.p.depot?0:1))[0];
   if(best&&best.p.depot<3){best.p.depot++;s.gold[f]-=95;s.wood[f]-=30;}
  }
  // Replace indiscriminate research only when the AI has no project and an appropriate reserve.
  if(!s.research[f]&&gold>250){
   let categories=isAtWar?['Логистика','Артиллерия и осады','Пехотные формирования']:role==='navy'?['Кораблестроение','Морская артиллерия','Флот']:role==='research'?['Образование','Хозяйство']:['Хозяйство','Государственные реформы','Логистика'];
   const candidates=TECH.filter(t=>!has(f,t.id)&&techAccessible(f,t)&&t.cost+95<=s.gold[f]);
   candidates.sort((a,b)=>{let sa=(categories.includes(a.cat)?100:0)+(a.eduMin||0)*.05-a.cost*.05, sb=(categories.includes(b.cat)?100:0)+(b.eduMin||0)*.05-b.cost*.05;return sb-sa});
   const choice=candidates[0];if(choice){s.gold[f]-=choice.cost;let days=researchDays(choice,f);s.research[f]={id:choice.id,remaining:days,total:days}}
  }
 }
}
const v16OldComputerTurn=computerTurn;
computerTurn=function(){v16OldComputerTurn();v16StrategicAITurn()};

save=function(){try{v16();v8get();localStorage.setItem(V16_SAVE_KEY,JSON.stringify(s));say('Кампания XVI сохранена')}catch(e){say('Локальное сохранение недоступно: используйте экспорт JSON')}};
load=function(){try{let raw=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(V16_SAVE_KEY)||localStorage.getItem(V10_SAVE_KEY)||'null');if(!raw)throw Error('Нет сохранения');restoreSave(raw);v16();drawAll();say('Кампания XVI загружена')}catch(e){say('Загрузка не удалась: '+e.message)}};
saveQuiet=function(){try{if(s){v16();localStorage.setItem(V16_SAVE_KEY,JSON.stringify(s))}}catch(e){}};
// Gunnery refits also affect actual sailing speed through the existing fleet movement calculator.
const v16OldFleetSpeed=v8fleetSpeed;
v8fleetSpeed=function(fleet){const speed=v16OldFleetSpeed(fleet),members=v8shipsOf(fleet);if(!members?.length)return speed;const factor=Math.min(...members.map(sh=>sh.v16Pattern==='long'?.955:sh.v16Pattern==='short'?1.035:1));return Math.max(2.5,speed*factor)};

function v17State(){if(!s)return null;if(!s.v17)s.v17={version:17,policies:{},policyCooldown:{},selectedDesign:null,seed:171700,events:[],allocation:{}};return s.v17}
const v17PriorMod=globalMod;
globalMod=function(f,k){let v=v17PriorMod(f,k);const p=V17_POLICIES[v17State()?.policies?.[f]||'balanced'];if(p?.mods?.[k]!=null)v*=p.mods[k];for(const t of V17_TECHS){if(has(f,t[0])&&t[7][k]!=null)v*=t[7][k]}return v};
function v17SetPolicy(key){if(!V17_POLICIES[key])return;const v=v17State(),f=s.player,now=s.turn||0;if(v.policyCooldown[f]>now)return say('Недавно изменена государственная политика. Дождитесь следующего квартала.');if((s.gold[f]||0)<130||s.action<1)return say('Нужно 130 монет и один дипломатический указ');s.gold[f]-=130;s.action--;v.policies[f]=key;v.policyCooldown[f]=now+1;s.stability[f]=clamp(s.stability[f]+V17_POLICIES[key].stability,0,100);log(`Утверждена государственная доктрина «${V17_POLICIES[key].name}».`);v15Render();drawAll()}
function v17PolicyPanel(){const f=s.player,v=v17State(),active=v.policies[f]||'balanced',modFmt=(k,m)=>`<div class="v17-mod"><span>${esc(BONUS_NAMES[k]||k)}</span><b class="${m<1?'v17-favorable':'v17-positive'}">${m<1?'−':'+'}${Math.round(Math.abs(1-m)*100)}%</b></div>`;return `<div class="v17-policy"><div class="v17-sectionhead"><h2>Совет министров</h2><small>Государственные приоритеты влияют на действующие расчёты экономики и военного дела</small></div><div class="v17-policygrid">${Object.entries(V17_POLICIES).map(([key,p])=>`<section class="v17-policycard ${active===key?'chosen':''}"><div class="v17-policy-plate"><img src="${v17Icon(key)}" alt="Государственная доктрина"></div><h3>${p.name}</h3><p>${p.desc}</p>${Object.entries(p.mods).map(([k,m])=>modFmt(k,m)).join('')||'<div class="v17-mod">Без дополнительных модификаторов</div>'}<button ${active===key?'disabled':''} onclick="v17SetPolicy('${key}')">${active===key?'Действующая политика':'Утвердить · 130 ◈'}</button></section>`).join('')}</div><div class="v17-status-note">Перемена доктрины расходует один государственный указ и 130 монет. При нескольких бонусах итог рассчитывается как произведение коэффициентов.</div></div>`}

 cavalrySabre:{name:'Кавалерийская сабля',bonus:{attack:1.10,defence:1.01},count:75,tech:null,category:'Конница'},
 uniform:{name:'Полковое обмундирование',bonus:{defence:1.04,morale:1.05},count:120,tech:null,category:'Все части'},
 wagon:{name:'Полковой обоз',bonus:{supply:1.13,defence:1.02},count:1,tech:'roads',category:'Все части'}
};
function v17KitFactor(r,kind){let x=1;for(const item of Object.values(r?.v17Kit||{})){if(!item?.key)continue;let a=V17_ACCESSORIES[item.key];if(a)x*=1+((a.bonus[kind]||1)-1)*Math.min(1,item.count/(item.key==='wagon'?1:Math.max(1,r.headcount||800)))}return x}
function v17EquipAccessory(id,key){const reg=v15Regiments(selected).find(r=>r.id===id),item=V17_ACCESSORIES[key];if(!reg||!item||!own(selected))return;if(item.tech&&!has(s.player,item.tech))return say('Требуется соответствующее исследование');const type=REGIMENTS[reg.type]?.type||'Пехота';if(type==='Конница'&&key==='bayonet')return say('Штыки предназначены пехоте');const inv=s.equipment[s.player]||{},slot=key==='wagon'?'support':key==='uniform'?'clothing':'melee';reg.v17Kit||={};const old=reg.v17Kit[slot];if(old){inv[old.key]=(inv[old.key]||0)+old.count;delete reg.v17Kit[slot]};if(old?.key===key){v15Render();drawAll();return}let required=key==='wagon'?1:Math.max(1,reg.headcount||800);let qty=Math.min(required,Math.max(0,Math.floor(inv[key]||0)));if(qty<=0){if(old){reg.v17Kit[slot]=old;inv[old.key]-=old.count}return say('На складе недостаточно снаряжения: '+item.name)}inv[key]-=qty;reg.v17Kit[slot]={key,count:qty};log(reg.name+': выдано '+item.name+' ('+qty+').');v15Render();drawAll()}
function v17AccessoryPanel(){const reg=v15SelectedReg();if(!reg)return '';const inventory=s.equipment[s.player]||{};return `<section class="v17-outfit"><div class="v17-sectionhead"><h3>Полковое оснащение и вспомогательные предметы</h3><small>Предметы списываются со склада. Сила полка зависит от выданного количества.</small></div><div class="v17-kitgrid">${Object.entries(V17_ACCESSORIES).map(([key,a])=>{let selected=Object.values(reg.v17Kit||{}).some(x=>x?.key===key);return `<div class="v17-kit"><img src="${v17Icon(key)}" alt=""><strong>${a.name}</strong><small>Склад: ${Math.floor(inventory[key]||0)} · штат ${key==='wagon'?1:(reg.headcount||800)}</small>${Object.entries(a.bonus).map(([k,v])=>`<div class="v17-mod"><span>${{attack:'Атака',defence:'Оборона',morale:'Мораль',supply:'Снабжение'}[k]}</span><b>+${Math.round((v-1)*100)}%</b></div>`).join('')}<button onclick="v17EquipAccessory(${reg.id},'${key}')">${selected?'Снять со склада':'Выдать полку'}</button></div>`}).join('')}</div><div class="v17-kit-summary">Действующие бонусы полка: атака +${Math.round((v17KitFactor(reg,'attack')-1)*100)}%, оборона +${Math.round((v17KitFactor(reg,'defence')-1)*100)}%, мораль +${Math.round((v17KitFactor(reg,'morale')-1)*100)}%.</div></section>`}
const v17OldRegPanel=v15RegPanel;
v15RegPanel=function(){return v17OldRegPanel()+v17AccessoryPanel()};
const v17OldPower=power;
power=function(p,f,attack=false,where=0){let val=v17OldPower(p,f,attack,where);if(!p?.v15Regiments?.length)return val;const factors=p.v15Regiments.map(r=>v17KitFactor(r,attack?'attack':'defence'));return val*factors.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/factors.length};
// Commissioned ships keep their original blueprint; new blueprints can have generated hull variants.
function v17NewSeed(){let v=v17State();v.seed=(Math.imul(v.seed,1664525)+1013904223)>>>0;return v.seed}
function v17SelectBlueprint(id){v17State().selectedDesign=id;v15Render()}
function v17Blueprint(){let designs=s.shipDesigns.filter(d=>d.f===s.player),v=v17State();return designs.find(x=>x.id===v.selectedDesign)||designs[0]||null}

 const before=s.shipDesigns.length;

Для постройки потребуются исследования, верфь, материалы и орудия.</small></div><div class="v17-design-grid"><div class="v17-canvas-shell"><canvas id="v17-preview" width="880" height="400"></canvas><div class="v17-overprint">Вращайте модель мышью · колесо — масштаб · параметры корпуса сохраняются в чертеже</div></div><div class="v17-design-controls"><h3>${d?esc(d.name):'Нет проекта'}</h3>${!d?`<div class="v17-note">Для чертежа нужен назначенный министр кораблестроения, достаточное образование и исследования корпуса. <button onclick="v15Close();tab='court';drawAll()">Открыть государственный совет</button></div>`:''}<select onchange="v17SelectBlueprint(+this.value)">${selection||'<option>Проектов нет</option>'}</select><div class="v17-buttonrow"><button onclick="v17CreateBlueprint('sloop')">+ Шлюп</button><button onclick="v17CreateBlueprint('frigate')">+ Фрегат</button><button onclick="v17CreateBlueprint('line')">+ Линейный</button></div><button class="v15-main" ${!d?'disabled':''} onclick="v17RandomizeBlueprint()">Новый вариант обводов и украшений</button>${st?`<div class="v17-mod"><span>Орудия на чертеже</span><b>${st.guns}</b></div><div class="v17-mod"><span>Расчётная скорость</span><b>${st.speed?.toFixed(1)||'—'} уз.</b></div><div class="v17-mod"><span>Экипаж</span><b>${st.crewMax||'—'}</b></div><div class="v17-mod"><span>Вариант корпуса</span><b>#${d.modelSeed||0}</b></div><div class="v17-mod"><span>Стоимость</span><b>${st.gold||'—'} ◈</b></div>`:''}<div class="v17-note">Изменение художественного варианта корпуса само по себе не меняет боевые характеристики. Их определяют чертёж батарей, технологии, материалы и экипаж.</div></div></div></section>`}
const v17OldShipPanel=v15ShipPanel;
function v17AdmiralCard(){const fl=s.fleets.find(x=>x.f===s.player),ad=V6_ADMIRALS[fl?.admiral??0];if(!fl||!ad)return '';const portrait=v15Portrait(ad.name,'Адмирал');return `<section class="v17-admiral"><img src="${portrait}" alt="Портрет адмирала"><div><small>Командование действующей эскадрой</small><h3>${esc(ad.name)}</h3><b>${esc(fl.name)}</b><div class="v17-admiralmods">${Object.entries(ad.mod||{}).map(([k,v])=>`<div class="v17-mod"><span>${BONUS_NAMES[k]||k}</span><b>${v<1?'−':'+'}${Math.round(Math.abs(v-1)*100)}%</b></div>`).join('')}</div></div></section>`}

// Same 3D triangle mesh as the in-game viewer; a live turntable embedded in shipyard.
let V17_CAM={yaw:.64,pitch:.48,zoom:1.0,frame:0};
function v17DrawModel(){const c=document.getElementById('v17-preview'),d=v17Blueprint();if(!c)return;const ctx=c.getContext('2d');if(!ctx)return;ctx.fillStyle='#102636';ctx.fillRect(0,0,c.width,c.height);if(!d){ctx.fillStyle='#d7bc81';ctx.font='22px Georgia';ctx.fillText('Выберите новый проект корпуса',40,180);return}
 const mesh=v8shipMesh(d.type,d),w=c.width,h=c.height,yaw=V17_CAM.yaw,pitch=V17_CAM.pitch,cy=Math.cos(yaw),sy=Math.sin(yaw),cp=Math.cos(pitch),sp=Math.sin(pitch),scale=(d.type==='line'?12:d.type==='frigate'?16:18)*V17_CAM.zoom;
 const project=(p)=>{const x=p[0]*cy-p[1]*sy,z=p[0]*sy+p[1]*cy;return {x:w*.5+x*scale,y:h*.62+(z*sp-p[2]*cp)*scale,depth:z*cp+p[2]*sp}};
 const faces=mesh.faces.map(t=>{const pts=t.p.map(project);return {pts,d:pts.reduce((a,p)=>a+p.depth,0)/3,color:t.color}}).sort((a,b)=>a.d-b.d);
 for(const f of faces){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(f.pts[0].x,f.pts[0].y);for(const p of f.pts.slice(1))ctx.lineTo(p.x,p.y);ctx.closePath();ctx.fillStyle=f.color;ctx.fill();ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(18,21,24,.17)';ctx.lineWidth=.45;ctx.stroke()}
 for(const segment of mesh.segments){let a=project(segment.a),b=project(segment.b);ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(a.x,a.y);ctx.lineTo(b.x,b.y);ctx.strokeStyle=segment.color;ctx.lineWidth=Math.max(.55,segment.w||1);ctx.stroke()}
}
function v17InitCanvas(){const c=document.getElementById('v17-preview');if(!c)return;if(c.dataset.ready!=='1'){c.dataset.ready='1';let down=null;c.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{down=[e.clientX,e.clientY];c.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId)});c.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(!down)return;V17_CAM.yaw+=(e.clientX-down[0])*.008;V17_CAM.pitch=Math.max(.08,Math.min(1.1,V17_CAM.pitch+(e.clientY-down[1])*.005));down=[e.clientX,e.clientY];cancelAnimationFrame(V17_CAM.frame);V17_CAM.frame=requestAnimationFrame(v17DrawModel)});c.addEventListener('pointerup',()=>down=null);c.addEventListener('wheel',e=>{e.preventDefault();V17_CAM.zoom=Math.max(.45,Math.min(2.5,V17_CAM.zoom*(e.deltaY<0?1.1:.9)));v17DrawModel()},{passive:false})}v17DrawModel()}

// Correct 3D cannon: full wooden carriage, axle, barrel taper and separate muzzle ring.
v8cannon3d=function(m,x,y,z,lb=12,side=1,scale=1){let L=(.40+lb*.009)*scale,r=(.055+lb*.0016)*scale,chassis=(.37+lb*.003)*scale;
 v8cube(m,x,y,z-.10*scale,chassis,.35*scale,.15*scale,'#875e39');v8cube(m,x,y-side*.035*scale,z-.04*scale,chassis*.9,.29*scale,.045*scale,'#ac895b');
 for(let dx of [-chassis*.32,chassis*.32]){let px=x+dx;v8cylinder(m,[px,y-.22*scale,z-.15*scale],[px,y+.22*scale,z-.15*scale],.13*scale,'#5b402b',12);v8cylinder(m,[px,y-.23*scale,z-.15*scale],[px,y-.25*scale,z-.15*scale],.05*scale,'#bd985c',12)}
 v8cylinder(m,[x,y-side*.13*scale,z+.05*scale],[x,y+side*L,z+.06*scale],r,'#333a3e',13);
 v8cylinder(m,[x,y+side*(L*.83),z+.06*scale],[x,y+side*(L*.96),z+.06*scale],r*1.20,'#42494c',13);
 v8cylinder(m,[x,y-side*.15*scale,z+.06*scale],[x,y-side*.19*scale,z+.06*scale],r*1.43,'#485052',13);
 v8seg(m,[x-chassis*.31,y-side*.12*scale,z-.03*scale],[x+chassis*.31,y-side*.12*scale,z-.03*scale],'#947244',1.3);
};

const V18_MINISTRIES={
 military:{title:'Инспекция военного ведомства',label:'Военная реформа',cost:165,mods:{armyCost:.96,infantryDef:1.05,regimentTime:.96},upkeep:7},
 navy:{title:'Реформа Адмиралтейства',label:'Морская реформа',cost:195,mods:{shipTime:.94,navalPower:1.05,gunAccuracy:1.04},upkeep:9},
 commerce:{title:'Купеческая палата',label:'Торговая реформа',cost:150,mods:{trade:1.08,arsenalCost:.97},upkeep:7},
