function v18State(){if(!s)return null;let v=s.v18;
 if(!v){v={version:18,ministries:{},projects:[],next:19000,aiTicks:0};s.v18=v}
 v.ministries ||= {};v.projects ||= [];v.next ||=19000;return v}
const v18OriginalMod=globalMod;
globalMod=function(f,key){let v=v18OriginalMod(f,key);for(const [id,_,__,___,____,_____,______,mods] of V18_TECHS){if(mods[key]!=null&&has(f,id))v*=mods[key]}
 const ministry=V18_MINISTRIES[v18State()?.ministries?.[f]];if(ministry?.mods[key]!=null)v*=ministry.mods[key];return v;};
function v18Ministry(key){const m=V18_MINISTRIES[key],f=s.player,v=v18State();if(!m)return;
 if(v.ministries[f]===key)return say('Эта комиссия уже действует');
 if(s.gold[f]<m.cost||s.action<1)return say(`Для реформы нужны ${m.cost} монет и один указ`);
 s.gold[f]-=m.cost;s.action--;v.ministries[f]=key;log('Корона учредила ведомство: '+m.title);v15Render();drawAll();}
function v18GovernmentPanel(){const f=s.player,active=v18State().ministries[f];return `<section class="v18-section"><div class="v18-h"><h2>Правительственный совет</h2><small>Реформы имеют реальные коэффициенты и постоянное жалование</small></div><div class="v18-cards">${Object.entries(V18_MINISTRIES).map(([key,m])=>`<article class="v18-card ${active===key?'is-active':''}"><div class="v18-government-art"><img src="${v15Portrait(m.title,'Государственный советник')}" alt="Министр"></div><h3>${m.title}</h3>${Object.entries(m.mods).map(([k,val])=>v18ModLine(k,val)).join('')}<div class="v18-cost">Жалование: ${m.upkeep} ◈ за квартал</div><button ${active===key?'disabled':''} onclick="v18Ministry('${key}')">${active===key?'Действует':`Утвердить · ${m.cost} ◈`}</button></article>`).join('')}</div></section>`;}
function v18ModLine(k,x){return `<div class="v18-mod"><span>${esc(BONUS_NAMES[k]||k)}</span><strong class="${x<1?'discount':'boost'}">${x<1?'−':'+'}${Math.round(Math.abs(x-1)*100)}%</strong></div>`}
// Regiment restoration: reserve people, food, and funds are actual, consumed inventory.
function v18RegStat(r){const base=REGIMENTS[r.type]||REGIMENTS.inf,quota=base.type==='Артиллерия'?120:base.type==='Конница'?500:800;
 return {base,quota,ratio:Math.max(.05,Math.min(1,(r.headcount||0)/quota)),ammo:Math.max(0,r.v18Ammo??100),fatigue:Math.max(0,r.v18Fatigue??0)};}
function v18Replenish(regId){if(!own(selected))return say('Выберите собственную провинцию');const r=v15Regiments(selected).find(x=>x.id===regId);if(!r)return;
 const o=v18RegStat(r),need=Math.max(0,o.quota-r.headcount);if(!need)return say('Численность полка полная');
 let f=s.player,reserve=s.demography?.manpower?.[selected]??0;let accepted=Math.min(need,Math.floor(reserve),Math.floor(s.gold[f]*10),Math.floor(s.food[f]*8));
 if(accepted<=0)return say('Не хватает рекрутов, денег или провианта');
 s.gold[f]-=Math.ceil(accepted/10);s.food[f]-=accepted/8;if(s.demography?.manpower)s.demography.manpower[selected]-=accepted;
 r.headcount+=accepted;r.morale=Math.min(100,(r.morale||65)+2);log(`${r.name}: пополнение +${accepted} человек, резерв провинции уменьшился.`);v15Render();drawAll();}
function v18SupplyAmmo(regId){const r=v15Regiments(selected).find(x=>x.id===regId),f=s.player;if(!r||!own(selected))return;
 const missing=Math.max(0,100-(r.v18Ammo??100)),usable=Math.min(missing,Math.floor((s.equipment[f]?.gunpowder||0)*10));
 if(usable<1)return say('Недостаточно пороха в арсенале');
 s.equipment[f].gunpowder-=usable/10;r.v18Ammo=(r.v18Ammo??100)+usable;r.v18Fatigue=Math.max(0,(r.v18Fatigue||0)-5);
 log(`${r.name}: запас боеприпасов +${usable}%, порох израсходован.`);v15Render();drawAll();}
function v18RegStatus(){const r=v15SelectedReg();if(!r)return '';const st=v18RegStat(r);return `<section class="v18-section"><div class="v18-h"><h3>Состояние полка · ${esc(r.name)}</h3><small>Фактическая численность влияет на боевую силу</small></div><div class="v18-regmetrics">${v15Gauge('Личный состав',r.headcount,st.quota,'#8cb49e',`${r.headcount} / ${st.quota}`)}${v15Gauge('Боезапас',st.ammo,100,'#d3b87d',Math.round(st.ammo)+'%')}${v15Gauge('Усталость',st.fatigue,100,'#c78077',Math.round(st.fatigue)+'%')}</div><div class="v18-controls"><button onclick="v18Replenish(${r.id})">Пополнить полк</button><button onclick="v18SupplyAmmo(${r.id})">Подвезти боеприпасы</button><button onclick="v15Train(${r.id})">Полевые учения · 21 день</button></div></section>`}
const v18OldRegPanel=v15RegPanel;
v15RegPanel=function(){return v18OldRegPanel()+v18RegStatus()};
const v18OldLandPower=power;
power=function(p,f,attack=false,where=0){let val=v18OldLandPower(p,f,attack,where);if(!p?.v15Regiments?.length)return val;
 let regs=p.v15Regiments,rat=regs.reduce((tot,r)=>{let st=v18RegStat(r);return tot+st.ratio*(.72+.28*st.ammo/100)*(1-.18*st.fatigue/100)},0)/regs.length;
 return val*(.55+.45*rat)*(attack?globalMod(f,'infAttack')/Math.max(.2,v18OriginalMod(f,'infAttack')):1);}
// Skilled ship crews require supplies and spend 24 in-game days training, then improve actual gunnery and sailing performance.
function v18CrewStatus(sh){sh.v18Crew||={sailing:Math.max(12,sh.seamanship||20),gunnery:Math.max(12,sh.gunnery||20),boarding:Math.max(12,sh.boarding||18),stamina:85};return sh.v18Crew}
function v18ShipTrain(shipId,skill){const f=s.player,sh=s.ships.find(x=>x.id===shipId&&x.f===f),v=v18State();if(!sh)return;
 if(!['sailing','gunnery','boarding'].includes(skill))return;
 if(v.projects.some(x=>x.kind==='crew'&&x.shipId===shipId))return say('Этот экипаж уже проходит обучение');
 if(sh.port==null||!N[sh.port]||s.provinces[sh.port].owner!==f)return say('Учения требуют дружественного порта');
 const gold=skill==='gunnery'?48:35,food=skill==='boarding'?8:5,powder=skill==='gunnery'?4:1;
 if(s.gold[f]<gold||s.food[f]<food||(s.equipment[f].gunpowder||0)<powder)return say('Недостаточно денег, пороха или провианта');
 s.gold[f]-=gold;s.food[f]-=food;s.equipment[f].gunpowder-=powder;
 v.projects.push({id:++v.next,kind:'crew',shipId,skill,remaining:24,f});log(`${sh.name}: начаты учения экипажа (${skill}, 24 дня).`);v15Render();drawAll();}
function v18CrewPanel(){let sh=s.ships.find(x=>x.id===v15ShipId&&x.f===s.player);if(!sh)return '';
 const cr=v18CrewStatus(sh),queue=v18State().projects.find(x=>x.shipId===sh.id&&x.kind==='crew');
 return `<section class="v18-section"><div class="v18-h"><h3>Подготовка экипажа · ${esc(sh.name)}</h3><small>Действует на стрельбу, движение эскадры и абордаж</small></div><div class="v18-regmetrics">${v15Gauge('Артиллеристы',cr.gunnery,100,'#c89e68',Math.round(cr.gunnery)+'%')}${v15Gauge('Парусная команда',cr.sailing,100,'#80b4c1',Math.round(cr.sailing)+'%')}${v15Gauge('Абордажные партии',cr.boarding,100,'#aa8eaa',Math.round(cr.boarding)+'%')}</div>${queue?`<div class="v18-cost">Учения продолжаются: ${queue.remaining} дней</div>`:''}<div class="v18-controls"><button onclick="v18ShipTrain(${sh.id},'gunnery')">Учить артиллеристов</button><button onclick="v18ShipTrain(${sh.id},'sailing')">Парусная подготовка</button><button onclick="v18ShipTrain(${sh.id},'boarding')">Абордажные учения</button></div></section>`;}
const v18OldShipPanel=v15ShipPanel;
v15ShipPanel=function(){return v18OldShipPanel()+v18CrewPanel()};
const v18OldShipPower=v6shipPower;
v6shipPower=function(sh,admiral){let out=v18OldShipPower(sh,admiral);let c=v18CrewStatus(sh);return out*(.90+.002*c.gunnery)*(.94+.001*c.boarding)*globalMod(sh.f,'gunDamage')/Math.max(.1,v18OriginalMod(sh.f,'gunDamage'));}
const v18OldSpeed=v8fleetSpeed;
v8fleetSpeed=function(fleet){let sp=v18OldSpeed(fleet),ships=v8shipsOf(fleet);if(!ships?.length)return sp;const skill=ships.reduce((a,sh)=>a+v18CrewStatus(sh).sailing,0)/ships.length;
 return sp*(.90+.002*skill)*globalMod(fleet.f,'shipSpeed')/Math.max(.1,v18OriginalMod(fleet.f,'shipSpeed'));};
const v18OldAdvance=advanceDay;
advanceDay=function(){v18OldAdvance();if(!s||s.ended)return;const v=v18State();for(const q of v.projects){q.remaining--;if(q.remaining<=0){if(q.kind==='crew'){let sh=s.ships.find(x=>x.id===q.shipId);if(sh){let stats=v18CrewStatus(sh);stats[q.skill]=Math.min(100,stats[q.skill]+14);if(q.skill==='gunnery')sh.gunnery=Math.min(100,(sh.gunnery||20)+10);if(q.skill==='sailing')sh.seamanship=Math.min(100,(sh.seamanship||20)+10);log(`${sh.name}: завершены учения, навык «${q.skill}» +14.`)}}}}
 v.projects=v.projects.filter(x=>x.remaining>0);
 if(s.day===1&&s.month%3===1){for(let f=0;f<F.length;f++){const ministry=V18_MINISTRIES[v.ministries[f]];if(ministry)s.gold[f]-=ministry.upkeep}}
};
// Province routes model: existing network + warehouse and docks contribute measurable throughput.
const v18OldSupply=v8supplyOf;
v8supplyOf=function(i){let q=v18OldSupply(i),p=s?.provinces?.[i];if(!p)return q;
 const mod=globalMod(p.owner,'supply')/Math.max(.1,v18OriginalMod(p.owner,'supply'));
 return Math.max(0,Math.min(100,q*mod+(p.depot||0)*2+(p.road||0)*1.5+(N[i]?.port?(p.dock||0)*.6:0)));};
function v18SupplyScreen(){let f=s.player,provinces=regOf(f).filter(z=>armies(z.p)>0).sort((a,b)=>armies(b.p)-armies(a.p)).slice(0,12),v=v8get();
 return `<section class="v18-section"><div class="v18-h"><h2>Логистическая карта</h2><small>Снабжение ограничивает силу и длительность походов</small></div><div class="v18-logrow">${provinces.map(z=>{const q=v8supplyOf(z.i),p=z.p;return `<button onclick="selected=${z.i};v15Close();tab='province';drawAll()"><b>${esc(N[z.i].name)}</b><small>${armies(p)} полков · склад ${p.depot||0} · дороги ${p.road||0}</small>${v15Gauge('Снабжение',q,100,q<35?'#c9796e':'#8caf98',Math.round(q)+'%')}</button>`}).join('')}</div><div class="v18-cost">Снабжение зависит от складов, дорог, портов, технологий и политических реформ. Щёлкни по гарнизону, чтобы перейти к региону.</div></section>`;}
function v18OperationsScreen(){const f=s.player,orders=s.orders.filter(x=>x.f===f),fleets=s.fleets.filter(x=>x.f===f),regi=regOf(f).reduce((acc,z)=>acc+armies(z.p),0),ships=s.ships.filter(x=>x.f===f);
 return `<section class="v18-section"><div class="v18-h"><h2>Оперативный штаб</h2><small>Один календарь для армий, эскадр, обучения и промышленности</small></div><div class="v18-totals"><div><b>${regi}</b><span>Полков</span></div><div><b>${ships.length}</b><span>Кораблей</span></div><div><b>${fleets.length}</b><span>Эскадр</span></div><div><b>${orders.length}</b><span>Приказов</span></div></div><div class="v18-operation-grid"><div><h3>Военные приказы</h3>${orders.slice(0,18).map(o=>`<div class="v18-operation"><b>${o.kind==='army'?'Сухопутный марш':'Морская операция'}</b><span>${esc(N[o.from]?.name||'?')} → ${esc(N[o.to]?.name||'?')}</span>${v15Gauge('Переход',Math.max(0,o.total-o.remaining),Math.max(1,o.total),'#9db7bd',Math.max(0,o.remaining)+' дн.')}</div>`).join('')||'<small>Действующих маршей пока нет.</small>'}</div><div><h3>Адмиралтейство</h3>${fleets.slice(0,12).map(fl=>`<div class="v18-operation"><b>${esc(fl.name)}</b><span>Судов: ${v8shipsOf(fl).length} · ${Number.isInteger(fl.port)?esc(N[fl.port]?.name||'порт'):'море'}</span></div>`).join('')||'<small>Эскадры не сформированы.</small>'}<div class="v18-controls"><button onclick="v15Switch('fleet')">Перейти во флот</button><button onclick="v15Switch('regiments')">Открыть полки</button></div></div></div></section>`;}
const v18OldHeader=v15Header;
v15Header=function(){return v18OldHeader().replace('</nav>',`<button class="${v15OverlayTab==='operations'?'on':''}" onclick="v15Switch('operations')">Штаб</button><button class="${v15OverlayTab==='government'?'on':''}" onclick="v15Switch('government')">Ведомства</button><button class="${v15OverlayTab==='supplyMap'?'on':''}" onclick="v15Switch('supplyMap')">Логистика</button></nav>`)};
const v18OldRender=v15Render;

 const el=document.getElementById('v15-window');if(!el||!s)return;el.innerHTML=v15Header()+`<div class="v15-h-body">${v15OverlayTab==='operations'?v18OperationsScreen():v15OverlayTab==='government'?v18GovernmentPanel():v18SupplyScreen()}</div>`;return;}
 v18OldRender();};

// Multiple durable ship variations: stern glazing, gunport bands and rigging react to hull seed.
const v18OldShipMesh=v8shipMesh;
v8shipMesh=function(type='frigate',design=null){let m=v18OldShipMesh(type,design);if(!design)return m;
 const k=(Number(design.modelSeed)||0)>>>0,L=(type==='line'?1.55:type==='frigate'?1.1:type==='transport'?1.16:.82)*11;
 const beam=(type==='line'?3.4:2.8)*(type==='line'?1.55:type==='frigate'?1.1:type==='transport'?1.16:.82)*.5;
 const col=['#dbc183','#b5ad8c','#c59561','#d8b76b'][k%4],count=4+(k%4);
 for(const side of [-1,1]){
   for(let i=0;i<count;i++){let x=-L*.39+(i+.5)*L*.77/count;
     v8cube(m,x,side*beam*.91,.05,.18,.07,.21,'#25272b');
     v8cube(m,x,side*beam*.93,.19,.23,.065,.038,col);
   }
   v8seg(m,[L*.32,side*beam*.78,.46],[L*.42,side*beam*.66,.93],col,1.1);
 }
 for(let i=0;i<3;i++){const x=L*(i-1)*.22;
  v8seg(m,[x,0,3.3],[x+((k>>i)&3)*.12,beam*.62,.35],'#ab9f80',.55);
  v8seg(m,[x,0,3.3],[x-((k>>(i+3))&3)*.12,-beam*.62,.35],'#ab9f80',.55);
 }
 return m;};
// Computer states develop strategic priorities once per quarter, respecting treasury limits and supply position.
const v18OldComputer=computerTurn;
computerTurn=function(){v18OldComputer();if(!s)return;const v=v18State();v.aiTicks++;
 for(let f=0;f<F.length;f++){if(f===s.player)continue;const regions=regOf(f);if(!regions.length)continue;
  if(!v.ministries[f]&&s.gold[f]>250){let q=NATIONAL[f]?.quality||'trade';let choice=q==='navy'?'navy':q==='army'?'military':q==='research'?'education':'commerce';s.gold[f]-=V18_MINISTRIES[choice].cost;v.ministries[f]=choice;}
  if(s.gold[f]>220){let frontier=regions.filter(x=>N[x.i].adj?.some(adj=>s.provinces[adj]?.owner!==f));let candidate=frontier.sort((a,b)=>armies(b.p)-armies(a.p))[0]||regions.find(z=>N[z.i].port)||regions[0];
   if(candidate){const p=candidate.p;if((p.depot||0)<2&&armies(p)>1){s.gold[f]-=95;p.depot=(p.depot||0)+1;}else if((p.road||0)<2){s.gold[f]-=80;p.road=(p.road||0)+1;}}
  }
 }
};

/* XVIII · Rendering refinement and manpower integration */
const v18BeforePop=v10PopulationMonth;
v10PopulationMonth=function(){v18BeforePop();if(!s?.demography)return;
 let d=s.demography;
 for(let i=0;i<N.length;i++){
   let owner=s.provinces[i]?.owner;if(!Number.isInteger(owner))continue;
   let multiplier=globalMod(owner,'manpower');
   if(multiplier>1){let bonus=Math.round((d.population[i]||0)*.00016*(multiplier-1));
     d.manpower[i]=Math.min(Math.round((d.population[i]||0)*.075),Math.max(0,(d.manpower[i]||0)+bonus));
   }
 }
};
// Infantry defensive doctrine is applied to actual combat power; reserve losses have tangible effect.
const v18BeforeLandDefense=power;
power=function(p,f,attack=false,where=0){let value=v18BeforeLandDefense(p,f,attack,where);if(!attack&&p){let infantry=UNITKEYS.some(k=>REGIMENTS[k]?.type==='Пехота'&&countUnit(p,k)>0);
 if(infantry)value*=globalMod(f,'infantryDef')/Math.max(.1,v18OriginalMod(f,'infantryDef'));}
 return value;};
const v18BeforeMilitaryLoss=militaryLoss;
militaryLoss=function(p,loss){let f=p?.owner;let adj=loss;
 if(Number.isInteger(f)&&f>=0&&f<F.length)adj=Math.floor(loss*globalMod(f,'armyLoss'));
 return v18BeforeMilitaryLoss(p,adj);};

const V19_OLD=new Map();for(const t of TECH){if(!t.id.startsWith('v19_')&&!/^(v15_|v17_|v18_)/.test(t.id))V19_OLD.set(t.id,V19_LEGACY[t.cat]||{research:1.003,trade:1.003})}

const v19GlobalBefore=globalMod;const v19ModCache=new Map();
function v19Aggregate(f){const tech=s?.tech?.[f]||[],sig=tech.length+':'+tech.slice(-3).join('/');let cache=v19ModCache.get(f);if(cache?.sig===sig)return cache.mods;const mods={};for(const id of tech){const row=V19_NEW[id]||V19_OLD.get(id);if(!row)continue;for(const [key,val] of Object.entries(row))mods[key]=(mods[key]||1)*val}v19ModCache.set(f,{sig,mods});return mods}
globalMod=function(f,key){const normal=v19GlobalBefore(f,key);return normal*(v19Aggregate(f)[key]||1)};
function v19fmtMod(k,v){return `<div class="v19-effect"><span>${esc(V19_LABELS[k]||BONUS_NAMES[k]||k)}</span><strong class="${v<1?'minus':'plus'}">${v<1?'−':'+'}${(Math.abs(1-v)*100).toFixed(Math.abs(v-1)<.01?1:0)}%</strong></div>`}
function v19hash(x){let h=2166136261;for(let i=0;i<x.length;i++)h=Math.imul(h^x.charCodeAt(i),16777619);return h>>>0}
const V19_IMG_CACHE=new Map();

 if(kind==='cannon'){const lb=Number((t.name+' '+t.id).match(/\b(4|6|9|12|18|24|32|42)\b/)?.[0])||([4,6,9,12,18,24,32,42][seed%8]);const r=4+lb*.42,barrel=65+lb*2.1;shape=`<path d="M50 88 L151 88 L163 115 L45 115 Z" fill="#795637" stroke="${stroke}" stroke-width="3"/><circle cx="78" cy="111" r="${10+lb*.30}" fill="#6c482c" stroke="#30291f" stroke-width="4"/><circle cx="78" cy="111" r="6" fill="#ad8855"/><circle cx="143" cy="111" r="${9+lb*.23}" fill="#6c482c" stroke="#30291f" stroke-width="4"/><path d="M61 ${81-r/2} Q77 ${80-r} 99 ${76-r/2} L${barrel+90} ${73-r*.45} L${barrel+90} ${73+r*.6} L100 ${76+r/2}Z" fill="#30373a" stroke="#181e21" stroke-width="3"/><path d="M${barrel+83} ${73-r*.45}v${r*1.04}" stroke="#8d9392" stroke-width="7"/>`}
 else if(kind==='ship'){const m=2+seed%3;shape=`<path d="M36 110 Q129 144 228 105 L202 128 Q122 153 55 124 Z" fill="#725236" stroke="#493626" stroke-width="3"/><path d="M40 108H221" stroke="#c8a56d" stroke-width="4"/>`;for(let i=0;i<m;i++){const x=81+i*56;shape+=`<path d="M${x} 103V35" stroke="#49392b" stroke-width="4"/><path d="M${x-3} 42 Q${x-51} 67 ${x-7} 99 Z" fill="#f1e8d3" stroke="#9f926f" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M${x+2} 43 Q${x+50} 71 ${x+3} 98 Z" fill="#d3c29e" stroke="#a39475" stroke-width="2"/>`}}
 else if(kind==='musket'){shape=`<path d="M35 111 L233 45" stroke="#6f4b2b" stroke-width="15" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M118 82 L253 37" stroke="#515757" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M99 89l6 21 11-4" fill="none" stroke="#282725" stroke-width="5"/><path d="M59 98 l-17 24" stroke="#b5945f" stroke-width="7"/>`}
 else if(kind==='horse'){shape=`<path d="M58 121L64 73 91 65 117 79 147 67 169 88 194 99 194 111 168 111 162 128 147 128 137 109 91 108 81 132 65 132Z" fill="#68513b" stroke="#3e3229" stroke-width="3"/><path d="M79 70L92 44 113 42 121 68" fill="#725638" stroke="#3e3229" stroke-width="3"/><path d="M139 79 L147 49" stroke="#6c4435" stroke-width="5"/><path d="M145 75 Q170 65 179 80" fill="none" stroke="#342721" stroke-width="4"/>`}
 else if(kind==='wagon'){shape=`<path d="M38 83L215 83 194 109 59 109Z" fill="#865b35" stroke="#4b3426" stroke-width="3"/><path d="M65 83V43H191V83" fill="none" stroke="#674b33" stroke-width="6"/><path d="M66 47L195 50" stroke="#d1b78f" stroke-width="5"/><circle cx="76" cy="119" r="20" fill="#604b34" stroke="#392e25" stroke-width="5"/><circle cx="176" cy="119" r="20" fill="#604b34" stroke="#392e25" stroke-width="5"/>`}
 else if(kind==='book'){shape=`<path d="M48 48Q89 34 136 56 Q177 34 224 48V120Q177 106 136 126 Q86 106 48 120Z" fill="#e8ddbe" stroke="#715a41" stroke-width="4"/><path d="M136 56V126" stroke="#9e8057" stroke-width="4"/><path d="M65 72Q97 67 123 78 M150 78Q185 67 204 72 M65 90Q97 85 123 95 M150 96Q185 85 204 91" stroke="#a19a82" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none"/>`}

function v19WeaponSpec(t){const c=CANNONS.find(z=>z.id===t.id);if(!c)return '';return `<div class="v19-gunstats"><b>Образец ${c.lb} фн</b><span>Урон ${c.atk.toFixed(1)}</span><span>Дальность ${c.range} м</span><span>Масса ${c.weight.toFixed(1)} т</span><span>Перезарядка ×${c.reload.toFixed(2)}</span></div>`}
function v19TechMods(t){return V19_MODS[t.id]||V19_LEGACY[t.cat]||{research:1.003,trade:1.003}}
function v19ChooseCategory(cat){v19Category=cat;v19OpenTech()}
let v19Category='Морская артиллерия',v19Term='';
function v19OpenTech(){const f=s.player,cats=[...new Set(TECH.map(t=>t.cat))];if(!cats.includes(v19Category))v19Category=cats[0];const term=v19Term.toLowerCase();const pool=TECH.filter(t=>(!term?t.cat===v19Category:(t.name+' '+t.cat).toLowerCase().includes(term))).slice(0,130);let cur=s.research[f];const h=`<section class="v19-techtree"><header><div><h2>Королевская академия</h2><small>Технологии ${s.tech[f].length}/${TECH.length} · образование ${edu(f).toFixed(1)}/100 · ${cur?'идёт исследование':'ожидает распоряжения'}</small></div><button onclick="closeModal()">Закрыть ✕</button></header><div class="v19-techcats">${cats.map(cat=>`<button class="${v19Category===cat?'active':''}" onclick="v19ChooseCategory('${cat.replace(/'/g,'')}')">${esc(cat)}</button>`).join('')}</div><div class="v19-search"><input placeholder="Поиск технологии" value="${esc(v19Term)}" onchange="v19Term=this.value;v19OpenTech()"><span>${pool.length} карточек · все эффекты указаны в %</span></div><div class="v19-techgrid">${pool.map(t=>{const mods=v19TechMods(t),done=has(f,t.id),ongoing=cur?.id===t.id,ok=techAccessible(f,t),can=!done&&!cur&&ok&&s.gold[f]>=t.cost;return `<article class="v19-techcard ${done?'done':''}"><img src="${v19TechPicture(t)}" alt="${esc(t.name)}"><h3>${esc(t.name)}</h3><p>${esc(t.desc||'Отраслевое исследование')}</p><div class="v19-effects">${Object.entries(mods).slice(0,4).map(([k,v])=>v19fmtMod(k,v)).join('')}${v19WeaponSpec(t)}</div><div class="v19-prereq">${t.eduMin?'Образование ≥'+t.eduMin+' · ':''}${t.req?.length?('Требуется: '+t.req.map(id=>TECH.find(x=>x.id===id)?.name||id).join(', ')):'Без предварительных исследований'}</div><footer><small>${researchDays(t,f)} дней · ◈ ${t.cost}</small><button ${can?'':'disabled'} onclick="research('${t.id}');v19OpenTech()">${done?'Изучено':ongoing?'Изучается':'Исследовать'}</button></footer></article>`}).join('')}</div></section>`;showModal(h);const b=$('modalbody');b.classList.add('v19-tech-dialog');}
// Update earlier tree entry points while keeping their mechanics and quests intact.
showTechTree=function(cat){if(cat&&TECH.some(t=>t.cat===cat))v19Category=cat;v19OpenTech()};
const v19BeforeHeader=v15Header;
v15Header=function(){return v19BeforeHeader().replace('</nav>',`<button class="${v15OverlayTab==='v19workshop'?'on':''}" onclick="v15Switch('v19workshop')">Портреты и 3D</button><button onclick="v19OpenTech()">Полное дерево</button></nav>`) };
const v19BeforeRender=v15Render;
v15Render=function(){if(v15OverlayTab==='v19workshop'){const el=document.getElementById('v15-window');if(!el||!s)return;el.innerHTML=v15Header()+`<div class="v15-h-body">${v19Workshop()}</div>`;try{v17InitCanvas();v17DrawModel()}catch(e){}return}v19BeforeRender()};
function v19Workshop(){const ds=(s.shipDesigns||[]).filter(d=>d.f===s.player),f=s.player,p=NATIONAL[f],ads=(s.advisers[f]||[]).map(id=>ADVISERS.find(a=>a.id===id)).filter(Boolean);return `<section class="v19-wshop"><header><h2>Королевская мастерская</h2><small>Генерация портретов и 3D-кораблей работает локально · сохранённый seed воспроизводит одну и ту же модель</small></header><div class="v19-workcols"><div><h3>Корона и советники</h3><div class="v19-people"><div><img src="${v15Portrait(p.ruler,'Монарх')}" alt="монарх"><b>${esc(p.ruler)}</b></div>${ADVISERS.map(a=>`<div><img src="${v15Portrait(a.name,a.role)}" alt="советник"><b>${esc(a.name)}${ads.includes(a)?' ✓':''}</b></div>`).join('')}</div><div class="v19-advice">Портреты отличаются за счёт имени и роли; генератор формирует SVG-портреты и сохраняет их в автономной игре.</div></div><div><h3>Обзор проектов · 3D</h3>${v17ShipDesigner()}</div></div></section>`}
function v19Retool(id,key){const v=v8get(),line=v.lines.find(x=>x.id===id&&x.f===s.player),eq=V6_EQUIP[key];if(!line||!eq)return say('Линия недоступна');if(!v6canEquip(s.player,key))return say('Сначала изучите образец');if(line.key===key)return say('Это изделие уже производится');const old=line.key,prev=line.eff;line.key=key;line.eff=Math.max(.12,prev*.45);line.work=0;line.blocked='';log(`Перепрофилирование: ${V6_EQUIP[old]?.name||old} → ${eq.name}. Эффективность ${Math.round(prev*100)}% → ${Math.round(line.eff*100)}%.`);v15Render();drawAll()}
function v19FactoryReport(){const v=v8get(),f=s.player,rows=v.lines.filter(x=>x.f===f),defs=Object.entries(V6_EQUIP).filter(([id])=>v6canEquip(f,id));return `<section class="v19-prod"><h2>Военное производство · план выпуска</h2><p>Перевод мануфактуры на другое изделие сохраняет 45% накопленной эффективности. Ресурсы списываются при фактическом выпуске.</p><div class="v19-prodgrid">${rows.map(l=>{const recipe=v8recipe(l.key),eff=l.eff*100;return `<article><div class="v19-prodhead"><img src="${(V6_ART[V6_EQUIP[l.key]?.art||l.key]||V6_ART.industry)}"><div><b>${esc(V6_EQUIP[l.key]?.name||l.key)}</b><small>${l.factories} заводов · эффективность ${eff.toFixed(1)}%</small></div></div><div class="v19-meter"><i style="width:${Math.max(1,eff)}%"></i></div><div class="v19-materials">${Object.entries(recipe).filter(x=>x[1]>0).map(([k,q])=>{const have=v8stock(f,k),needed=q*l.factories;return `<div class="${have<needed?'short':''}"><span>${esc(V8_MATERIALS[k]?.name||k)}</span><b>${have.toFixed(1)} / ${needed.toFixed(1)}</b></div>`}).join('')}</div><div class="v19-change"><select id="v19_to_${l.id}">${defs.map(([id,item])=>`<option ${id===l.key?'selected':''} value="${id}">${esc(item.name)}</option>`).join('')}</select><button onclick="v19Retool(${l.id},document.getElementById('v19_to_${l.id}').value)">Перепрофилировать</button></div></article>`}).join('')||'<p>Нет действующих линий.</p>'}</div></section>`}
const v19BeforeIndustry=v15IndustryPanel;
v15IndustryPanel=function(){return v19FactoryReport()+v19BeforeIndustry()};
// Experienced AI officials score demand and strategic threat rather than buying a random unit.
const v19OldAI=computerTurn;
computerTurn=function(){v19OldAI();if(!s)return;for(let f=0;f<F.length;f++){if(f===s.player||!regOf(f).length)continue;const land=regOf(f),front=land.filter(z=>N[z.i].adj.some(j=>withWar(f,s.provinces[j].owner))),sea=land.filter(z=>N[z.i].port),g=s.gold[f];
 if(!s.research[f]&&g>125){const options=TECH.filter(t=>!has(f,t.id)&&techAccessible(f,t)&&t.cost<Math.max(125,s.gold[f]*.55));if(options.length){const wartime=front.length>0,desired=wartime?['Логистика','Пехотные формирования','Пехотное оружие','Артиллерия и осады']:sea.length>1?['Кораблестроение','Флот','Морская артиллерия']:['Хозяйство','Образование'];options.sort((a,b)=>(desired.includes(b.cat)?4:0)-(desired.includes(a.cat)?4:0)+a.cost/1000-b.cost/1000);let t=options[0];s.gold[f]-=t.cost;s.research[f]={id:t.id,remaining:researchDays(t,f),total:researchDays(t,f)}}}
 const hub=front.sort((a,b)=>armies(b.p)-armies(a.p))[0]||land.find(z=>N[z.i].port)||land[0];if(!hub)continue;
 if(s.food[f]<24&&g>100){let ag=land.sort((a,b)=>(b.p.farm||0)-(a.p.farm||0))[0];if(ag.p.farm<4){ag.p.farm++;s.gold[f]-=75;}}
 else if(front.length&&hub.p.depot<2&&g>150){hub.p.depot++;s.gold[f]-=95;}
 else if(sea.length&&NATIONAL[f]?.quality==='navy'&&g>350&&s.wood[f]>50){let p=sea.sort((a,b)=>b.p.dock-a.p.dock)[0].p;if(!p.dock){p.dock=1;s.gold[f]-=135;s.wood[f]-=40;}}
 }};
// Expanded structural detail of procedurally generated vessels; seed is saved with design.
const v19BeforeMesh=v8shipMesh;
v8shipMesh=function(type='frigate',design=null){const m=v19BeforeMesh(type,design);if(!design)return m;const seed=(Number(design.modelSeed)||v19hash(design.name||type))>>>0,k=seed%5,size=type==='line'?1.55:type==='frigate'?1.1:type==='transport'?1.16:.82,L=11*size,W=(type==='line'?3.4:2.8)*size;const gold=['#a58a57','#bd9c64','#bdab7b','#928768','#bf904e'][k];for(const sign of [-1,1]){
 for(let a=0;a<5+k;a++){const x=-L*.37+(a+.5)*(L*.74)/(5+k);v8cube(m,x,sign*W*.465,-.08*size,.20*size,.065*size,.18*size,'#161d20');v8seg(m,[x,sign*W*.49,.06],[x,sign*W*.49,-.20*size],gold,.7)}
 v8seg(m,[-L*.42,sign*W*.46,.24*size],[L*.42,sign*W*.46,.24*size],gold,.9);
 for(let i=0;i<3;i++){let x=L*(i-1)*.25;v8seg(m,[x,sign*W*.27,2.5*size],[x+((seed>>(i*2))&3)*.045*size,sign*W*.47,.25*size],'#bcb49c',.7)}
 }
 for(let i=0;i<3;i++){const x=L*(i-1)*.26;v8cube(m,x,0,1.65*size,.19*size,.18*size,.20*size,'#a58a67');v8seg(m,[x,0,1.70*size],[x,0,2.65*size],'#514639',1.0)}
 return m};
const v19OldCannon=v8cannon3d;
v8cannon3d=function(m,x,y,z,lb=12,side=1,scale=1){v19OldCannon(m,x,y,z,lb,side,scale);const len=(.38+.17*lb/12)*scale,sz=(.28+lb/70)*scale,r=(.065+lb/400)*scale;v8cube(m,x,y,z-.18*scale,sz*.85,.39*scale,.06*scale,'#6c4b31');v8cylinder(m,[x,y+side*len*.85,z+.05*scale],[x,y+side*len*.93,z+.05*scale],r*1.13,'#77706a',10);v8cube(m,x-sz*.28,y,z-.04*scale,.05*scale,.51*scale,.09*scale,'#634b35');v8cube(m,x+sz*.28,y,z-.04*scale,.05*scale,.51*scale,.09*scale,'#634b35')};
// New map details appear only at close zoom, avoiding the previous giant-label problem.
function v19GeoDecor(){const world=document.getElementById('world');if(!world||!s)return;let g=document.getElementById('v19-geo');if(!g){g=document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','g');g.id='v19-geo';g.setAttribute('pointer-events','none');world.appendChild(g)}const towns=N.filter((n,i)=>i%49===0).slice(0,95);const rivers=N.filter((n,i)=>n.terrain==='plain'&&i%113===0).slice(0,50);g.innerHTML=`<g opacity=".62">${rivers.map(n=>`<path d="M${n.x-7},${n.y-10} Q${n.x+3},${n.y} ${n.x+9},${n.y+12}" stroke="#4796b2" stroke-width="1.1" fill="none"/>`).join('')}</g><g>${towns.map(n=>`<circle cx="${n.x}" cy="${n.y}" r="1.6" fill="#e5d9b9" stroke="#5d4f37" stroke-width=".8"/><path d="M${n.x-2},${n.y+2}v-4l2-1.7 2 1.7v4Z" fill="#b79b6a"/>`).join('')}</g>`;g.style.opacity=zoom>4?'.95':zoom>2?'.42':'0'};
const v19OldDrawMap=drawMap;drawMap=function(){v19OldDrawMap();v19GeoDecor()};
const v19OldTransform=updateTransform;updateTransform=function(){v19OldTransform();let el=document.getElementById('v19-geo');if(el)el.style.opacity=zoom>4?'.95':zoom>2?'.42':'0'};
// Don't overwrite previous saves; version XIX has its own key.

const v19OldLoad=load;load=function(){try{const txt=localStorage.getItem(V19_SAVE);if(!txt)return v19OldLoad();restoreSave(JSON.parse(txt));drawAll();say('Кампания XIX загружена')}catch(e){say('Не удалось открыть XIX: '+e.message)}};
const v19OldSaveQuiet=saveQuiet;saveQuiet=function(){try{if(s)localStorage.setItem(V19_SAVE,JSON.stringify(s))}catch(e){}};

 const available=Math.floor(inv[key]||0),n=Math.min(item.quantity,available);if(n<1){if(before){inv[before.key]-=before.count;r.v19Gear[item.slot]=before}return say('Пустой склад: '+item.name)}inv[key]-=n;r.v19Gear[item.slot]={key,count:n};log(r.name+': выдан '+item.name+' ('+n+' из '+item.quantity+').');v15Render();drawAll()}

function v20SetDesignModule(id,slot,key){const d=s.shipDesigns.find(x=>x.id===id&&x.f===s.player);if(!d)return;let v=key&&V20_MODULES[key];if(v&&(v.slot!==slot||!has(s.player,v.tech)))return say('Сначала исследуйте эту модификацию');d.modules ||= {};if(!key)delete d.modules[slot];else d.modules[slot]=key;drawAll(); if(document.getElementById('v15-window')?.offsetParent!==null)v15Render()}

При постройке один комплект каждого модуля списывается со склада.</p><div class="v20-modulegrid">${Object.entries(V20_SLOT_NAMES).map(([slot,label])=>`<label class="v20-module"><b>${label}</b><select onchange="v20SetDesignModule(${d.id},'${slot}',this.value)"><option value="">Без модуля</option>${Object.entries(V20_MODULES).filter(([k,v])=>v.slot===slot).map(([k,v])=>`<option value="${k}" ${d.modules?.[slot]===k?'selected':''} ${has(f,v.tech)?'':'disabled'}>${esc(v.name)} ${has(f,v.tech)?'':'· изучить'}</option>`).join('')}</select><small>${d.modules?.[slot]?V20_MODULES[d.modules[slot]].desc:'Выберите исследованный модуль'}</small></label>`).join('')}</div><div class="v20-summary">${Object.entries(mods).map(([k,v])=>`<span>${V20_BONUS_LABELS[k]||k}: <b class="${v<1?'v20-minus':'v20-plus'}">${v<1?'−':'+'}${(Math.abs(v-1)*100).toFixed(0)}%</b></span>`).join('')||'На проекте нет дополнительных модулей.'}</div><button onclick="v15Switch('industry')">Производство модулей ↗</button></section>`}
const v20OldDesigner=v17ShipDesigner;

const v20BaseStats=v6designStats;
v6designStats=function(d){const st=v20BaseStats(d),mods=v20ModsFor(d),h=V6_HULLS[d.type]; if(!h)return st;
 if(mods.carriageWeight){const before=st.weight;st.weight=before*mods.carriageWeight;st.speed=Math.max(3,st.speed*(1+Math.min(.16,(before-st.weight)/Math.max(1,h.tonnage)*.8)));if(st.weight>h.tonnage*.18&&!st.errors.some(e=>e.includes('перегружают'))) {st.valid=false;st.errors.push('Перегрузка корпуса орудиями')}}
 st.reloadSec=Math.round(17*globalMod(d.f,'gunReload')*(mods.gunReload||1));st.commandMultiplier=globalMod(d.f,'commandDelay')*(mods.commandDelay||1);st.formationMultiplier=globalMod(d.f,'formationHold')*(mods.formationHold||1);st.turnMultiplier=globalMod(d.f,'turnRate')*(mods.turnRate||1);st.moduleCount=Object.keys(d.modules||{}).length;st.days=Math.ceil(st.days*(1+.012*st.moduleCount)); st.gold=Math.ceil(st.gold*(1+.018*st.moduleCount));return st};
const v20BuildBase=v6buildShip;
v6buildShip=function(id){let d=v6design(id);if(!d)return;const stock=s.equipment[s.player],req=Object.values(d.modules||{});for(const k of req){const m=V20_MODULES[k];if(!m||!has(s.player,m.tech))return say('Не исследован корабельный модуль: '+(m?.name||k));if((stock[k]||0)<1)return say('На складе нет модуля «'+m.name+'». Назначьте на производство его комплект.');}
 const before=s.production.length;v20BuildBase(id);if(s.production.length>before){for(const k of req)stock[k]--;const q=s.production[s.production.length-1];if(q.key==='customship')q.design.modules={...d.modules};} };
function v20ShipOrganization(fleet){if(!fleet)return {value:0,delay:99,hold:0,formation:'line'};const ships=v8shipsOf(fleet);if(!ships.length)return {value:0,delay:99,hold:0,formation:fleet.formation||'line'};const n=ships.length,formation=fleet.formation||'line',fm=V20_FORMATIONS[formation]||V20_FORMATIONS.line;
 const crewAvg=ships.reduce((a,x)=>a+Math.min(1,x.crew/Math.max(1,x.crewMax)),0)/n;
 const trainAvg=ships.reduce((a,x)=>a+((x.crewSkills?.sailing||x.crewSkills?.gunnery||x.experience||20)),0)/n;
 const sizePenalty=Math.min(.35,Math.max(0,n-4)*.023),morale=Math.min(100,fleet.seaMorale??83)/100;
 const cohesion=ships.reduce((sum,sh)=>sum*v20ShipMod(sh,'formationHold'),1)**(1/n);

 const adm=fleet.admiral!=null?1.08:1;
 const hold=Math.max(.3,Math.min(1.7,(.35+trainAvg*.005+crewAvg*.27)*fm.cohesion*cohesion*adm*(1-sizePenalty)*(.65+morale*.35)));
 const value=Math.max(1,Math.min(100,Math.round(hold*79)));

function v20FleetFormat(id,form){let fl=s.fleets.find(x=>x.id===id&&x.f===s.player);if(!fl||!V20_FORMATIONS[form])return;fl.formation=form;log(`Эскадра «${fl.name}» перешла на построение «${V20_FORMATIONS[form].name}».`);drawAll();v8Refresh(false)}

 for(let side of [-1,1]){const y=side*W*.32;for(let j=0;j<18;j++){let x=(-.42+j*.05)*L;v8seg(m,[x,y,.22*size],[x,y,.51*size],'#b99b66',.65);if(j>0)v8seg(m,[(x-L*.05),y,.48*size],[x,y,.48*size],'#c6a579',.7);}for(let j=0;j<9;j++){let x=(-.36+j*.084)*L;v8seg(m,[x,y,.43*size],[x-L*.04,0,.51*size],'#9d855f',.4)}}

 const stern=-(.46*L),paint=['#b38b48','#b7a16b','#9d6d3b'][seed%3];for(let j=-2;j<=2;j++){v8seg(m,[stern,j*W*.09,.38*size],[stern,j*W*.09,1.15*size],paint,.9);v8cube(m,stern-.08,j*W*.09,.93*size,.13*size,W*.054,.27*size,'#425761')}
 v8cube(m,stern-.1,0,1.22*size,L*.06,W*.56,.15*size,paint);

function v20EnsureNavies(){const state=V20_STATE();if(!state||state.naviesInitialized)return;state.naviesInitialized=true;
 for(let f=0;f<F.length;f++){if(f===s.player||s.fleets.some(x=>x.f===f))continue;const port=N.map((n,i)=>({n,i,p:s.provinces[i]})).filter(x=>x.n.port&&x.p.owner===f).sort((a,b)=>((b.p.line||0)*3+(b.p.frigate||0)*2+(b.p.sloop||0))-((a.p.line||0)*3+(a.p.frigate||0)*2+(a.p.sloop||0)))[0];if(!port)continue;const shipsCount=Math.min(3,(port.p.sloop||0)+(port.p.frigate||0)+(port.p.line||0));if(shipsCount<1)continue;const fleet={id:++s.v6seq,f,name:`${F[f].name}: эскадра ${port.n.name}`,port:port.i,admiral:f%V6_ADMIRALS.length,embarked:[],formation:'line',provisions:130,seaMorale:80};s.fleets.push(fleet);
 const types=[];for(const [k,c] of [['line',port.p.line||0],['frigate',port.p.frigate||0],['sloop',port.p.sloop||0]])for(let j=0;j<Math.min(3,c);j++)types.push(k);
 for(const type of types.slice(0,shipsCount)){const h=V6_HULLS[type],design={f,type,name:`Проект ${h.label}`,modelSeed:f*101+shipsCount,modules:{},batteries:h.decks.map((dk,j)=>({gun:type==='line'?'gun12':type==='frigate'?'gun9':'gun4',count:Math.min(dk.max,type==='line'?16:type==='frigate'?12:6)}))};const st=v6designStats(design);s.ships.push({id:++s.v6seq,f,name:`${F[f].name}: ${h.label} №${s.v6seq%100}`,type,design,port:port.i,fleetId:fleet.id,hp:st.hp,maxHp:st.hp,crew:Math.round(h.crew*.83),crewMax:h.crew,ammo:80,crewSkills:{sailing:25+f%20,gunnery:22+f%15}});}
 }

function v20StartContact(){if(!s)return;const v=V20_STATE();if(!v.contact)return;const contact=v.contact,ours=s.fleets.find(x=>x.id===contact.ours),theirs=s.fleets.find(x=>x.id===contact.theirs);if(!ours||!theirs||!v8shipsOf(ours).length||!v8shipsOf(theirs).length){v.contact=null;return say('Контакт потерян')};if(!withWar(ours.f,theirs.f))return say('Для атаки нейтральной эскадры сначала требуется объявить войну.');v.contact=null;v20ContactOverlay();v8Open3DBattle('sea',true,{fleet:ours,enemyFleet:theirs,openSea:true,to:theirs.port,contactId:contact.id});}
function v20IgnoreContact(){const state=V20_STATE();const c=state.contact;if(c){state.seen[c.id]=(s.year||1700)*400+(s.month||1)*31+(s.day||1)+30;state.contact=null;v20ContactOverlay();}}
function v20ContactOverlay(){let el=document.getElementById('v20-alert');if(!el){el=document.createElement('div');el.id='v20-alert';document.body.appendChild(el)}const c=s?.v20?.contact;if(!c){el.classList.remove('visible');el.innerHTML='';return;}const ours=s.fleets.find(x=>x.id===c.ours),theirs=s.fleets.find(x=>x.id===c.theirs);if(!ours||!theirs){el.classList.remove('visible');return}const war=withWar(ours.f,theirs.f);el.innerHTML=`<div class="v20-alert-top"><strong>⚑ Обнаружена эскадра</strong><button onclick="v20IgnoreContact()">✕</button></div><div class="v20-contacts"><div><b>${esc(ours.name)}</b><span>${v8shipsOf(ours).length} корабля · организация ${v20ShipOrganization(ours).value}%</span></div><span>≈</span><div><b>${esc(theirs.name)}</b><span>${v8shipsOf(theirs).length} корабля · ${war?'ВРАГ':'нейтралитет'}</span></div></div><p>Морской контакт у ${esc(N[c.coast]?.name||'побережья')}. function v20ScanContact(){const v=V20_STATE();if(!v||v.contact)return;const orders=v8get().seaOrders.filter(o=>o.f===s.player&&o.remaining>0);if(!orders.length)return;const now=(s.year||1700)*400+(s.month||1)*31+(s.day||1);const rivals=s.fleets.filter(x=>x.f!==s.player&&x.port!=null&&v8shipsOf(x).length>0);for(const o of orders){const player=s.fleets.find(x=>x.id===o.fleetId);if(!player||!v8shipsOf(player).length||!o.position)continue;const skill=v20ShipOrganization(player);for(const other of rivals){const pt=N[other.port];if(!pt)continue;const d=Math.hypot(o.position.x-pt.x,o.position.y-pt.y),spotMod=v8shipsOf(player).reduce((p,sh)=>p*v20ShipMod(sh,'spotting'),1)**(1/Math.max(1,v8shipsOf(player).length));if(d>26*spotMod*(.6+skill.value/130))continue;let id=[player.id,other.id].join('/');if((v.seen[id]||0)>now)continue;v.contact={id,ours:player.id,theirs:other.id,coast:other.port};pauseGame();v20ContactOverlay();log(`Наблюдатели эскадры «${player.name}» обнаружили суда государства ${F[other.f].name}.`);return;}}}

const v20OpenOriginal=v8Open3DBattle;

 const sc=V8_SCENE,fl=context?.fleet||s.fleets.find(x=>x.f===s.player),hostile=context?.enemyFleet; if(hostile){const real=v8shipsOf(hostile);sc.units=sc.units.filter(u=>u.team==='friendly').concat(real.slice(0,6).map((sh,i)=>({id:100+i,shipId:sh.id,kind:'ship',type:sh.type,design:sh.design,pos:[25,i*11-10,0],angle:Math.PI,hp:sh.hp,maxHp:sh.maxHp,team:'enemy',name:sh.name,cooldown:3+i,turn:0,ammo:sh.ammo||80,firepower:v6shipPower(sh,hostile.admiral)})));}

 v20BattleHud();
};

const v20OldCommand=v8battleCommand;
v8battleCommand=function(cmd){if(!v8Battle?.v20||V8_SCENE?.kind!=='sea')return v20OldCommand(cmd);if(cmd==='pause')return v20OldCommand(cmd);if(cmd==='sail'){v8Battle.sails=!v8Battle.sails;return;}const unit=v8select3dUnit();if(!unit)return;if(['left','right','fire'].includes(cmd))return v20QueueOrder(unit,cmd);return v20OldCommand(cmd)};
function v20BattleHud(){const b=v8Battle?.v20;const hud=document.getElementById('v8-battle-hud');if(!b||!hud)return;const o=v20ShipOrganization(b.squadron),alive=V8_SCENE?.units.filter(x=>x.hp>0&&x.team==='friendly')||[];hud.innerHTML=`<b>ОРГАНИЗАЦИЯ ${o.value}/100</b> · задержка команды ${o.delay} с · строй: ${V20_FORMATIONS[b.formation]?.name||'линия'} · скорость боя ×${b.timeScale} · ${alive.length} кораблей · ${b.commands.length} ожидающих приказов`}
const v20OriginalStep=v8sceneStep;
v8sceneStep=function(rawDt){const sc=V8_SCENE,b=v8Battle?.v20;if(!b||sc?.kind!=='sea')return v20OriginalStep(rawDt);if(sc.paused)return;const dt=rawDt*b.timeScale;sc.time+=dt;if(v8Battle)v8Battle.elapsed+=dt;for(const item of [...b.commands]){if(sc.time<item.when)continue;const u=sc.units.find(x=>x.id===item.id);if(!u||u.hp<=0){b.commands.splice(b.commands.indexOf(item),1);continue}if(item.cmd==='heading'){u.desiredHeading=item.extra.angle;u.order='manual'}else if(item.cmd==='left'){u.desiredHeading-=Math.PI/6;u.order='manual'}else if(item.cmd==='right'){u.desiredHeading+=Math.PI/6;u.order='manual'}else if(item.cmd==='fire'){if(u.cooldown<=0)v8fire(u)}else if(item.cmd==='retreat'){u.targetSpeed=u.knots;u.desiredHeading=Math.PI;u.order='retreat'}else if(item.cmd==='chase'){u.order='chase';u.targetSpeed=u.knots}else if(item.cmd==='line'){u.order='line';u.targetSpeed=u.knots*.82};b.commands.splice(b.commands.indexOf(item),1)}
 const friendly=sc.units.filter(x=>x.kind==='ship'&&x.team==='friendly'&&x.hp>0), enemy=sc.units.filter(x=>x.kind==='ship'&&x.team==='enemy'&&x.hp>0),lead=friendly[0];
 for(const u of [...friendly,...enemy]){u.cooldown=Math.max(0,(u.cooldown||0)-dt);let real=s.ships.find(x=>x.id===u.shipId);if(real)u.knots=v20VesselSpeed(real);let speed=(u.knots||8)*(u.hp/Math.max(1,u.maxHp))**.25;
 if(u.team==='friendly'){if(u.order==='line'&&lead&&u!==lead){const idx=friendly.indexOf(u),gap=(V20_FORMATIONS[b.formation]?.spacing||11),o=v20ShipOrganization(b.squadron);speed*=v26Station(u,lead,idx,gap,o.hold,b.squadron?.f??s.player);}if(u.order==='chase'&&enemy.length){const tgt=enemy.reduce((a,x)=>Math.hypot(x.pos[0]-u.pos[0],x.pos[1]-u.pos[1])<Math.hypot(a.pos[0]-u.pos[0],a.pos[1]-u.pos[1])?x:a,enemy[0]);u.desiredHeading=Math.atan2(tgt.pos[1]-u.pos[1],tgt.pos[0]-u.pos[0]);}if(v8Battle.sails===false)speed*=.48;}
 else if(friendly.length){v26EnemyTactics(u,friendly,enemy)}
 speed*=v27Sailing(u,real);const diff=Math.atan2(Math.sin((u.desiredHeading??u.angle)-u.angle),Math.cos((u.desiredHeading??u.angle)-u.angle));const turning=(real?v20ShipMod(real,'turnRate'):1)*(V20_FORMATIONS[u.team==='friendly'?b.formation:'line']?.turn||1);u.angle+=Math.max(-dt*.18*turning,Math.min(dt*.18*turning,diff));u.actualSpeed+=(speed-u.actualSpeed)*Math.min(1,dt*.6);u.pos[0]+=Math.cos(u.angle)*u.actualSpeed*dt*.105;u.pos[1]+=Math.sin(u.angle)*u.actualSpeed*dt*.105;
 u.pos[0]=Math.max(-180,Math.min(180,u.pos[0]));u.pos[1]=Math.max(-150,Math.min(150,u.pos[1]));}
 sc.smoke=sc.smoke.filter(x=>x.age<1.7);for(const x of sc.smoke)x.age+=dt;
 if(Math.floor(sc.time*2)!==Math.floor((sc.time-dt)*2)){v20BattleHud();for(const btn of document.querySelectorAll('#v8-unit-strip button[data-unit]')){const u=sc.units.find(x=>x.id===+btn.dataset.unit),e=btn.querySelector('.v10-unit-health>i');if(u&&e)e.style.width=Math.max(0,100*u.hp/Math.max(1,u.maxHp))+'%'}}
 if(friendly.length===0||enemy.length===0)v8finish3dBattle(!!friendly.length);

 :root{--gold:#ddb97b;--cream:#f4e0ae}
 body{font-family:'Palatino Linotype',Georgia,serif!important}

 .v20-modulegrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}.v17-design-controls .v20-modulegrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.v17-design-controls .v20-panel{margin-top:10px;padding:10px}.v17-design-controls .v20-panel h3{font-size:16px}.v20-quick{position:sticky;top:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:7px;background:#102632;border:1px solid #9b7f51;border-radius:6px;z-index:2;gap:6px}.v20-quick b{font-size:12px;color:#dfcb9b}.v20-quick button{padding:6px 9px;font-size:11px}.v20-module{padding:10px;border:1px solid #615139;border-radius:6px;background:#122430;display:grid;gap:8px}.v20-module b{color:#f1dba8}.v20-module small{font-size:11px;color:#bacacb;line-height:1.4}.v20-module select,.v20-squadrow select{max-width:100%;min-height:33px;background:#1a3645;border:1px solid #7e6b48;color:#f3e8ce;padding:6px}
 .v20-summary{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px;margin:12px 0}.v20-summary span{padding:7px;border:1px solid #655236;border-radius:4px;background:#152631;font-size:12px}.v20-plus{color:#8dd19f}.v20-minus{color:#d8ad70}
 .v20-squadrow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(190px,1fr) minmax(150px,.75fr) auto;align-items:center;gap:16px;padding:12px 8px;border-top:1px solid #4a5360}.v20-squadrow>div{display:grid;gap:5px}.v20-squadrow small{display:block;color:#b2c5cb}.v20-squadrow span{font-size:12px;color:#d5c5a6}.v20-bar{width:100%;height:9px;background:#1a2731;border:1px solid #665844;border-radius:9px;overflow:hidden}.v20-bar i{height:100%;display:block;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#638a8a,#b8c98d)}
 #v20-alert{display:none;position:fixed;z-index:99999;top:90px;right:22px;width:min(530px,90vw);border:2px solid #bca066;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#1d3440,#0e1d27);color:#f4e8d1;padding:15px;box-shadow:0 20px 80px #000b;border-radius:8px}#v20-alert.visible{display:block}.v20-alert-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:19px}.v20-contacts{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:9px;margin-top:13px}.v20-contacts>div{flex:1;border:1px solid #6d5c3a;padding:10px;background:#152735}.v20-contacts b{display:block;color:#ecd3a4}.v20-contacts span{display:block;font-size:11px;color:#b7cad0}.v20-alert-actions{display:flex;gap:8px}.v20-alert-actions button:last-child{background:linear-gradient(#a7824c,#76522d);border-color:#dfba79}
 .v20-tactical-controls{position:absolute;left:12px;right:12px;top:10px;display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;z-index:6;background:#0c1d27db;border:1px solid #a68758;border-radius:7px;padding:7px}.v20-tactical-controls button{padding:6px 9px!important;font-size:11px}.v20-tactical-controls .sel{background:#846744;border-color:#e2c47e}#v8-stage:has(#v20-tactical-controls)>.v8-3d-controls{display:none!important}.v20-tactical-controls span{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1.5px;color:#e9d9b2;margin-right:5px}
 #v20-maplegend{position:absolute;pointer-events:none;bottom:14px;right:18px;padding:5px 9px;background:#102736d9;border:1px solid #af915f;border-radius:4px;color:#dbcaa6;font:italic 12px Georgia,serif}

// Regiment doctrines affect combat, not just text on the research cards.
const v20OldPower=power;
power=function(province,f,attack=false,where=0){return v20OldPower(province,f,attack,where)*globalMod(f,'regimentMorale')*globalMod(f,'armySupply')};
const v20OldStateLabels=v15StateLabels;
v15StateLabels=function(r){const p=v20OldStateLabels(r);p[0]*=globalMod(s.player,'regimentMorale');p[1]*=globalMod(s.player,'regimentMorale');return p};
// Reload speed and shock recoil are applied to live 3D broadsides.
const v20OldFire=v8fire;
v8fire=function(u){if(V8_SCENE?.kind!=='sea'||u.kind!=='ship')return v20OldFire(u);const ship=s.ships.find(x=>x.id===u.shipId);const enemy=V8_SCENE.units.filter(x=>x.team!==u.team&&x.kind==='ship'&&x.hp>0).sort((a,b)=>Math.hypot(a.pos[0]-u.pos[0],a.pos[1]-u.pos[1])-Math.hypot(b.pos[0]-u.pos[0],b.pos[1]-u.pos[1]))[0];const prior=enemy?.hp??0,was=u.cooldown||0;const allUnits=V8_SCENE.units;V8_SCENE.units=allUnits.filter(x=>x.kind!=='coast');try{v20OldFire(u)}finally{V8_SCENE.units=allUnits}if(!ship||u.cooldown<=was||u.cooldown<=0)return;u.cooldown*=v20ShipMod(ship,'gunReload');ship.v20Wear=(ship.v20Wear||0)+.03*v20ShipMod(ship,'recoilStress');u.cooldown*=1+Math.min(.18,(ship.v20Wear||0)*.002);if(enemy&&enemy.hp<prior){const target=s.ships.find(x=>x.id===enemy.shipId),gun=v20ShipMod(ship,'gunAccuracy'),armor=target?.design?.modules?.safety==='magazine'?.96:1;enemy.hp=Math.max(0,prior-(prior-enemy.hp)*gun*armor)} };
// Supply structures change consumption on active voyages and troop orders.
const v20OldSupplyDaily=v9FleetSupplyDaily;
v9FleetSupplyDaily=function(){if(!s)return;const before=new Map(s.fleets.map(fl=>[fl.id,fl.provisions||0]));v20OldSupplyDaily();for(const fl of s.fleets){const was=before.get(fl.id)??0,spent=Math.max(0,was-(fl.provisions||0));const eff=globalMod(fl.f,'seaSupply');if(spent>0&&eff>1)fl.provisions+=spent*(1-1/eff)}};
const v20OldMarch=march;
march=function(from,to){const f=s.player,c=s.orders.length;v20OldMarch(from,to);if(s.orders.length>c&&has(f,'v20_couriers')){const o=s.orders[s.orders.length-1];if(o.kind==='army'){o.remaining=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(o.remaining*globalMod(f,'armyCommandDelay')));o.total=o.remaining}}};
const v20OldComplete=v6completeShip;
v6completeShip=function(q){const before=new Set(s.ships.map(x=>x.id));v20OldComplete(q);if(q.key!=='customship')return;const sh=s.ships.find(x=>!before.has(x.id));if(sh&&sh.design?.modules?.safety==='magazine')sh.ammo=Math.round((sh.ammo||100)*v20ShipMod(sh,'ammoCapacity'));};

/* XX · Non-player patrol routing, repairs and real on-map sightings. */
function v20AIPatrolOrders(){if(!s||!s.v8)return;const v=v8get();for(const f of Array.from({length:F.length},(_,i)=>i)){if(f===s.player)continue;const fl=s.fleets.find(x=>x.f===f&&v8shipsOf(x).length);if(!fl||v.seaOrders.some(x=>x.fleetId===fl.id)||fl.port==null)continue;if(s.gold[f]<75)continue;const origin=N[fl.port];if(!origin?.port)continue;const ports=N.map((n,i)=>({n,i})).filter(({n,i})=>n.port&&i!==fl.port&&s.provinces[i].owner===f&&adjacentSea(seaZone(origin),seaZone(n))&&distKm(origin,n)>75);if(ports.length<1)continue;ports.sort((a,b)=>Math.abs(distKm(origin,a.n)-480)-Math.abs(distKm(origin,b.n)-480));const target=ports[0],speed=v8fleetSpeed(fl),days=Math.max(9,Math.ceil(distKm(origin,target.n)/(Math.max(3,speed)*7.8)+3));v.seaOrders.push({id:++v.id,f,fleetId:fl.id,type:'patrol',from:fl.port,to:target.i,remaining:days,total:days,progress:0,position:{x:origin.x,y:origin.y}});}}
const v20EarlierAI=v20AIMonth;v20AIMonth=function(){const day=s.day,month=s.month,year=s.year;v20EarlierAI();if(day!==1||month%2!==0)return;const st=V20_STATE(),index=year*12+month;if(st.lastPatrol===index)return;st.lastPatrol=index;v20AIPatrolOrders();for(const fl of s.fleets.filter(x=>x.f!==s.player)){if(v8get().seaOrders.some(x=>x.fleetId===fl.id))continue;for(const sh of v8shipsOf(fl)){if(sh.hp>=sh.maxHp*.97||s.gold[fl.f]<35||s.wood[fl.f]<3)continue;sh.hp=Math.min(sh.maxHp,sh.hp+sh.maxHp*.045*globalMod(fl.f,'damageControl'));s.gold[fl.f]-=7;s.wood[fl.f]-=2;}}};
// Include sailing adversaries when checking detection ranges; do not duplicate vessels.
const v20OriginalScan=v20ScanContact;v20ScanContact=function(){v20OriginalScan();if(s?.v20?.contact)return;const v=V20_STATE(),all=v8get().seaOrders;const our=all.filter(o=>o.f===s.player&&o.position&&o.remaining>0),their=all.filter(o=>o.f!==s.player&&o.position&&o.remaining>0);if(!our.length||!their.length)return;const now=(s.year||1700)*400+(s.month||1)*31+(s.day||1);for(const a of our){const own=s.fleets.find(x=>x.id===a.fleetId);if(!own)continue;for(const b of their){const enemy=s.fleets.find(x=>x.id===b.fleetId);if(!enemy||!v8shipsOf(enemy).length)continue;const d=Math.hypot(a.position.x-b.position.x,a.position.y-b.position.y);const visibility=19*(.7+v20ShipOrganization(own).value/90);if(d>visibility)continue;const id=own.id+'/'+enemy.id;if((v.seen[id]||0)>now)continue;v.contact={id,ours:own.id,theirs:enemy.id,coast:b.to};pauseGame();v20ContactOverlay();log(`В море замечена эскадра «${enemy.name}».`);return;}}};

 TECH.push({id,cat,name,req:requirements.filter(x=>TECH.some(t=>t.id===x)),eduMin:education,cost,time:6,mods,desc:effects});

const v21GlobalBase=globalMod;

 lampSignals:{name:'Фонари с кодовыми заслонками',slot:'signals',tech:'v21_lamp_codes',recipe:{copper:.36,wood:.20,flax:.24},gold:7.2,work:2.5,mods:{commandDelay:.91,signalReliability:1.14,nightSignals:1.18},desc:'Задержка приказов −9% · надёжность сигналов +14% · ночная сигнализация +18%'},

 hullPartitions:{name:'Переборки и аварийные помпы',slot:'safety',tech:'v21_repair_teams',recipe:{wood:2.4,iron:.48,hemp:.12},gold:10.2,work:3.4,mods:{damageControl:1.13,fireRisk:.93,carriageWeight:1.035},desc:'Борьба за живучесть +13% · риск пожара −7% · масса оборудования +3,5%'}
};

function V21_STATE(){if(!s)return null;s.v21 ||= {drills:[],aiDate:-1};return s.v21;}
function v21ShipFatigue(sh){return Math.min(100,Math.max(0,sh?.v21Fatigue||0))}
const v21OrgBase=v20ShipOrganization;
v20ShipOrganization=function(fl){const base=v21OrgBase(fl);if(!fl||!base.ships)return {...base,reliability:0,fatigue:0,stationError:0};
 const vessels=v8shipsOf(fl);const fatigue=vessels.reduce((a,sh)=>a+v21ShipFatigue(sh),0)/vessels.length;
 const baseClarity=Math.min(1.18,Math.max(.35,.92-fatigue*.0034));
 const moduleRel=vessels.reduce((a,sh)=>a*v20ShipMod(sh,'signalReliability'),1)**(1/vessels.length);
 const techBonus=globalMod(fl.f,'seaEndurance');
 const holdFactor=Math.max(.60,1-fatigue*.0035),value=Math.max(1,Math.round(base.value*holdFactor));
 const reliability=Math.min(99,Math.max(30,Math.round(100*baseClarity*moduleRel)));
 const delay=Math.max(.8,Math.round(base.delay*(1+fatigue*.005)/Math.max(.80,Math.min(1.25,techBonus)) *10)/10);
 const stationError=Math.round(Math.max(2,(100-value)*.35+(100-reliability)*.12));
 return {...base,value,delay,hold:base.hold*holdFactor,reliability,fatigue:Math.round(fatigue),stationError};
};
// Signal quality affects both order latency and how precisely ships follow their admiral's intentions.
const v21OrderLatencyBase=v20OrderLatency;
v20OrderLatency=function(u){const base=v21OrderLatencyBase(u);const fl=v8Battle?.v20?.squadron, o=v20ShipOrganization(fl);
 const sc=V8_SCENE,flag=sc?.units.find(x=>x.team==='friendly'&&x.kind==='ship'&&x.hp>0);
 const range=flag&&u&&flag!==u?Math.hypot(flag.pos[0]-u.pos[0],flag.pos[1]-u.pos[1]):0;
 const relPenalty=1+(100-(o.reliability||85))*.002;
 const distancePenalty=Math.max(1,range/34);
 return Math.max(.8,base*relPenalty*distancePenalty);
};
const v21QueueBase=v20QueueOrder;
v20QueueOrder=function(u,cmd,extra){v21QueueBase(u,cmd,extra);const b=v8Battle?.v20;if(!b||!b.commands.length)return;
 const o=v20ShipOrganization(b.squadron),q=b.commands[b.commands.length-1];
 if(q.id===u.id&&o.reliability<85)q.when+=(85-o.reliability)*.045;
};
// Fleet formations affect a practical station-keeping measurement, shown on the battle HUD.
const v21HudBase=v20BattleHud;
v20BattleHud=function(){v21HudBase();const b=v8Battle?.v20,el=document.getElementById('v8-battle-hud');if(!b||!el)return;
 const o=v20ShipOrganization(b.squadron);
 el.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',`<span class="v21-hud-extra"> · сигнал ${o.reliability}% · отклонение линии ~${o.stationError}% · усталость ${o.fatigue}%</span>`);
};
function v21Daily(){if(!s)return;const st=V21_STATE(),orders=v8get().seaOrders;
 const atSea=new Set(orders.filter(x=>x.remaining>0).map(x=>x.fleetId));
 for(const fl of s.fleets){const offshore=atSea.has(fl.id)||fl.port==null;
  for(const sh of v8shipsOf(fl)){
   const rate=globalMod(fl.f,'crewFatigue');
   const relief=globalMod(fl.f,'seaEndurance');
   sh.v21Fatigue=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,v21ShipFatigue(sh)+(offshore?1.15*rate/Math.max(.75,relief):(-2.5*relief))));
  }
 }
 for(const drill of [...st.drills]){drill.days--;if(drill.days>0)continue;
  const fl=s.fleets.find(x=>x.id===drill.fleetId);
  if(fl){for(const sh of v8shipsOf(fl)){sh.crewSkills ||= {};sh.crewSkills.sailing=Math.min(100,(sh.crewSkills.sailing||20)+7*globalMod(fl.f,'crewTraining'));sh.v21Fatigue=Math.min(100,v21ShipFatigue(sh)+9)}fl.seaMorale=Math.min(100,(fl.seaMorale??75)+4);log(`Эскадра «${fl.name}»: закончена сигнальная и строевая подготовка.`)}
  st.drills.splice(st.drills.indexOf(drill),1);
 }
}
function v21TrainFleet(id){const fl=s.fleets.find(x=>x.id===id&&x.f===s.player);if(!fl||!v8shipsOf(fl).length)return say('Необходима действующая эскадра');
 const st=V21_STATE();if(st.drills.some(x=>x.fleetId===id))return say('Эскадра уже на учениях');
 if(fl.port==null)return say('Сначала верните эскадру в порт для учебного выхода');
 if(s.gold[s.player]<48||s.food[s.player]<10||(s.equipment[s.player]?.gunpowder||0)<4)return say('Учения: 48 монет, 10 провианта и 4 пороха');
 s.gold[s.player]-=48;s.food[s.player]-=10;s.equipment[s.player].gunpowder-=4;
 st.drills.push({fleetId:id,days:18});log(`Эскадра «${fl.name}»: начаты 18-дневные учения передачи сигналов.`);drawAll();
}
function v21FleetCards(){const f=s.player,st=V21_STATE();return `<section class="v21-panel"><h3>Сигнальная служба и боеготовность</h3><p>Каждый корабль сохраняет собственную скорость. Подготовка, усталость и оборудование влияют на получение приказов и удержание позиции.</p><div class="v21-grid">${s.fleets.filter(fl=>fl.f===f&&v8shipsOf(fl).length).map(fl=>{const o=v20ShipOrganization(fl),training=st.drills.find(x=>x.fleetId===fl.id);return `<div class="v21-fleet"><b>${esc(fl.name)}</b><small>${o.ships} кораблей · задержка ${o.delay} с</small><div class="v21-meter"><span>Организация</span><i><u style="width:${o.value}%"></u></i><strong>${o.value}%</strong></div><div class="v21-meter"><span>Передача сигналов</span><i><u style="width:${o.reliability}%"></u></i><strong>${o.reliability}%</strong></div><div class="v21-meter"><span>Усталость</span><i><u style="width:${o.fatigue}%;background:#c67f5c"></u></i><strong>${o.fatigue}%</strong></div><button ${training?'disabled':''} onclick="v21TrainFleet(${fl.id})">${training?'Учения · '+training.days+' дн.':'18 дней: учения сигналов'}</button></div>`}).join('')||'<div class="mini">Сначала сформируйте эскадру.</div>'}</div></section>`}
const v21FleetUIBase=v8fleetUI;
v8fleetUI=function(){return v21FleetCards()+v21FleetUIBase()};

function v21FieldStores(){const reg=v15SelectedReg();if(!reg||!own(selected))return say('Выберите свой полк');
 if(s.food[s.player]<8||(s.equipment[s.player]?.gunpowder||0)<2||s.gold[s.player]<12)return say('Необходимо 8 провианта, 2 пороха и 12 монет');
 s.food[s.player]-=8;s.equipment[s.player].gunpowder-=2;s.gold[s.player]-=12;
 reg.v21Supplies=Math.min(100,(reg.v21Supplies??60)+28);log(`${reg.name}: обоз доставил запас продовольствия и пороха.`);v15Render();drawAll();
}

v15RegPanel=function(){const html=v21RegBase(),r=v15SelectedReg();return (r?`<section class="v21-panel"><h3>Полковой обоз и пополнение</h3><p>Запасы подразделения: <b>${r.v21Supplies??60}%</b>. Пополнение требует продовольствие, порох и казну.</p><button onclick="v21FieldStores()">Пополнить обоз — 8 провианта / 2 пороха / 12 ◈</button></section>`:'')+html};
const v21PowerBase=power;
power=function(p,f,attack=false,where=0){let x=v21PowerBase(p,f,attack,where);const records=p?.v15Regiments||[];if(records.length){let avg=records.reduce((a,r)=>a+(r.v21Supplies??60),0)/records.length;x*=.85+avg*.0015;}return x};
// Stable, deterministic extra plank and stern geometry; never re-randomize when opening a blueprint.
const v21ShipMeshBase=v8shipMesh;
v8shipMesh=function(type='frigate',design=null){let mesh=v21ShipMeshBase(type,design);if(!design)return mesh;const seed=design.modelSeed||1700,scale=type==='line'?1.55:type==='frigate'?1.10:type==='transport'?1.16:.82;
 const gunPorts=type==='line'?13:type==='frigate'?9:6;
 for(let side of [-1,1])for(let i=0;i<gunPorts;i++){
  const x=(-4.7+(i+.5)*9.4/gunPorts)*scale,y=side*1.16*scale;
  v8cube(mesh,x,y,.53*scale,.34*scale,.085*scale,.24*scale,'#211d1b');
  v8cube(mesh,x,y,.69*scale,.39*scale,.092*scale,.058*scale,['#b09250','#c0ab76','#84623d'][seed%3]);
 }
 for(let i=0;i<3+(seed%3);i++){const x=(-2.3+i*1.15)*scale;v8seg(mesh,[x,0,2.6*scale],[x+.55*scale,1.1*scale,.27*scale],'#b6ad8d',.45);v8seg(mesh,[x,0,2.6*scale],[x-.55*scale,-1.1*scale,.27*scale],'#b6ad8d',.45)}
 return mesh;
};
// Monthly computer decision: if a squadron is exhausted, stop sending it on another patrol.
const v21OldAIPatrol=v20AIPatrolOrders;
v20AIPatrolOrders=function(){if(!s)return;let v=v8get();
 for(const fl of s.fleets){if(fl.f===s.player||fl.port==null)continue;const o=v20ShipOrganization(fl);
  if(o.fatigue>68||o.value<35){fl.v21RestUntil=(s.year*12+s.month)+1;}
 }
 const excluded=new Set(s.fleets.filter(fl=>fl.v21RestUntil&&(s.year*12+s.month)<=fl.v21RestUntil).map(fl=>fl.id));
 if(!excluded.size)return v21OldAIPatrol();
 // Temporarily mark resting fleets as already assigned; no changes to their real course or supply.
 const fake=Array.from(excluded, fleetId=>({fleetId,remaining:0,_v21:true}));v.seaOrders.push(...fake);
 try{v21OldAIPatrol()}finally{v.seaOrders=v.seaOrders.filter(x=>!x._v21)};
};

 const ports=N.filter(n=>n.port&&n.core).slice(0,70);layer.innerHTML=ports.map(n=>`<g transform="translate(${n.x} ${n.y})"><circle r="3.4" fill="#f0d3a1" stroke="#1a2b34" stroke-width="1.3"/><path d="M-2.1 -1.7H2.1M0 -4V4M-3 1L0 4L3 1" fill="none" stroke="#213b48" stroke-width=".75"/></g>`).join('');

/* XXI · Более различимые процедурные исторические портреты (без сторонних ассетов). */
function v21Portrait(name,role='Придворный'){
 const encoded=v15Portrait(name,role);
 const svg=decodeURIComponent(encoded.slice(encoded.indexOf(',')+1));
 const seed=v15Hash('XXI|'+name+'|'+role),c=['#e4c782','#d3a968','#bbd0d3','#ae975c'][seed%4],off=seed%4;
 const tr=role.toLowerCase();
 const navy=tr.includes('флот')||tr.includes('адмирал')||tr.includes('мор');
 const ruler=tr.includes('правител')||tr.includes('корол')||tr.includes('импер')||tr.includes('герцог');
 const military=tr.includes('воен')||tr.includes('генерал')||navy;

 for(const [id,,,,,,mods] of V22_TECHS)if(has(f,id)&&mods[k]!=null)x*=mods[k];
 const st=s.v22;if(st?.policy?.[f]&&V22_POLICIES[st.policy[f]]?.mods[k]!=null)x*=V22_POLICIES[st.policy[f]].mods[k];
 return x;};

 V6_EQUIP[key]={name:item.name,tech:item.tech,work:item.work,art:'naval',gold:item.gold,iron:item.recipe.iron||0,wood:item.recipe.wood||0,steel:item.recipe.steel||0,copper:item.recipe.copper||0};

function v22State(){if(!s)return null;s.v22 ||= {refits:[],policy:{},lastAI:0};return s.v22;}
function v22ModText(k,v){return `<span>${esc(BONUS_NAMES[k]||V20_BONUS_LABELS?.[k]||k)}</span><b class="${v<1?'v22-neg':'v22-pos'}">${v<1?'−':'+'}${(100*Math.abs(1-v)).toFixed(1)}%</b>`;}
function v22RefitShip(id,key){const ship=s.ships.find(sh=>sh.id===id&&sh.f===s.player),item=V20_MODULES[key];if(!ship||!item)return say('Корабль или модуль недоступен');
 const fl=s.fleets.find(x=>x.id===ship.fleetId);
 if(!fl||fl.port==null||s.provinces[fl.port]?.owner!==s.player)return say('Корабль должен находиться в собственном порту');
 if(!has(s.player,item.tech))return say('Сначала изучите модуль');
 if((s.equipment[s.player]?.[key]||0)<1)return say('На складе нет комплекта: поставьте его на производственную линию');
 const q=v22State().refits;if(q.some(x=>x.shipId===id))return say('Корабль уже модернизируется');
 if(s.gold[s.player]<28||s.wood[s.player]<5||s.iron[s.player]<2)return say('Недостаточно ресурсов: 28 монет, 5 древесины и 2 железа');
 if(ship.design?.modules?.[item.slot]===key)return say('Модуль уже установлен');
 s.gold[s.player]-=28;s.wood[s.player]-=5;s.iron[s.player]-=2;s.equipment[s.player][key]--;
 q.push({shipId:id,key,slot:item.slot,remaining:14,total:14,port:fl.port});
 log(`${ship.name}: начата 14-дневная модернизация — ${item.name}.`);v15Render();drawAll();
}
function v22RefitCard(ship){if(!ship)return '';const choices=Object.entries(V20_MODULES).filter(([key,m])=>has(s.player,m.tech));const pending=v22State().refits.find(x=>x.shipId===ship.id);
 let html=`<section class="v22-panel"><h3>Модернизация готового корабля</h3><p>Только в собственном порту. Оборудование необходимо произвести; работы занимают 14 дней, требуют 28 ◈ / 5 древесины / 2 железа.</p>`;
 html+=`<div class="v22-modcols">${Object.entries(V20_SLOT_NAMES).map(([slot,label])=>{const current=ship.design?.modules?.[slot];return `<div class="v22-module"><b>${label}</b><small>${current?esc(V20_MODULES[current]?.name||current):'Стандартное оснащение'}</small>${choices.filter(([k,v])=>v.slot===slot).map(([k,v])=>`<button ${pending||current===k?'disabled':''} onclick="v22RefitShip(${ship.id},'${k}')">${esc(v.name)} · склад ${s.equipment[s.player][k]||0}</button>`).join('')}</div>`}).join('')}</div>`;
 if(pending)html+=`<div class="v22-warning">Работы: осталось ${pending.remaining} дней</div>`;
 return html+'</section>';
}
const v22ShipPanelBase=v15ShipPanel;
v15ShipPanel=function(){const sh=(s.ships||[]).find(x=>x.id===v15ShipId)||s.ships.find(x=>x.f===s.player);return v22ShipPanelBase()+v22RefitCard(sh);};
function v22Advance(){const st=v22State();for(const q of [...st.refits]){q.remaining--;if(q.remaining>0)continue;
 const sh=s.ships.find(x=>x.id===q.shipId);if(sh){sh.design ||= {type:sh.type,batteries:[],f:sh.f};sh.design.modules||={};const old=sh.design.modules[q.slot];sh.design.modules[q.slot]=q.key;
 if(old&&V20_MODULES[old])s.equipment[sh.f][old]=(s.equipment[sh.f][old]||0)+1;
 log(`Корабль «${sh.name}»: установлен модуль «${V20_MODULES[q.key]?.name}».`);}
 st.refits.splice(st.refits.indexOf(q),1);
 }
 // Operating expenditures of each current ministry apply at quarterly boundaries (policy is distinct).
 if(s.day===1&&[1,4,7,10].includes(s.month))for(const [fstr,key] of Object.entries(st.policy)){let f=+fstr;if(V22_POLICIES[key])s.gold[f]=Math.max(0,s.gold[f]-V22_POLICIES[key].upkeep)}
}
function v22PolicyChoose(key){const p=V22_POLICIES[key],f=s.player;if(!p)return;if(v22State().policy[f]===key)return;
 if(s.gold[f]<p.cost)return say('Недостаточно денег для выбранного курса');
 s.gold[f]-=p.cost;v22State().policy[f]=key;log(`Кабинет министров: ${p.name}.`);drawAll();if(document.getElementById('v15-overlay')?.classList.contains('open'))v15Render();}
function v22PolicyUI(){let f=s.player,chosen=v22State().policy[f];return `<section class="v22-panel"><div class="v22-heading"><h3>Государственная программа</h3><small>Реальные множители, цена утверждения и содержание за квартал</small></div><div class="v22-policygrid">${Object.entries(V22_POLICIES).map(([key,p],i)=>`<article class="v22-policy ${chosen===key?'on':''}"><img src="${v15Portrait(p.name,'Министерская программа '+(i+1))}" alt=""><div><b>${p.name}</b><p>${p.desc}</p>${Object.entries(p.mods).map(([k,v])=>`<div class="v22-modline">${v22ModText(k,v)}</div>`).join('')}<small>Утверждение ${p.cost} ◈ · содержание ${p.upkeep} ◈/квартал</small><button ${chosen===key?'disabled':''} onclick="v22PolicyChoose('${key}')">${chosen===key?'Действует':'Утвердить программу'}</button></div></article>`).join('')}</div></section>`;}

// Predict shortages from active factory recipes and the currently assigned workshops.
function v22Demand(){const f=s.player,lines=v8get().lines.filter(x=>x.f===f&&x.factories&&x.active),demand={},producing=[];
 for(const q of lines){let e=V6_EQUIP[q.key];if(!e)continue;const units=q.factories*globalMod(f,'arsenalSpeed')*(.35+q.eff*.65)/Math.max(.04,e.work||1);
 producing.push({key:q.key,count:units});for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(v8recipe(q.key,q.f)))if(v>0)demand[k]=(demand[k]||0)+units*v;
 }
 return {demand,producing};}
function v22IndustryUI(){let f=s.player,{demand}=v22Demand();const keys=Object.keys(V8_MATERIALS).filter(k=>k in demand || ['iron','wood','steel','copper','hemp','coal'].includes(k));
 return `<section class="v22-panel"><div class="v22-heading"><h3>Промышленный баланс</h3><small>Расчёт при текущем назначении мануфактур (без будущей добычи и импорта)</small></div><div class="v22-balancegrid">${keys.map(k=>{let d=demand[k]||0,x=v8stock(f,k),days=d>0?x/d:Infinity,crit=days<7;return `<div class="v22-balance ${crit?'critical':''}"><b>${esc(V8_MATERIALS[k]?.name||k)}</b><div class="v22-modline"><span>Запас</span><strong>${x.toFixed(1)}</strong></div><div class="v22-modline"><span>Расход / день</span><strong>${d.toFixed(2)}</strong></div><div class="v22-modline"><span>Хватит на</span><strong>${Number.isFinite(days)?days.toFixed(1)+' дн.':'∞'}</strong></div><div class="v22-meter"><i style="width:${Number.isFinite(days)?Math.min(100,days*2):100}%;background:${crit?'#ce8462':'#8eba9c'}"></i></div></div>`}).join('')}</div></section>`;}

// Additional visual artillery and wearable equipment detail for each deterministic 3D hull.
const v22HullBase=v8shipMesh;
v8shipMesh=function(type='frigate',design=null){const mesh=v22HullBase(type,design);if(!design)return mesh;
 const size=type==='line'?1.55:type==='frigate'?1.10:type==='transport'?1.16:.82;
 const seed=design.modelSeed||Math.max(1,(design.id||7)*137),n=type==='line'?12:type==='frigate'?9:type==='transport'?5:6,L=11*size,beam=(type==='line'?3.4:2.8)*size/2;
 for(let side of [-1,1]){for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
   const x=-L*.37+(i+.5)*L*.74/n,y=side*beam*.80,z=-.27*size;
   v8cube(mesh,x,y,z,.30*size,.055*size,.29*size,'#342820');
   v8cube(mesh,x,side*(beam*.84),z+.09*size,.34*size,.05*size,.04*size,'#bba47a');
 }
 for(let j=0;j<4;j++){let x=-L*.37+j*L*.24;
  v8seg(mesh,[x,side*beam*.79,.30*size],[x,side*beam*.79,.72*size],'#b3966d',.7);
  v8seg(mesh,[x,side*beam*.79,.72*size],[x+L*.22,side*beam*.79,.72*size],'#b3966d',.55);
 }
 }
 for(let k=0;k<3+(seed%3);k++){const x=(-L*.26+k*L*.13);
 v8cube(mesh,x,0,.39*size,.30*size,.5*size,.23*size, k%2?'#896844':'#674832');}
 // Cabin windows, framing, and variation in brass fittings.
 for(let side of [-1,1])for(let k=0;k<3+(seed%2);k++)v8cube(mesh,-L*.45+k*.32*size,side*beam*.69,.64*size,.18*size,.08*size,.22*size,k%2?'#d3bc81':'#9d825b');
 return mesh;};
const v22SoldierBase=v8soldier;
v8soldier=function(m,x,y,z,kind='inf',coat='#a8463a',motion=0){v22SoldierBase(m,x,y,z,kind,coat,motion);
 if(kind==='inf'){v8cube(m,x,y,z+1.62,.42,.38,.14,'#232527');v8cube(m,x,y,z+1.73,.52,.28,.09,'#303035');
  v8seg(m,[x-.20,y,z+.43],[x+.24,y,z+1.06],'#d3bd91',.6);
 }else if(kind==='cav'){v8seg(m,[x-.12,y,z+1.0],[x+.85,y,z+1.75],'#c4c4c0',.70)};
};
